using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

class Program
{
    public struct Cut
    {
        public int Index;
        public int Length;
        public double SortKey;
    }

    public struct Placement
    {
        public int TargetBin;
        public int CutSortedIndex;
    }

    static int N;
    static int L;
    static int M;
    static Cut[] initialCuts;
    static int[] bestGlobalCutBin;
    static int bestGlobalBinsCount = int.MaxValue;
    static object globalLock = new object();

    public class SolverThreadState
    {
        public Cut[] LocalCuts;
        public int[] LocalTree;
        public int[] LocalBinHead;
        public int[] LocalCutNext;
        public int[] LocalBinCapacityRemaining;
        public int[] LocalBinTotalWeight;
        public int[] LocalActiveBins;
        public int[] LocalCutBin;
        public int LocalBestBinsCount;
        public int[] LocalBestCutBin;

        public SolverThreadState(Cut[] initialCuts)
        {
            LocalCuts = new Cut[N];
            Array.Copy(initialCuts, LocalCuts, N);

            LocalTree = new int[2 * M];
            LocalBinHead = new int[N];
            LocalCutNext = new int[N];
            LocalBinCapacityRemaining = new int[N];
            LocalBinTotalWeight = new int[N];
            LocalActiveBins = new int[N];
            LocalCutBin = new int[N];
            LocalBestCutBin = new int[N];
            LocalBestBinsCount = int.MaxValue;
        }

        public void SolveIteration(Random rand, double alpha, int lowerBound)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            {
                LocalCuts[i].SortKey = -LocalCuts[i].Length + rand.NextDouble() * alpha;
            }

            Array.Sort(LocalCuts, (a, b) => a.SortKey.CompareTo(b.SortKey));

            // Reset tree
            for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) LocalTree[M + i] = L;
            for (int i = M - 1; i >= 1; i--) LocalTree[i] = L;

            // Reset bins
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            {
                LocalBinHead[i] = -1;
                LocalCutNext[i] = -1;
                LocalBinCapacityRemaining[i] = L;
                LocalBinTotalWeight[i] = 0;
            }

            // FFD
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            {
                int w = LocalCuts[i].Length;
                int binIdx = FindFirstBin(w);
                if (binIdx == -1) continue;

                LocalCutNext[i] = LocalBinHead[binIdx];
                LocalBinHead[binIdx] = i;
                LocalBinCapacityRemaining[binIdx] -= w;
                LocalBinTotalWeight[binIdx] += w;
                UpdateTree(binIdx, LocalBinCapacityRemaining[binIdx]);
            }

            // Inactive bin zeroing
            for (int i = 0; i < M; i++)
            {
                if (i >= N || LocalBinHead[i] == -1)
                {
                    UpdateTree(i, 0);
                }
            }

            // Run local search
            while (true)
            {
                bool merged = RunBinMergingPass();
                if (!merged) break;
            }

            int binsUsed = CountActiveBins();
            if (binsUsed < LocalBestBinsCount)
            {
                LocalBestBinsCount = binsUsed;
                for (int b = 0; b < N; b++)
                {
                    int curr = LocalBinHead[b];
                    while (curr != -1)
                    {
                        LocalCutBin[LocalCuts[curr].Index] = b;
                        curr = LocalCutNext[curr];
                    }
                }
                Array.Copy(LocalCutBin, LocalBestCutBin, N);
            }
        }

        private int CountActiveBins()
        {
            int count = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            {
                if (LocalBinHead[i] != -1) count++;
            }
            return count;
        }

        private void SortBinsDescending(int[] arr, int left, int right)
        {
            if (left >= right) return;
            int pivot = LocalBinCapacityRemaining[arr[left + (right - left) / 2]];
            int i = left;
            int j = right;
            while (i <= j)
            {
                while (LocalBinCapacityRemaining[arr[i]] > pivot) i++;
                while (LocalBinCapacityRemaining[arr[j]] < pivot) j--;
                if (i <= j)
                {
                    int temp = arr[i];
                    arr[i] = arr[j];
                    arr[j] = temp;
                    i++;
                    j--;
                }
            }
            SortBinsDescending(arr, left, j);
            SortBinsDescending(arr, i, right);
        }

        private bool RunBinMergingPass()
        {
            int numActive = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            {
                if (LocalBinHead[i] != -1)
                {
                    LocalActiveBins[numActive++] = i;
                }
            }

            if (numActive <= 1) return false;

            SortBinsDescending(LocalActiveBins, 0, numActive - 1);

            bool anyMerged = false;
            List<int> tempCuts = new List<int>();
            List<Placement> placements = new List<Placement>();

            for (int i = 0; i < numActive; i++)
            {
                int b = LocalActiveBins[i];
                if (LocalBinHead[b] == -1) continue;

                int origCap = LocalBinCapacityRemaining[b];

                tempCuts.Clear();
                int curr = LocalBinHead[b];
                while (curr != -1)
                {
                    tempCuts.Add(curr);
                    curr = LocalCutNext[curr];
                }

                UpdateTree(b, 0);

                placements.Clear();
                bool success = true;

                for (int k = 0; k < tempCuts.Count; k++)
                {
                    int cIdx = tempCuts[k];
                    int length = LocalCuts[cIdx].Length;
                    int targetBin = FindFirstBin(length);
                    if (targetBin == -1)
                    {
                        success = false;
                        break;
                    }

                    LocalBinCapacityRemaining[targetBin] -= length;
                    UpdateTree(targetBin, LocalBinCapacityRemaining[targetBin]);
                    placements.Add(new Placement { TargetBin = targetBin, CutSortedIndex = cIdx });
                }

                if (success)
                {
                    for (int k = 0; k < placements.Count; k++)
                    {
                        int targetBin = placements[k].TargetBin;
                        int cIdx = placements[k].CutSortedIndex;

                        LocalCutNext[cIdx] = LocalBinHead[targetBin];
                        LocalBinHead[targetBin] = cIdx;
                        LocalBinTotalWeight[targetBin] += LocalCuts[cIdx].Length;
                    }

                    LocalBinHead[b] = -1;
                    LocalBinCapacityRemaining[b] = 0;
                    LocalBinTotalWeight[b] = 0;
                    UpdateTree(b, 0);

                    anyMerged = true;
                }
                else
                {
                    for (int k = 0; k < placements.Count; k++)
                    {
                        int targetBin = placements[k].TargetBin;
                        int cIdx = placements[k].CutSortedIndex;

                        LocalBinCapacityRemaining[targetBin] += LocalCuts[cIdx].Length;
                        UpdateTree(targetBin, LocalBinCapacityRemaining[targetBin]);
                    }

                    LocalBinCapacityRemaining[b] = origCap;
                    UpdateTree(b, origCap);
                }
            }

            return anyMerged;
        }

        private int FindFirstBin(int w)
        {
            if (LocalTree[1] < w) return -1;
            int node = 1;
            while (node < M)
            {
                if (LocalTree[node * 2] >= w)
                {
                    node = node * 2;
                }
                else
                {
                    node = node * 2 + 1;
                }
            }
            return node - M;
        }

        private void UpdateTree(int binIdx, int newCap)
        {
            int node = M + binIdx;
            LocalTree[node] = newCap;
            node >>= 1;
            while (node >= 1)
            {
                LocalTree[node] = Math.Max(LocalTree[node * 2], LocalTree[node * 2 + 1]);
                node >>= 1;
            }
        }
    }

    public static class FastParser
    {
        private static readonly byte[] buffer = new byte[1024 * 1024];
        private static int bufferCount = 0;
        private static int bufferPointer = 0;
        private static Stream stream = Console.OpenStandardInput();

        public static int ReadInt()
        {
            while (true)
            {
                if (bufferPointer >= bufferCount)
                {
                    bufferCount = stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
                    bufferPointer = 0;
                    if (bufferCount == 0) return -1; // EOF
                }
                byte b = buffer[bufferPointer++];
                if (b >= '0' && b <= '9')
                {
                    int val = b - '0';
                    while (true)
                    {
                        if (bufferPointer >= bufferCount)
                        {
                            bufferCount = stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
                            bufferPointer = 0;
                            if (bufferCount == 0) return val;
                        }
                        byte next = buffer[bufferPointer];
                        if (next >= '0' && next <= '9')
                        {
                            val = val * 10 + (next - '0');
                            bufferPointer++;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            bufferPointer++; // Consume non-digit
                            return val;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        N = FastParser.ReadInt();
        if (N <= 0)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(0);
            return;
        }
        L = FastParser.ReadInt();

        initialCuts = new Cut[N];
        long sumLengths = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            int len = FastParser.ReadInt();
            initialCuts[i] = new Cut { Index = i, Length = len };
            sumLengths += len;
        }

        int lowerBound = (int)((sumLengths + L - 1) / L);

        M = 1;
        while (M < N) M <<= 1;
        
        bestGlobalCutBin = new int[N];

        Stopwatch sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();

        int maxThreads = Environment.ProcessorCount;
        int numIterations = 1;
        if (N < 1000) numIterations = 1000;
        else if (N < 10000) numIterations = 200;
        else if (N < 100000) numIterations = 40;
        else numIterations = 12;

        bool solvedOptimal = false;

        Parallel.For(0, numIterations, new ParallelOptions { MaxDegreeOfParallelism = maxThreads }, (iter, state) =>
        {
            if (Volatile.Read(ref solvedOptimal))
            {
                state.Stop();
                return;
            }

            if (sw.ElapsedMilliseconds > 240000)
            {
                state.Stop();
                return;
            }

            Random threadRand = new Random(42 + iter);
            double alpha = (iter == 0) ? 0.0 : (iter * 1.5);

            SolverThreadState localSolver = new SolverThreadState(initialCuts);
            localSolver.SolveIteration(threadRand, alpha, lowerBound);

            lock (globalLock)
            {
                if (localSolver.LocalBestBinsCount < bestGlobalBinsCount)
                {
                    bestGlobalBinsCount = localSolver.LocalBestBinsCount;
                    Array.Copy(localSolver.LocalBestCutBin, bestGlobalCutBin, N);

                    if (bestGlobalBinsCount <= lowerBound)
                    {
                        Volatile.Write(ref solvedOptimal, true);
                        state.Stop();
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        PrintOutput();
    }

    static void PrintOutput()
    {
        int[] binMap = new int[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) binMap[i] = -1;

        int uniqueBins = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            int b = bestGlobalCutBin[i];
            if (binMap[b] == -1)
            {
                binMap[b] = uniqueBins++;
            }
        }

        int[] head = new int[uniqueBins];
        int[] next = new int[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < uniqueBins; i++) head[i] = -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            int remappedBin = binMap[bestGlobalCutBin[i]];
            next[i] = head[remappedBin];
            head[remappedBin] = i;
        }

        StreamWriter writer = new StreamWriter(Console.OpenStandardOutput(), Encoding.ASCII, 65536);
        writer.WriteLine(uniqueBins);
        for (int b = 0; b < uniqueBins; b++)
        {
            int curr = head[b];
            bool first = true;
            while (curr != -1)
            {
                if (!first) writer.Write(' ');
                writer.Write(curr);
                first = false;
                curr = next[curr];
            }
            writer.WriteLine();
        }
        writer.Flush();
    }
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <functional>
#include <thread>
#include <mutex>
#include <cmath>

struct Rectangle {
    int id;
    int w;
    int h;
    int area;
};

struct Placement {
    int id;
    int board_idx;
    int x;
    int y;
    int rotated;
};

struct SkylineSegment {
    int x;
    int y;
    int width;
};

struct FreeRect {
    int x;
    int y;
    int w;
    int h;
};

struct PlacementOption {
    bool valid = false;
    bool from_free_list = false;
    int free_list_idx = -1;
    int x = 0;
    int y = 0;
    int rotated = 0;
    double score = 1e18;
};

struct Solution {
    int num_boards;
    std::vector<Placement> placements;
};

void add_free_rect(std::vector<FreeRect>& free_rects, FreeRect new_fr, int free_list_cap) {
    if (new_fr.w <= 0 || new_fr.h <= 0) return;
    for (const auto& fr : free_rects) {
        if (new_fr.x >= fr.x && new_fr.y >= fr.y &&
            new_fr.x + new_fr.w <= fr.x + fr.w &&
            new_fr.y + new_fr.h <= fr.y + fr.h) {
            return;
        }
    }
    free_rects.erase(
        std::remove_if(free_rects.begin(), free_rects.end(), [&](const FreeRect& fr) {
            return fr.x >= new_fr.x && fr.y >= new_fr.y &&
                   fr.x + fr.w <= new_fr.x + new_fr.w &&
                   fr.y + fr.h <= new_fr.y + new_fr.h;
        }),
        free_rects.end()
    );
    if ((int)free_rects.size() < free_list_cap) {
        free_rects.push_back(new_fr);
    } else {
        int min_idx = -1;
        int min_area = new_fr.w * new_fr.h;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < free_rects.size(); ++i) {
            int area = free_rects[i].w * free_rects[i].h;
            if (area < min_area) {
                min_area = area;
                min_idx = i;
            }
        }
        if (min_idx != -1) {
            free_rects[min_idx] = new_fr;
        }
    }
}

void register_placement_in_free_list(std::vector<FreeRect>& free_rects, const FreeRect& R, int free_list_cap) {
    std::vector<FreeRect> candidates;
    bool any_intersection = false;
    for (const auto& fr : free_rects) {
        if (R.x < fr.x + fr.w && R.x + R.w > fr.x &&
            R.y < fr.y + fr.h && R.y + R.h > fr.y) {
            any_intersection = true;
            if (R.x > fr.x) candidates.push_back({fr.x, fr.y, R.x - fr.x, fr.h});
            if (R.x + R.w < fr.x + fr.w) candidates.push_back({R.x + R.w, fr.y, fr.x + fr.w - (R.x + R.w), fr.h});
            if (R.y > fr.y) candidates.push_back({fr.x, fr.y, fr.w, R.y - fr.y});
            if (R.y + R.h < fr.y + fr.h) candidates.push_back({fr.x, R.y + R.h, fr.w, fr.y + fr.h - (R.y + R.h)});
        } else {
            candidates.push_back(fr);
        }
    }
    if (!any_intersection) return;
    free_rects.clear();
    for (const auto& cand : candidates) {
        add_free_rect(free_rects, cand, free_list_cap);
    }
}

PlacementOption find_best_placement(
    int rw, int rh,
    const std::vector<SkylineSegment>& segments,
    const std::vector<FreeRect>& free_rects,
    int board_width, int board_height,
    double alpha
) {
    PlacementOption best_opt;
    int num_rotations = (rw == rh) ? 1 : 2;
    for (int rot = 0; rot < num_rotations; ++rot) {
        int w = (rot == 0) ? rw : rh;
        int h = (rot == 0) ? rh : rw;
        if (w > board_width || h > board_height) continue;
        
        for (size_t f = 0; f < free_rects.size(); ++f) {
            const auto& fr = free_rects[f];
            if (fr.w >= w && fr.h >= h) {
                double score = (fr.y + h) + 0.1 * std::min(fr.w - w, fr.h - h);
                if (score < best_opt.score) {
                    best_opt.valid = true;
                    best_opt.from_free_list = true;
                    best_opt.free_list_idx = f;
                    best_opt.x = fr.x;
                    best_opt.y = fr.y;
                    best_opt.rotated = rot;
                    best_opt.score = score;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (size_t i = 0; i < segments.size(); ++i) {
            int x = segments[i].x;
            if (x + w > board_width) continue;
            
            int y_max = 0;
            size_t curr_idx = i;
            while (curr_idx < segments.size() && segments[curr_idx].x < x + w) {
                y_max = std::max(y_max, segments[curr_idx].y);
                curr_idx++;
            }
            if (y_max + h > board_height) continue;
            
            double score;
            if (alpha == 0.0) {
                score = (y_max + h);
            } else {
                int waste_area = 0;
                curr_idx = i;
                while (curr_idx < segments.size() && segments[curr_idx].x < x + w) {
                    int seg_left = segments[curr_idx].x;
                    int seg_right = seg_left + segments[curr_idx].width;
                    int overlap_w = std::min(seg_right, x + w) - std::max(seg_left, x);
                    waste_area += (y_max - segments[curr_idx].y) * overlap_w;
                    curr_idx++;
                }
                score = (y_max + h) + alpha * waste_area;
            }
            
            if (score < best_opt.score) {
                best_opt.valid = true;
                best_opt.from_free_list = false;
                best_opt.free_list_idx = -1;
                best_opt.x = x;
                best_opt.y = y_max;
                best_opt.rotated = rot;
                best_opt.score = score;
            }
        }
    }
    return best_opt;
}

void place_on_skyline(
    std::vector<SkylineSegment>& segments,
    std::vector<FreeRect>& free_rects,
    int x, int y_max, int w, int h,
    int free_list_cap
) {
    int y_new = y_max + h;
    for (const auto& seg : segments) {
        if (seg.x + seg.width <= x || seg.x >= x + w) continue;
        if (seg.y < y_max) {
            int hole_x = std::max(seg.x, x);
            int hole_w = std::min(seg.x + seg.width, x + w) - hole_x;
            int hole_h = y_max - seg.y;
            add_free_rect(free_rects, {hole_x, seg.y, hole_w, hole_h}, free_list_cap);
        }
    }
    std::vector<SkylineSegment> new_segments;
    new_segments.reserve(segments.size() + 2);
    bool inserted = false;
    for (const auto& seg : segments) {
        if (seg.x + seg.width <= x) {
            new_segments.push_back(seg);
        } else if (seg.x >= x + w) {
            if (!inserted) {
                new_segments.push_back({x, y_new, w});
                inserted = true;
            }
            new_segments.push_back(seg);
        } else {
            if (seg.x < x) new_segments.push_back({seg.x, seg.y, x - seg.x});
            if (seg.x + seg.width > x + w) {
                if (!inserted) {
                    new_segments.push_back({x, y_new, w});
                    inserted = true;
                }
                new_segments.push_back({x + w, seg.y, seg.x + seg.width - (x + w)});
            }
        }
    }
    if (!inserted) new_segments.push_back({x, y_new, w});
    segments.clear();
    for (const auto& seg : new_segments) {
        if (segments.empty()) {
            segments.push_back(seg);
        } else {
            auto& prev = segments.back();
            if (prev.y == seg.y) prev.width += seg.width;
            else segments.push_back(seg);
        }
    }
}

Solution solve_single_config(
    const std::vector<Rectangle>& rects,
    int board_width, int board_height,
    double alpha,
    int free_list_cap
) {
    int N = rects.size();
    std::vector<bool> packed(N, false);
    std::vector<Placement> placements(N);
    int num_boards = 0;
    int unpacked_count = N;
    
    while (unpacked_count > 0) {
        int board_idx = num_boards++;
        std::vector<SkylineSegment> segments = {{0, 0, board_width}};
        std::vector<FreeRect> free_rects;
        int remaining_area = board_width * board_height;
        
        bool board_progress = true;
        bool packed_any_on_board = false;
        
        while (board_progress) {
            board_progress = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
                if (packed[i]) continue;
                if (remaining_area < rects[i].area) continue;
                
                PlacementOption opt = find_best_placement(
                    rects[i].w, rects[i].h,
                    segments, free_rects,
                    board_width, board_height,
                    alpha
                );
                if (opt.valid) {
                    int w = (opt.rotated == 0) ? rects[i].w : rects[i].h;
                    int h = (opt.rotated == 0) ? rects[i].h : rects[i].w;
                    if (opt.from_free_list) {
                        register_placement_in_free_list(free_rects, {opt.x, opt.y, w, h}, free_list_cap);
                    } else {
                        place_on_skyline(segments, free_rects, opt.x, opt.y, w, h, free_list_cap);
                    }
                    packed[i] = true;
                    unpacked_count--;
                    remaining_area -= rects[i].area;
                    board_progress = true;
                    packed_any_on_board = true;
                    placements[rects[i].id] = {rects[i].id, board_idx, opt.x, opt.y, opt.rotated};
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (!packed_any_on_board) {
            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
                if (!packed[i]) {
                    packed[i] = true;
                    unpacked_count--;
                    placements[rects[i].id] = {rects[i].id, board_idx, 0, 0, 0};
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return {num_boards, placements};
}

int main() {
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(NULL);
    
    int N, bw, bh;
    if (!(std::cin >> N >> bw >> bh)) return 0;
    
    std::vector<Rectangle> rects(N);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        rects[i].id = i;
        std::cin >> rects[i].w >> rects[i].h;
        rects[i].area = rects[i].w * rects[i].h;
    }
    
    if (N == 0) {
        std::cout << "0\n";
        return 0;
    }
    
    auto comp_area = [](const Rectangle& a, const Rectangle& b) {
        if (a.area != b.area) return a.area > b.area;
        return a.id < b.id;
    };
    
    auto comp_max_dim = [](const Rectangle& a, const Rectangle& b) {
        int ma = std::max(a.w, a.h);
        int mb = std::max(b.w, b.h);
        if (ma != mb) return ma > mb;
        int mia = std::min(a.w, a.h);
        int mib = std::min(b.w, b.h);
        if (mia != mib) return mia > mib;
        return a.id < b.id;
    };
    
    auto comp_perimeter = [](const Rectangle& a, const Rectangle& b) {
        int pa = a.w + a.h;
        int pb = b.w + b.h;
        if (pa != pb) return pa > pb;
        return a.id < b.id;
    };

    auto comp_height = [](const Rectangle& a, const Rectangle& b) {
        if (a.h != b.h) return a.h > b.h;
        if (a.w != b.w) return a.w > b.w;
        return a.id < b.id;
    };

    auto comp_width = [](const Rectangle& a, const Rectangle& b) {
        if (a.w != b.w) return a.w > b.w;
        if (a.h != b.h) return a.h > b.h;
        return a.id < b.id;
    };

    auto comp_min_dim = [](const Rectangle& a, const Rectangle& b) {
        int mia = std::min(a.w, a.h);
        int mib = std::min(b.w, b.h);
        if (mia != mib) return mia > mib;
        int ma = std::max(a.w, a.h);
        int mb = std::max(b.w, b.h);
        if (ma != mb) return ma > mb;
        return a.id < b.id;
    };

    auto comp_ratio = [](const Rectangle& a, const Rectangle& b) {
        double ra = (double)std::max(a.w, a.h) / std::min(a.w, a.h);
        double rb = (double)std::max(b.w, b.h) / std::min(b.w, b.h);
        if (std::abs(ra - rb) > 1e-5) return ra > rb;
        if (a.area != b.area) return a.area > b.area;
        return a.id < b.id;
    };

    struct ThreadConfig {
        std::vector<Rectangle> sorted_rects;
        double alpha;
        int free_list_cap;
    };

    std::vector<ThreadConfig> configs;
    auto add_config = [&](auto comp, double alpha, int cap) {
        std::vector<Rectangle> temp = rects;
        std::sort(temp.begin(), temp.end(), comp);
        configs.push_back({std::move(temp), alpha, cap});
    };

    add_config(comp_max_dim, 0.0, 150);
    add_config(comp_max_dim, 0.5, 150);
    add_config(comp_max_dim, 0.0, 300);
    add_config(comp_max_dim, 0.5, 300);
    
    add_config(comp_area, 0.0, 150);
    add_config(comp_area, 0.5, 150);
    add_config(comp_area, 0.0, 300);
    add_config(comp_area, 0.5, 300);
    
    add_config(comp_perimeter, 0.0, 150);
    add_config(comp_perimeter, 0.5, 150);
    add_config(comp_perimeter, 0.0, 300);
    add_config(comp_perimeter, 0.5, 300);
    
    add_config(comp_height, 0.0, 150);
    add_config(comp_height, 0.5, 150);
    
    add_config(comp_width, 0.0, 150);
    add_config(comp_width, 0.5, 150);
    
    add_config(comp_min_dim, 0.0, 150);
    add_config(comp_min_dim, 0.5, 150);
    
    add_config(comp_ratio, 0.0, 150);
    add_config(comp_ratio, 0.5, 150);

    std::vector<std::thread> threads;
    std::mutex result_mutex;
    Solution best_sol;
    best_sol.num_boards = 1e9;

    for (const auto& config : configs) {
        threads.emplace_back([&, config]() {
            Solution sol = solve_single_config(config.sorted_rects, bw, bh, config.alpha, config.free_list_cap);
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(result_mutex);
            if (sol.num_boards < best_sol.num_boards) {
                best_sol = std::move(sol);
            }
        });
    }

    for (auto& t : threads) {
        t.join();
    }

    std::cout << best_sol.num_boards << "\n";
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        std::cout << best_sol.placements[i].board_idx << " "
                  << best_sol.placements[i].x << " "
                  << best_sol.placements[i].y << " "
                  << best_sol.placements[i].rotated << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

use std::f64::consts::PI;
use std::io::{self, Read};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct Point {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
}

impl std::ops::Sub for Point {
    type Output = Point;
    fn sub(self, other: Point) -> Point {
        Point { x: self.x - other.x, y: self.y - other.y }
    }
}

impl std::ops::Add for Point {
    type Output = Point;
    fn add(self, other: Point) -> Point {
        Point { x: self.x + other.x, y: self.y + other.y }
    }
}

fn ccw(a: Point, b: Point, c: Point) -> f64 {
    (b.x - a.x) * (c.y - a.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - a.x)
}

fn segments_strictly_intersect(a: Point, b: Point, c: Point, d: Point) -> bool {
    let cp1 = ccw(a, b, c);
    let cp2 = ccw(a, b, d);
    let cp3 = ccw(c, d, a);
    let cp4 = ccw(c, d, b);
    
    let epsilon = 1e-9;
    let cross1 = (cp1 > epsilon && cp2 < -epsilon) || (cp1 < -epsilon && cp2 > epsilon);
    let cross2 = (cp3 > epsilon && cp4 < -epsilon) || (cp3 < -epsilon && cp4 > epsilon);
    cross1 && cross2
}

fn point_on_segment(p: Point, a: Point, b: Point) -> bool {
    let epsilon = 1e-9;
    if ccw(a, b, p).abs() > epsilon {
        return false;
    }
    let min_x = a.x.min(b.x) - epsilon;
    let max_x = a.x.max(b.x) + epsilon;
    let min_y = a.y.min(b.y) - epsilon;
    let max_y = a.y.max(b.y) + epsilon;
    p.x >= min_x && p.x <= max_x && p.y >= min_y && p.y <= max_y
}

fn point_strictly_in_polygon(p: Point, poly: &[Point]) -> bool {
    let n = poly.len();
    for i in 0..n {
        let a = poly[i];
        let b = poly[(i + 1) % n];
        if point_on_segment(p, a, b) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    let mut inside = false;
    for i in 0..n {
        let j = (i + 1) % n;
        let pi = poly[i];
        let pj = poly[j];
        if ((pi.y > p.y) != (pj.y > p.y)) &&
           (p.x < (pj.x - pi.x) * (p.y - pi.y) / (pj.y - pi.y) + pi.x) {
            inside = !inside;
        }
    }
    inside
}

fn point_in_or_on_polygon(p: Point, poly: &[Point]) -> bool {
    let n = poly.len();
    for i in 0..n {
        let a = poly[i];
        let b = poly[(i + 1) % n];
        if point_on_segment(p, a, b) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    
    let mut inside = false;
    for i in 0..n {
        let j = (i + 1) % n;
        let pi = poly[i];
        let pj = poly[j];
        if ((pi.y > p.y) != (pj.y > p.y)) &&
           (p.x < (pj.x - pi.x) * (p.y - pi.y) / (pj.y - pi.y) + pi.x) {
            inside = !inside;
        }
    }
    inside
}

fn compute_area(poly: &[Point]) -> f64 {
    let mut area = 0.0;
    let n = poly.len();
    for i in 0..n {
        let p1 = poly[i];
        let p2 = poly[(i + 1) % n];
        area += p1.x * p2.y - p2.x * p1.y;
    }
    (area * 0.5).abs()
}

fn compute_centroid(poly: &[Point]) -> Point {
    let mut cx = 0.0;
    let mut cy = 0.0;
    let mut area = 0.0;
    let n = poly.len();
    for i in 0..n {
        let p1 = poly[i];
        let p2 = poly[(i + 1) % n];
        let factor = p1.x * p2.y - p2.x * p1.y;
        cx += (p1.x + p2.x) * factor;
        cy += (p1.y + p2.y) * factor;
        area += factor;
    }
    area *= 0.5;
    if area.abs() > 1e-9 {
        Point {
            x: cx / (6.0 * area),
            y: cy / (6.0 * area),
        }
    } else {
        let mut sx = 0.0;
        let mut sy = 0.0;
        for p in poly {
            sx += p.x;
            sy += p.y;
        }
        Point { x: sx / n as f64, y: sy / n as f64 }
    }
}

fn is_ccw(poly: &[Point]) -> bool {
    let mut area = 0.0;
    let n = poly.len();
    for i in 0..n {
        let p1 = poly[i];
        let p2 = poly[(i + 1) % n];
        area += p1.x * p2.y - p2.x * p1.y;
    }
    area > 0.0
}

fn point_in_triangle(p: Point, a: Point, b: Point, c: Point) -> bool {
    let s1 = ccw(a, b, p);
    let s2 = ccw(b, c, p);
    let s3 = ccw(c, a, p);
    let has_neg = (s1 < -1e-9) || (s2 < -1e-9) || (s3 < -1e-9);
    let has_pos = (s1 > 1e-9) || (s2 > 1e-9) || (s3 > 1e-9);
    !(has_neg && has_pos)
}

fn find_interior_point(poly: &[Point]) -> Point {
    let n = poly.len();
    if n == 3 {
        return Point {
            x: (poly[0].x + poly[1].x + poly[2].x) / 3.0,
            y: (poly[0].y + poly[1].y + poly[2].y) / 3.0,
        };
    }
    let ccw_oriented = is_ccw(poly);
    for i in 0..n {
        let prev = (i + n - 1) % n;
        let next = (i + 1) % n;
        let a = poly[prev];
        let b = poly[i];
        let c = poly[next];
        
        let val = ccw(a, b, c);
        let is_convex = if ccw_oriented { val > 1e-9 } else { val < -1e-9 };
        
        if is_convex {
            let mut is_ear = true;
            for j in 0..n {
                if j == prev || j == i || j == next {
                    continue;
                }
                if point_in_triangle(poly[j], a, b, c) {
                    is_ear = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if is_ear {
                return Point {
                    x: (a.x + b.x + c.x) / 3.0,
                    y: (a.y + b.y + c.y) / 3.0,
                };
            }
        }
    }
    let mut sx = 0.0;
    let mut sy = 0.0;
    for p in poly {
        sx += p.x;
        sy += p.y;
    }
    Point { x: sx / n as f64, y: sy / n as f64 }
}

fn get_bbox(poly: &[Point]) -> (f64, f64, f64, f64) {
    let mut xmin = poly[0].x;
    let mut xmax = poly[0].x;
    let mut ymin = poly[0].y;
    let mut ymax = poly[0].y;
    for &p in poly.iter().skip(1) {
        if p.x < xmin { xmin = p.x; }
        if p.x > xmax { xmax = p.x; }
        if p.y < ymin { ymin = p.y; }
        if p.y > ymax { ymax = p.y; }
    }
    (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
}

fn rotate_point(p: Point, angle: f64) -> Point {
    let cos_a = angle.cos();
    let sin_a = angle.sin();
    Point {
        x: p.x * cos_a - p.y * sin_a,
        y: p.x * sin_a + p.y * cos_a,
    }
}

fn rotate_polygon(poly: &[Point], angle: f64) -> Vec<Point> {
    let cos_a = angle.cos();
    let sin_a = angle.sin();
    poly.iter()
        .map(|p| Point {
            x: p.x * cos_a - p.y * sin_a,
            y: p.x * sin_a + p.y * cos_a,
        })
        .collect()
}

fn is_axis_aligned_rect(poly: &[Point]) -> bool {
    if poly.len() != 4 {
        return false;
    }
    for i in 0..4 {
        let p1 = poly[i];
        let p2 = poly[(i + 1) % 4];
        let dx = (p1.x - p2.x).abs();
        let dy = (p1.y - p2.y).abs();
        if dx > 1e-9 && dy > 1e-9 {
            return false;
        }
    }
    true
}

fn segments_intersect_any(p1: Point, p2: Point, poly: &[Point]) -> bool {
    let n = poly.len();
    for i in 0..n {
        let s1 = poly[i];
        let s2 = poly[(i + 1) % n];
        if segments_strictly_intersect(p1, p2, s1, s2) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    false
}

fn is_contained_in_stock(
    p: &[Point],
    ip: Point,
    stock: &[Point],
    stock_is_rect: bool,
    stock_bbox: (f64, f64, f64, f64),
) -> bool {
    if stock_is_rect {
        let (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax) = stock_bbox;
        let mut px_min = p[0].x;
        let mut px_max = p[0].x;
        let mut py_min = p[0].y;
        let mut py_max = p[0].y;
        for &pt in p.iter().skip(1) {
            if pt.x < px_min { px_min = pt.x; }
            if pt.x > px_max { px_max = pt.x; }
            if pt.y < py_min { py_min = pt.y; }
            if pt.y > py_max { py_max = pt.y; }
        }
        return px_min >= xmin - 1e-9 && px_max <= xmax + 1e-9 &&
               py_min >= ymin - 1e-9 && py_max <= ymax + 1e-9;
    }
    
    if !point_strictly_in_polygon(ip, stock) {
        return false;
    }
    
    for &pt in p {
        if !point_in_or_on_polygon(pt, stock) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    let n_p = p.len();
    for i in 0..n_p {
        let p1 = p[i];
        let p2 = p[(i + 1) % n_p];
        if segments_intersect_any(p1, p2, stock) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    true
}

fn polygons_overlap(
    a: &[Point],
    b: &[Point],
    ia: Point,
    ib: Point,
) -> bool {
    let n_a = a.len();
    for i in 0..n_a {
        let a1 = a[i];
        let a2 = a[(i + 1) % n_a];
        if segments_intersect_any(a1, a2, b) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    
    for &p in a {
        if point_strictly_in_polygon(p, b) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    
    for &p in b {
        if point_strictly_in_polygon(p, a) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    
    if point_strictly_in_polygon(ia, b) {
        return true;
    }
    
    if point_strictly_in_polygon(ib, a) {
        return true;
    }
    
    false
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct SpatialGrid {
    cell_size: f64,
    min_x: f64,
    min_y: f64,
    cols: usize,
    rows: usize,
    cells: Vec<Vec<usize>>,
}

impl SpatialGrid {
    fn new(min_x: f64, max_x: f64, min_y: f64, max_y: f64, num_cells_per_dim: usize) -> Self {
        let w = max_x - min_x;
        let h = max_y - min_y;
        let cell_size = (w.max(h) / num_cells_per_dim as f64).max(1e-5);
        let cols = ((w / cell_size).ceil() as usize).max(1);
        let rows = ((h / cell_size).ceil() as usize).max(1);
        Self {
            cell_size,
            min_x,
            min_y,
            cols,
            rows,
            cells: vec![Vec::new(); cols * rows],
        }
    }

    fn get_cell_range(&self, xmin: f64, xmax: f64, ymin: f64, ymax: f64) -> (usize, usize, usize, usize) {
        let col_min = (((xmin - self.min_x) / self.cell_size).floor() as isize).max(0) as usize;
        let col_max = (((xmax - self.min_x) / self.cell_size).floor() as isize).max(0) as usize;
        let col_max = col_max.min(self.cols - 1);
        let row_min = (((ymin - self.min_y) / self.cell_size).floor() as isize).max(0) as usize;
        let row_max = (((ymax - self.min_y) / self.cell_size).floor() as isize).max(0) as usize;
        let row_max = row_max.min(self.rows - 1);
        (col_min, col_max, row_min, row_max)
    }

    fn insert(&mut self, idx: usize, xmin: f64, xmax: f64, ymin: f64, ymax: f64) {
        let (col_min, col_max, row_min, row_max) = self.get_cell_range(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax);
        for r in row_min..=row_max {
            for c in col_min..=col_max {
                let cell_idx = r * self.cols + c;
                self.cells[cell_idx].push(idx);
            }
        }
    }

    fn query(&self, xmin: f64, xmax: f64, ymin: f64, ymax: f64, out: &mut Vec<usize>) {
        out.clear();
        let (col_min, col_max, row_min, row_max) = self.get_cell_range(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax);
        for r in row_min..=row_max {
            for c in col_min..=col_max {
                let cell_idx = r * self.cols + c;
                for &idx in &self.cells[cell_idx] {
                    out.push(idx);
                }
            }
        }
        out.sort_unstable();
        out.dedup();
    }
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
struct InputPiece {
    id: usize,
    vertices: Vec<Point>,
    area: f64,
    radius: f64,
    centroid: Point,
    interior_point: Point,
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
struct PlacedPiece {
    rotation: f64,
    translation: Point,
    vertices: Vec<Point>,
    centroid: Point,
    radius: f64,
    interior_point: Point,
}

struct Stock {
    placed_pieces: Vec<PlacedPiece>,
    grid: SpatialGrid,
}

fn get_anchors(stock_vertices: &[Point], placed: &[PlacedPiece], l: usize) -> Vec<Point> {
    let mut pool = Vec::new();
    for &p in stock_vertices {
        pool.push(p);
    }
    let start = if placed.len() > l { placed.len() - l } else { 0 };
    for p in &placed[start..] {
        for &pt in &p.vertices {
            pool.push(pt);
        }
    }
    pool.sort_unstable_by(|a, b| {
        a.y.partial_cmp(&b.y).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
            .then_with(|| a.x.partial_cmp(&b.x).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal))
    });
    pool.dedup_by(|a, b| (a.x - b.x).abs() < 1e-5 && (a.y - b.y).abs() < 1e-5);
    pool
}

fn try_place_piece(
    piece: &InputPiece,
    stock: &Stock,
    stock_vertices: &[Point],
    stock_bbox: (f64, f64, f64, f64),
    stock_is_rect: bool,
    num_rotations: usize,
    max_anchors: usize,
    query_buf: &mut Vec<usize>,
) -> Option<(Point, f64)> {
    let anchors = get_anchors(stock_vertices, &stock.placed_pieces, max_anchors);
    
    let mut candidates = Vec::new();
    
    for r_idx in 0..num_rotations {
        let rotation = 2.0 * PI * (r_idx as f64) / (num_rotations as f64);
        let rotated_vertices = rotate_polygon(&piece.vertices, rotation);
        let (dx_min, dx_max, dy_min, dy_max) = get_bbox(&rotated_vertices);
        let interior_point = rotate_point(piece.interior_point, rotation);
        let rotated_centroid = rotate_point(piece.centroid, rotation);
        
        // 1. Anchor-based candidates
        for &anchor in &anchors {
            for &v in &rotated_vertices {
                let translation = anchor - v;
                let px_min = translation.x + dx_min;
                let px_max = translation.x + dx_max;
                let py_min = translation.y + dy_min;
                let py_max = translation.y + dy_max;
                
                if px_min < stock_bbox.0 - 1e-9 || px_max > stock_bbox.1 + 1e-9 ||
                   py_min < stock_bbox.2 - 1e-9 || py_max > stock_bbox.3 + 1e-9 {
                    continue;
                }
                
                let score = py_max;
                candidates.push((translation, rotation, score, rotated_vertices.clone(), interior_point, rotated_centroid));
            }
        }
        
        // 2. Fallbacks for empty/packed stocks (centroid and bbox alignments)
        if stock.placed_pieces.is_empty() {
            let stock_centroid = compute_centroid(stock_vertices);
            let translation = stock_centroid - rotated_centroid;
            let px_min = translation.x + dx_min;
            let px_max = translation.x + dx_max;
            let py_min = translation.y + dy_min;
            let py_max = translation.y + dy_max;
            if px_min >= stock_bbox.0 - 1e-9 && px_max <= stock_bbox.1 + 1e-9 &&
               py_min >= stock_bbox.2 - 1e-9 && py_max <= stock_bbox.3 + 1e-9 {
                candidates.push((translation, rotation, py_max, rotated_vertices.clone(), interior_point, rotated_centroid));
            }
        }
    }
    
    candidates.sort_unstable_by(|a, b| a.2.partial_cmp(&b.2).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));
    
    for (translation, rotation, _, rotated_vertices, interior_point, rotated_centroid) in candidates {
        let placed_vertices: Vec<Point> = rotated_vertices.iter().map(|&v| v + translation).collect();
        let placed_interior = interior_point + translation;
        let placed_centroid = rotated_centroid + translation;
        
        if !is_contained_in_stock(&placed_vertices, placed_interior, stock_vertices, stock_is_rect, stock_bbox) {
            continue;
        }
        
        let (px_min, px_max, py_min, py_max) = get_bbox(&placed_vertices);
        stock.grid.query(px_min, px_max, py_min, py_max, query_buf);
        
        let mut overlap = false;
        for &idx in query_buf.iter() {
            let other = &stock.placed_pieces[idx];
            
            let dist_sq = (placed_centroid.x - other.centroid.x).powi(2) +
                          (placed_centroid.y - other.centroid.y).powi(2);
            let r_sum = piece.radius + other.radius;
            if dist_sq > r_sum.powi(2) + 1e-9 {
                continue;
            }
            
            if polygons_overlap(&placed_vertices, &other.vertices, placed_interior, other.interior_point) {
                overlap = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        
        if !overlap {
            return Some((translation, rotation));
        }
    }
    
    None
}

fn main() -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut input = String::new();
    io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input)?;
    let mut tokens = input.split_whitespace();
    
    let sv_str = match tokens.next() {
        Some(s) => s,
        None => return Ok(()),
    };
    let sv: usize = sv_str.parse().unwrap();
    let np: usize = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
    
    let mut stock_vertices = Vec::with_capacity(sv);
    for _ in 0..sv {
        let x: f64 = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        let y: f64 = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        stock_vertices.push(Point { x, y });
    }
    
    let stock_bbox = get_bbox(&stock_vertices);
    let stock_is_rect = is_axis_aligned_rect(&stock_vertices);
    
    let mut pieces = Vec::with_capacity(np);
    for i in 0..np {
        let pv: usize = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        let mut vertices = Vec::with_capacity(pv);
        for _ in 0..pv {
            let x: f64 = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
            let y: f64 = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
            vertices.push(Point { x, y });
        }
        
        let area = compute_area(&vertices);
        let centroid = compute_centroid(&vertices);
        
        let mut max_dist_sq = 0.0;
        for &p in &vertices {
            let dist_sq = (p.x - centroid.x).powi(2) + (p.y - centroid.y).powi(2);
            if dist_sq > max_dist_sq {
                max_dist_sq = dist_sq;
            }
        }
        let radius = max_dist_sq.sqrt();
        let interior_point = find_interior_point(&vertices);
        
        pieces.push(InputPiece {
            id: i,
            vertices,
            area,
            radius,
            centroid,
            interior_point,
        });
    }
    
    let mut sorted_pieces: Vec<usize> = (0..np).collect();
    sorted_pieces.sort_by(|&a, &b| {
        pieces[b].area.partial_cmp(&pieces[a].area).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
    });
    
    // Multi-tier configurations
    let num_rotations;
    let max_anchors;
    let grid_size;
    let max_stock_search;
    
    if np <= 50 {
        num_rotations = 16;
        max_anchors = 100;
        grid_size = 50;
        max_stock_search = 50;
    } else if np <= 500 {
        num_rotations = 8;
        max_anchors = 50;
        grid_size = 50;
        max_stock_search = 50;
    } else if np <= 2000 {
        num_rotations = 4;
        max_anchors = 20;
        grid_size = 80;
        max_stock_search = 15;
    } else {
        num_rotations = 2;
        max_anchors = 10;
        grid_size = 100;
        max_stock_search = 5;
    }
    
    let mut stocks: Vec<Stock> = Vec::new();
    let mut results = vec![(0, Point { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 }, 0.0); np];
    let mut query_buf = Vec::new();
    
    for &piece_id in &sorted_pieces {
        let piece = &pieces[piece_id];
        let mut placed = false;
        
        let stock_search_start = if stocks.len() > max_stock_search {
            stocks.len() - max_stock_search
        } else {
            0
        };
        
        for stock_idx in (stock_search_start..stocks.len()).rev() {
            let stock = &mut stocks[stock_idx];
            if let Some((translation, rotation)) = try_place_piece(
                piece,
                stock,
                &stock_vertices,
                stock_bbox,
                stock_is_rect,
                num_rotations,
                max_anchors,
                &mut query_buf,
            ) {
                let rotated_vertices = rotate_polygon(&piece.vertices, rotation);
                let placed_vertices: Vec<Point> = rotated_vertices.iter().map(|&v| v + translation).collect();
                let centroid = rotate_point(piece.centroid, rotation) + translation;
                let interior_point = rotate_point(piece.interior_point, rotation) + translation;
                
                let placed_piece = PlacedPiece {
                    rotation,
                    translation,
                    vertices: placed_vertices.clone(),
                    centroid,
                    radius: piece.radius,
                    interior_point,
                };
                
                let (px_min, px_max, py_min, py_max) = get_bbox(&placed_vertices);
                stock.grid.insert(stock.placed_pieces.len(), px_min, px_max, py_min, py_max);
                stock.placed_pieces.push(placed_piece);
                
                results[piece_id] = (stock_idx, translation, rotation);
                placed = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        
        if !placed {
            let stock_idx = stocks.len();
            let mut grid = SpatialGrid::new(stock_bbox.0, stock_bbox.1, stock_bbox.2, stock_bbox.3, grid_size);
            
            let mut empty_stock = Stock {
                placed_pieces: Vec::new(),
                grid: grid.clone(),
            };
            
            let (translation, rotation) = try_place_piece(
                piece,
                &empty_stock,
                &stock_vertices,
                stock_bbox,
                stock_is_rect,
                num_rotations.max(8), // give empty stock slightly more rotations if needed
                max_anchors.max(20),
                &mut query_buf,
            ).expect("Piece must fit in empty stock!");
            
            let rotated_vertices = rotate_polygon(&piece.vertices, rotation);
            let placed_vertices: Vec<Point> = rotated_vertices.iter().map(|&v| v + translation).collect();
            let centroid = rotate_point(piece.centroid, rotation) + translation;
            let interior_point = rotate_point(piece.interior_point, rotation) + translation;
            
            let placed_piece = PlacedPiece {
                rotation,
                translation,
                vertices: placed_vertices.clone(),
                centroid,
                radius: piece.radius,
                interior_point,
            };
            
            let (px_min, px_max, py_min, py_max) = get_bbox(&placed_vertices);
            grid.insert(0, px_min, px_max, py_min, py_max);
            
            empty_stock.placed_pieces.push(placed_piece);
            empty_stock.grid = grid;
            
            stocks.push(empty_stock);
            results[piece_id] = (stock_idx, translation, rotation);
        }
    }
    
    println!("{}", stocks.len());
    for r in results {
        println!("{} {} {} {}", r.0, r.1.x, r.1.y, r.2);
    }
    
    Ok(())
}

use std::f64::consts::PI;
use std::io::{self, Read};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct Point {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
}

impl std::ops::Sub for Point {
    type Output = Point;
    fn sub(self, other: Point) -> Point {
        Point { x: self.x - other.x, y: self.y - other.y }
    }
}

impl std::ops::Add for Point {
    type Output = Point;
    fn add(self, other: Point) -> Point {
        Point { x: self.x + other.x, y: self.y + other.y }
    }
}

fn ccw(a: Point, b: Point, c: Point) -> f64 {
    (b.x - a.x) * (c.y - a.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - a.x)
}

fn segments_strictly_intersect(a: Point, b: Point, c: Point, d: Point) -> bool {
    let cp1 = ccw(a, b, c);
    let cp2 = ccw(a, b, d);
    let cp3 = ccw(c, d, a);
    let cp4 = ccw(c, d, b);
    
    let epsilon = 1e-9;
    let cross1 = (cp1 > epsilon && cp2 < -epsilon) || (cp1 < -epsilon && cp2 > epsilon);
    let cross2 = (cp3 > epsilon && cp4 < -epsilon) || (cp3 < -epsilon && cp4 > epsilon);
    cross1 && cross2
}

fn point_on_segment(p: Point, a: Point, b: Point) -> bool {
    let epsilon = 1e-9;
    if ccw(a, b, p).abs() > epsilon {
        return false;
    }
    let min_x = a.x.min(b.x) - epsilon;
    let max_x = a.x.max(b.x) + epsilon;
    let min_y = a.y.min(b.y) - epsilon;
    let max_y = a.y.max(b.y) + epsilon;
    p.x >= min_x && p.x <= max_x && p.y >= min_y && p.y <= max_y
}

fn point_strictly_in_polygon(p: Point, poly: &[Point]) -> bool {
    let n = poly.len();
    for i in 0..n {
        let a = poly[i];
        let b = poly[(i + 1) % n];
        if point_on_segment(p, a, b) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    let mut inside = false;
    for i in 0..n {
        let j = (i + 1) % n;
        let pi = poly[i];
        let pj = poly[j];
        if ((pi.y > p.y) != (pj.y > p.y)) &&
           (p.x < (pj.x - pi.x) * (p.y - pi.y) / (pj.y - pi.y) + pi.x) {
            inside = !inside;
        }
    }
    inside
}

fn point_in_or_on_polygon(p: Point, poly: &[Point]) -> bool {
    let n = poly.len();
    for i in 0..n {
        let a = poly[i];
        let b = poly[(i + 1) % n];
        if point_on_segment(p, a, b) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    
    let mut inside = false;
    for i in 0..n {
        let j = (i + 1) % n;
        let pi = poly[i];
        let pj = poly[j];
        if ((pi.y > p.y) != (pj.y > p.y)) &&
           (p.x < (pj.x - pi.x) * (p.y - pi.y) / (pj.y - pi.y) + pi.x) {
            inside = !inside;
        }
    }
    inside
}

fn compute_area(poly: &[Point]) -> f64 {
    let mut area = 0.0;
    let n = poly.len();
    for i in 0..n {
        let p1 = poly[i];
        let p2 = poly[(i + 1) % n];
        area += p1.x * p2.y - p2.x * p1.y;
    }
    (area * 0.5).abs()
}

fn compute_centroid(poly: &[Point]) -> Point {
    let mut cx = 0.0;
    let mut cy = 0.0;
    let mut area = 0.0;
    let n = poly.len();
    for i in 0..n {
        let p1 = poly[i];
        let p2 = poly[(i + 1) % n];
        let factor = p1.x * p2.y - p2.x * p1.y;
        cx += (p1.x + p2.x) * factor;
        cy += (p1.y + p2.y) * factor;
        area += factor;
    }
    area *= 0.5;
    if area.abs() > 1e-9 {
        Point {
            x: cx / (6.0 * area),
            y: cy / (6.0 * area),
        }
    } else {
        let mut sx = 0.0;
        let mut sy = 0.0;
        for p in poly {
            sx += p.x;
            sy += p.y;
        }
        Point { x: sx / n as f64, y: sy / n as f64 }
    }
}

fn is_ccw(poly: &[Point]) -> bool {
    let mut area = 0.0;
    let n = poly.len();
    for i in 0..n {
        let p1 = poly[i];
        let p2 = poly[(i + 1) % n];
        area += p1.x * p2.y - p2.x * p1.y;
    }
    area > 0.0
}

fn point_in_triangle(p: Point, a: Point, b: Point, c: Point) -> bool {
    let s1 = ccw(a, b, p);
    let s2 = ccw(b, c, p);
    let s3 = ccw(c, a, p);
    let has_neg = (s1 < -1e-9) || (s2 < -1e-9) || (s3 < -1e-9);
    let has_pos = (s1 > 1e-9) || (s2 > 1e-9) || (s3 > 1e-9);
    !(has_neg && has_pos)
}

fn find_interior_point(poly: &[Point]) -> Point {
    let n = poly.len();
    if n == 3 {
        return Point {
            x: (poly[0].x + poly[1].x + poly[2].x) / 3.0,
            y: (poly[0].y + poly[1].y + poly[2].y) / 3.0,
        };
    }
    let ccw_oriented = is_ccw(poly);
    for i in 0..n {
        let prev = (i + n - 1) % n;
        let next = (i + 1) % n;
        let a = poly[prev];
        let b = poly[i];
        let c = poly[next];
        
        let val = ccw(a, b, c);
        let is_convex = if ccw_oriented { val > 1e-9 } else { val < -1e-9 };
        
        if is_convex {
            let mut is_ear = true;
            for j in 0..n {
                if j == prev || j == i || j == next {
                    continue;
                }
                if point_in_triangle(poly[j], a, b, c) {
                    is_ear = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if is_ear {
                return Point {
                    x: (a.x + b.x + c.x) / 3.0,
                    y: (a.y + b.y + c.y) / 3.0,
                };
            }
        }
    }
    let mut sx = 0.0;
    let mut sy = 0.0;
    for p in poly {
        sx += p.x;
        sy += p.y;
    }
    Point { x: sx / n as f64, y: sy / n as f64 }
}

fn get_bbox(poly: &[Point]) -> (f64, f64, f64, f64) {
    let mut xmin = poly[0].x;
    let mut xmax = poly[0].x;
    let mut ymin = poly[0].y;
    let mut ymax = poly[0].y;
    for &p in poly.iter().skip(1) {
        if p.x < xmin { xmin = p.x; }
        if p.x > xmax { xmax = p.x; }
        if p.y < ymin { ymin = p.y; }
        if p.y > ymax { ymax = p.y; }
    }
    (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
}

fn rotate_point(p: Point, angle: f64) -> Point {
    let cos_a = angle.cos();
    let sin_a = angle.sin();
    Point {
        x: p.x * cos_a - p.y * sin_a,
        y: p.x * sin_a + p.y * cos_a,
    }
}

fn rotate_polygon(poly: &[Point], angle: f64) -> Vec<Point> {
    let cos_a = angle.cos();
    let sin_a = angle.sin();
    poly.iter()
        .map(|p| Point {
            x: p.x * cos_a - p.y * sin_a,
            y: p.x * sin_a + p.y * cos_a,
        })
        .collect()
}

fn is_axis_aligned_rect(poly: &[Point]) -> bool {
    if poly.len() != 4 {
        return false;
    }
    for i in 0..4 {
        let p1 = poly[i];
        let p2 = poly[(i + 1) % 4];
        let dx = (p1.x - p2.x).abs();
        let dy = (p1.y - p2.y).abs();
        if dx > 1e-9 && dy > 1e-9 {
            return false;
        }
    }
    true
}

fn segments_intersect_any(p1: Point, p2: Point, poly: &[Point]) -> bool {
    let n = poly.len();
    for i in 0..n {
        let s1 = poly[i];
        let s2 = poly[(i + 1) % n];
        if segments_strictly_intersect(p1, p2, s1, s2) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    false
}

fn is_contained_in_stock(
    p: &[Point],
    ip: Point,
    stock: &[Point],
    stock_is_rect: bool,
    stock_bbox: (f64, f64, f64, f64),
) -> bool {
    if stock_is_rect {
        let (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax) = stock_bbox;
        let mut px_min = p[0].x;
        let mut px_max = p[0].x;
        let mut py_min = p[0].y;
        let mut py_max = p[0].y;
        for &pt in p.iter().skip(1) {
            if pt.x < px_min { px_min = pt.x; }
            if pt.x > px_max { px_max = pt.x; }
            if pt.y < py_min { py_min = pt.y; }
            if pt.y > py_max { py_max = pt.y; }
        }
        return px_min >= xmin - 1e-9 && px_max <= xmax + 1e-9 &&
               py_min >= ymin - 1e-9 && py_max <= ymax + 1e-9;
    }
    
    if !point_strictly_in_polygon(ip, stock) {
        return false;
    }
    
    for &pt in p {
        if !point_in_or_on_polygon(pt, stock) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    let n_p = p.len();
    for i in 0..n_p {
        let p1 = p[i];
        let p2 = p[(i + 1) % n_p];
        if segments_intersect_any(p1, p2, stock) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    true
}

fn polygons_overlap(
    a: &[Point],
    b: &[Point],
    ia: Point,
    ib: Point,
) -> bool {
    let n_a = a.len();
    for i in 0..n_a {
        let a1 = a[i];
        let a2 = a[(i + 1) % n_a];
        if segments_intersect_any(a1, a2, b) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    
    for &p in a {
        if point_strictly_in_polygon(p, b) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    
    for &p in b {
        if point_strictly_in_polygon(p, a) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    
    if point_strictly_in_polygon(ia, b) {
        return true;
    }
    
    if point_strictly_in_polygon(ib, a) {
        return true;
    }
    
    false
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct SpatialGrid {
    cell_size: f64,
    min_x: f64,
    min_y: f64,
    cols: usize,
    rows: usize,
    cells: Vec<Vec<usize>>,
}

impl SpatialGrid {
    fn new(min_x: f64, max_x: f64, min_y: f64, max_y: f64, num_cells_per_dim: usize) -> Self {
        let w = max_x - min_x;
        let h = max_y - min_y;
        let cell_size = (w.max(h) / num_cells_per_dim as f64).max(1e-5);
        let cols = ((w / cell_size).ceil() as usize).max(1);
        let rows = ((h / cell_size).ceil() as usize).max(1);
        Self {
            cell_size,
            min_x,
            min_y,
            cols,
            rows,
            cells: vec![Vec::new(); cols * rows],
        }
    }

    fn get_cell_range(&self, xmin: f64, xmax: f64, ymin: f64, ymax: f64) -> (usize, usize, usize, usize) {
        let col_min = (((xmin - self.min_x) / self.cell_size).floor() as isize).max(0) as usize;
        let col_max = (((xmax - self.min_x) / self.cell_size).floor() as isize).max(0) as usize;
        let col_max = col_max.min(self.cols - 1);
        let row_min = (((ymin - self.min_y) / self.cell_size).floor() as isize).max(0) as usize;
        let row_max = (((ymax - self.min_y) / self.cell_size).floor() as isize).max(0) as usize;
        let row_max = row_max.min(self.rows - 1);
        (col_min, col_max, row_min, row_max)
    }

    fn insert(&mut self, idx: usize, xmin: f64, xmax: f64, ymin: f64, ymax: f64) {
        let (col_min, col_max, row_min, row_max) = self.get_cell_range(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax);
        for r in row_min..=row_max {
            for c in col_min..=col_max {
                let cell_idx = r * self.cols + c;
                self.cells[cell_idx].push(idx);
            }
        }
    }

    fn query(&self, xmin: f64, xmax: f64, ymin: f64, ymax: f64, out: &mut Vec<usize>) {
        out.clear();
        let (col_min, col_max, row_min, row_max) = self.get_cell_range(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax);
        for r in row_min..=row_max {
            for c in col_min..=col_max {
                let cell_idx = r * self.cols + c;
                for &idx in &self.cells[cell_idx] {
                    out.push(idx);
                }
            }
        }
        out.sort_unstable();
        out.dedup();
    }
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
struct InputPiece {
    id: usize,
    vertices: Vec<Point>,
    area: f64,
    radius: f64,
    centroid: Point,
    interior_point: Point,
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
struct PlacedPiece {
    rotation: f64,
    translation: Point,
    vertices: Vec<Point>,
    centroid: Point,
    radius: f64,
    interior_point: Point,
}

struct Stock {
    placed_pieces: Vec<PlacedPiece>,
    grid: SpatialGrid,
}

fn get_anchors(stock_vertices: &[Point], placed: &[PlacedPiece], l: usize) -> Vec<Point> {
    let mut pool = Vec::new();
    for &p in stock_vertices {
        pool.push(p);
    }
    let start = if placed.len() > l { placed.len() - l } else { 0 };
    for p in &placed[start..] {
        for &pt in &p.vertices {
            pool.push(pt);
        }
    }
    pool.sort_unstable_by(|a, b| {
        a.y.partial_cmp(&b.y).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
            .then_with(|| a.x.partial_cmp(&b.x).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal))
    });
    pool.dedup_by(|a, b| (a.x - b.x).abs() < 1e-5 && (a.y - b.y).abs() < 1e-5);
    pool
}

fn try_place_piece(
    piece: &InputPiece,
    stock: &Stock,
    stock_vertices: &[Point],
    stock_bbox: (f64, f64, f64, f64),
    stock_is_rect: bool,
    num_rotations: usize,
    max_anchors: usize,
    query_buf: &mut Vec<usize>,
) -> Option<(Point, f64)> {
    let anchors = get_anchors(stock_vertices, &stock.placed_pieces, max_anchors);
    
    let mut candidates = Vec::new();
    
    for r_idx in 0..num_rotations {
        let rotation = 2.0 * PI * (r_idx as f64) / (num_rotations as f64);
        let rotated_vertices = rotate_polygon(&piece.vertices, rotation);
        let (dx_min, dx_max, dy_min, dy_max) = get_bbox(&rotated_vertices);
        let interior_point = rotate_point(piece.interior_point, rotation);
        let rotated_centroid = rotate_point(piece.centroid, rotation);
        
        // 1. Anchor-based candidates
        for &anchor in &anchors {
            for &v in &rotated_vertices {
                let translation = anchor - v;
                let px_min = translation.x + dx_min;
                let px_max = translation.x + dx_max;
                let py_min = translation.y + dy_min;
                let py_max = translation.y + dy_max;
                
                if px_min < stock_bbox.0 - 1e-9 || px_max > stock_bbox.1 + 1e-9 ||
                   py_min < stock_bbox.2 - 1e-9 || py_max > stock_bbox.3 + 1e-9 {
                    continue;
                }
                
                let score = py_max;
                candidates.push((translation, rotation, score, rotated_vertices.clone(), interior_point, rotated_centroid));
            }
        }
        
        // 2. Fallbacks for empty/packed stocks (centroid and bbox alignments)
        if stock.placed_pieces.is_empty() {
            let stock_centroid = compute_centroid(stock_vertices);
            let translation = stock_centroid - rotated_centroid;
            let px_min = translation.x + dx_min;
            let px_max = translation.x + dx_max;
            let py_min = translation.y + dy_min;
            let py_max = translation.y + dy_max;
            if px_min >= stock_bbox.0 - 1e-9 && px_max <= stock_bbox.1 + 1e-9 &&
               py_min >= stock_bbox.2 - 1e-9 && py_max <= stock_bbox.3 + 1e-9 {
                candidates.push((translation, rotation, py_max, rotated_vertices.clone(), interior_point, rotated_centroid));
            }
        }
    }
    
    candidates.sort_unstable_by(|a, b| a.2.partial_cmp(&b.2).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));
    
    for (translation, rotation, _, rotated_vertices, interior_point, rotated_centroid) in candidates {
        let placed_vertices: Vec<Point> = rotated_vertices.iter().map(|&v| v + translation).collect();
        let placed_interior = interior_point + translation;
        let placed_centroid = rotated_centroid + translation;
        
        if !is_contained_in_stock(&placed_vertices, placed_interior, stock_vertices, stock_is_rect, stock_bbox) {
            continue;
        }
        
        let (px_min, px_max, py_min, py_max) = get_bbox(&placed_vertices);
        stock.grid.query(px_min, px_max, py_min, py_max, query_buf);
        
        let mut overlap = false;
        for &idx in query_buf.iter() {
            let other = &stock.placed_pieces[idx];
            
            let dist_sq = (placed_centroid.x - other.centroid.x).powi(2) +
                          (placed_centroid.y - other.centroid.y).powi(2);
            let r_sum = piece.radius + other.radius;
            if dist_sq > r_sum.powi(2) + 1e-9 {
                continue;
            }
            
            if polygons_overlap(&placed_vertices, &other.vertices, placed_interior, other.interior_point) {
                overlap = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        
        if !overlap {
            return Some((translation, rotation));
        }
    }
    
    None
}

fn main() -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut input = String::new();
    io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input)?;
    let mut tokens = input.split_whitespace();
    
    let sv_str = match tokens.next() {
        Some(s) => s,
        None => return Ok(()),
    };
    let sv: usize = sv_str.parse().unwrap();
    let np: usize = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
    
    let mut stock_vertices = Vec::with_capacity(sv);
    for _ in 0..sv {
        let x: f64 = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        let y: f64 = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        stock_vertices.push(Point { x, y });
    }
    
    let stock_bbox = get_bbox(&stock_vertices);
    let stock_is_rect = is_axis_aligned_rect(&stock_vertices);
    
    let mut pieces = Vec::with_capacity(np);
    for i in 0..np {
        let pv: usize = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        let mut vertices = Vec::with_capacity(pv);
        for _ in 0..pv {
            let x: f64 = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
            let y: f64 = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
            vertices.push(Point { x, y });
        }
        
        let area = compute_area(&vertices);
        let centroid = compute_centroid(&vertices);
        
        let mut max_dist_sq = 0.0;
        for &p in &vertices {
            let dist_sq = (p.x - centroid.x).powi(2) + (p.y - centroid.y).powi(2);
            if dist_sq > max_dist_sq {
                max_dist_sq = dist_sq;
            }
        }
        let radius = max_dist_sq.sqrt();
        let interior_point = find_interior_point(&vertices);
        
        pieces.push(InputPiece {
            id: i,
            vertices,
            area,
            radius,
            centroid,
            interior_point,
        });
    }
    
    let mut sorted_pieces: Vec<usize> = (0..np).collect();
    sorted_pieces.sort_by(|&a, &b| {
        pieces[b].area.partial_cmp(&pieces[a].area).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
    });
    
    // Multi-tier configurations
    let num_rotations;
    let max_anchors;
    let grid_size;
    let max_stock_search;
    
    if np <= 50 {
        num_rotations = 16;
        max_anchors = 100;
        grid_size = 50;
        max_stock_search = 50;
    } else if np <= 500 {
        num_rotations = 8;
        max_anchors = 50;
        grid_size = 50;
        max_stock_search = 50;
    } else if np <= 2000 {
        num_rotations = 4;
        max_anchors = 20;
        grid_size = 80;
        max_stock_search = 15;
    } else {
        num_rotations = 2;
        max_anchors = 10;
        grid_size = 100;
        max_stock_search = 5;
    }
    
    let mut stocks: Vec<Stock> = Vec::new();
    let mut results = vec![(0, Point { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 }, 0.0); np];
    let mut query_buf = Vec::new();
    
    for &piece_id in &sorted_pieces {
        let piece = &pieces[piece_id];
        let mut placed = false;
        
        let stock_search_start = if stocks.len() > max_stock_search {
            stocks.len() - max_stock_search
        } else {
            0
        };
        
        for stock_idx in (stock_search_start..stocks.len()).rev() {
            let stock = &mut stocks[stock_idx];
            if let Some((translation, rotation)) = try_place_piece(
                piece,
                stock,
                &stock_vertices,
                stock_bbox,
                stock_is_rect,
                num_rotations,
                max_anchors,
                &mut query_buf,
            ) {
                let rotated_vertices = rotate_polygon(&piece.vertices, rotation);
                let placed_vertices: Vec<Point> = rotated_vertices.iter().map(|&v| v + translation).collect();
                let centroid = rotate_point(piece.centroid, rotation) + translation;
                let interior_point = rotate_point(piece.interior_point, rotation) + translation;
                
                let placed_piece = PlacedPiece {
                    rotation,
                    translation,
                    vertices: placed_vertices.clone(),
                    centroid,
                    radius: piece.radius,
                    interior_point,
                };
                
                let (px_min, px_max, py_min, py_max) = get_bbox(&placed_vertices);
                stock.grid.insert(stock.placed_pieces.len(), px_min, px_max, py_min, py_max);
                stock.placed_pieces.push(placed_piece);
                
                results[piece_id] = (stock_idx, translation, rotation);
                placed = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        
        if !placed {
            let stock_idx = stocks.len();
            let mut grid = SpatialGrid::new(stock_bbox.0, stock_bbox.1, stock_bbox.2, stock_bbox.3, grid_size);
            
            let mut empty_stock = Stock {
                placed_pieces: Vec::new(),
                grid: grid.clone(),
            };
            
            let (translation, rotation) = try_place_piece(
                piece,
                &empty_stock,
                &stock_vertices,
                stock_bbox,
                stock_is_rect,
                num_rotations.max(8), // give empty stock slightly more rotations if needed
                max_anchors.max(20),
                &mut query_buf,
            ).expect("Piece must fit in empty stock!");
            
            let rotated_vertices = rotate_polygon(&piece.vertices, rotation);
            let placed_vertices: Vec<Point> = rotated_vertices.iter().map(|&v| v + translation).collect();
            let centroid = rotate_point(piece.centroid, rotation) + translation;
            let interior_point = rotate_point(piece.interior_point, rotation) + translation;
            
            let placed_piece = PlacedPiece {
                rotation,
                translation,
                vertices: placed_vertices.clone(),
                centroid,
                radius: piece.radius,
                interior_point,
            };
            
            let (px_min, px_max, py_min, py_max) = get_bbox(&placed_vertices);
            grid.insert(0, px_min, px_max, py_min, py_max);
            
            empty_stock.placed_pieces.push(placed_piece);
            empty_stock.grid = grid;
            
            stocks.push(empty_stock);
            results[piece_id] = (stock_idx, translation, rotation);
        }
    }
    
    println!("{}", stocks.len());
    for r in results {
        println!("{} {} {} {}", r.0, r.1.x, r.1.y, r.2);
    }
    
    Ok(())
}

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

public enum HeuristicType
{
    DBL,
    CornerDistance,
    MinHeight
}

public struct Vector3D
{
    public double X;
    public double Y;
    public double Z;

    public Vector3D(double x, double y, double z)
    {
        X = x; Y = y; Z = z;
    }

    public static Vector3D operator +(Vector3D a, Vector3D b) => new Vector3D(a.X + b.X, a.Y + b.Y, a.Z + b.Z);
    public static Vector3D operator -(Vector3D a, Vector3D b) => new Vector3D(a.X - b.X, a.Y - b.Y, a.Z - b.Z);
    public static Vector3D operator *(Vector3D a, double b) => new Vector3D(a.X * b, a.Y * b, a.Z * b);

    public static double Dot(Vector3D a, Vector3D b) => a.X * b.X + a.Y * b.Y + a.Z * b.Z;
    public static Vector3D Cross(Vector3D a, Vector3D b) => new Vector3D(
        a.Y * b.Z - a.Z * b.Y,
        a.Z * b.X - a.X * b.Z,
        a.X * b.Y - a.Y * b.X
    );

    public double Length() => Math.Sqrt(X * X + Y * Y + Z * Z);
    public Vector3D Normalized()
    {
        double len = Length();
        if (len < 1e-9) return new Vector3D(0, 0, 0);
        return new Vector3D(X / len, Y / len, Z / len);
    }
}

public struct Quaternion
{
    public double W;
    public double X;
    public double Y;
    public double Z;

    public Quaternion(double w, double x, double y, double z)
    {
        W = w; X = x; Y = y; Z = z;
    }

    public static Quaternion Multiply(Quaternion a, Quaternion b)
    {
        return new Quaternion(
            a.W * b.W - a.X * b.X - a.Y * b.Y - a.Z * b.Z,
            a.W * b.X + a.X * b.W + a.Y * b.Z - a.Z * b.Y,
            a.W * b.Y - a.X * b.Z + a.Y * b.W + a.Z * b.X,
            a.W * b.Z + a.X * b.Y - a.Y * b.X + a.Z * b.W
        );
    }

    public Vector3D Rotate(Vector3D p)
    {
        Vector3D v = new Vector3D(X, Y, Z);
        Vector3D cross1 = Vector3D.Cross(v, p) + p * W;
        Vector3D cross2 = Vector3D.Cross(v, cross1);
        return p + cross2 * 2.0;
    }

    public Quaternion Normalized()
    {
        double len = Math.Sqrt(W * W + X * X + Y * Y + Z * Z);
        if (len < 1e-9) return new Quaternion(1, 0, 0, 0);
        return new Quaternion(W / len, X / len, Y / len, Z / len);
    }
}

public struct ExtremePoint : IEquatable<ExtremePoint>
{
    public int X;
    public int Y;
    public int Z;

    public ExtremePoint(int x, int y, int z) { X = x; Y = y; Z = z; }

    public bool Equals(ExtremePoint other) => X == other.X && Y == other.Y && Z == other.Z;
    public override int GetHashCode() => X ^ (Y << 10) ^ (Z << 20);
    public override bool Equals(object obj) => obj is ExtremePoint other && Equals(other);
}

public class VoxelShape
{
    public readonly int Width;
    public readonly int Height;
    public readonly int Depth;
    public readonly int MinCx;
    public readonly int MinCy;
    public readonly int MinCz;
    public readonly Quaternion Rotation;
    public readonly int[] VoxelOffsets;
    public readonly Vector3Int[] Voxels;

    public VoxelShape(int w, int h, int d, int minCx, int minCy, int minCz, Quaternion rot, Vector3Int[] voxels, int gridWidth, int gridHeight)
    {
        Width = w;
        Height = h;
        Depth = d;
        MinCx = minCx;
        MinCy = minCy;
        MinCz = minCz;
        Rotation = rot;
        Voxels = voxels;
        VoxelOffsets = new int[voxels.Length];
        for (int i = 0; i < voxels.Length; i++)
        {
            VoxelOffsets[i] = voxels[i].X + voxels[i].Y * gridWidth + voxels[i].Z * gridWidth * gridHeight;
        }
    }
}

public class VoxelGrid
{
    public readonly int Width;
    public readonly int Height;
    public readonly int Depth;
    public readonly byte[] Data;

    public VoxelGrid(int w, int h, int d)
    {
        Width = w;
        Height = h;
        Depth = d;
        Data = new byte[w * h * d];
    }

    public bool IsOccupied(int x, int y, int z)
    {
        return Data[x + y * Width + z * Width * Height] != 0;
    }

    public bool CanPlace(VoxelShape shape, int gx, int gy, int gz)
    {
        int baseIdx = gx + gy * Width + gz * Width * Height;
        var offsets = shape.VoxelOffsets;
        for (int i = 0; i < offsets.Length; i++)
        {
            if (Data[baseIdx + offsets[i]] != 0)
                return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public void Place(VoxelShape shape, int gx, int gy, int gz)
    {
        int baseIdx = gx + gy * Width + gz * Width * Height;
        var offsets = shape.VoxelOffsets;
        for (int i = 0; i < offsets.Length; i++)
        {
            Data[baseIdx + offsets[i]] = 1;
        }
    }
}
