}

public class Program
{
    public static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        // Set invariant culture
        Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentCulture = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
        Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;

        var stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        double timeLimitSeconds = 285.0; // 4 minutes 45 seconds

        // Parse input
        string line;
        int V = 0, F = 0;
        while ((line = Console.ReadLine()) != null)
        {
            line = line.Trim();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(line)) continue;
            var parts = line.Split((char[])null, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
            if (parts.Length >= 2)
            {
                V = int.Parse(parts[0]);
                F = int.Parse(parts[1]);
                break;
            }
        }

        var vertices = new Vector3D[V];
        for (int i = 0; i < V; i++)
        {
            while ((line = Console.ReadLine()) != null)
            {
                line = line.Trim();
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(line)) continue;
                var parts = line.Split((char[])null, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                vertices[i] = new Vector3D(
                    double.Parse(parts[0]),
                    double.Parse(parts[1]),
                    double.Parse(parts[2])
                );
                break;
            }
        }

        var faces = new int[F][];
        for (int i = 0; i < F; i++)
        {
            while ((line = Console.ReadLine()) != null)
            {
                line = line.Trim();
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(line)) continue;
                var parts = line.Split((char[])null, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                faces[i] = new int[] {
                    int.Parse(parts[0]),
                    int.Parse(parts[1]),
                    int.Parse(parts[2])
                };
                break;
            }
        }

        // Check if 1-indexed and convert if needed
        int minIndex = int.MaxValue;
        int maxIndex = int.MinValue;
        for (int i = 0; i < F; i++)
        {
            minIndex = Math.Min(minIndex, Math.Min(faces[i][0], Math.Min(faces[i][1], faces[i][2])));
            maxIndex = Math.Max(maxIndex, Math.Max(faces[i][0], Math.Max(faces[i][1], faces[i][2])));
        }
        if (minIndex == 1 || maxIndex == V)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < F; i++)
            {
                faces[i][0]--;
                faces[i][1]--;
                faces[i][2]--;
            }
        }

        double W = 0, H = 0, D = 0;
        while ((line = Console.ReadLine()) != null)
        {
            line = line.Trim();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(line)) continue;
            var parts = line.Split((char[])null, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
            W = double.Parse(parts[0]);
            H = double.Parse(parts[1]);
            D = double.Parse(parts[2]);
            break;
        }

        // Find initial bounding box of polyhedron
        double minX = vertices[0].X, maxX = vertices[0].X;
        double minY = vertices[0].Y, maxY = vertices[0].Y;
        double minZ = vertices[0].Z, maxZ = vertices[0].Z;
        for (int i = 1; i < V; i++)
        {
            minX = Math.Min(minX, vertices[i].X); maxX = Math.Max(maxX, vertices[i].X);
            minY = Math.Min(minY, vertices[i].Y); maxY = Math.Max(maxY, vertices[i].Y);
            minZ = Math.Min(minZ, vertices[i].Z); maxZ = Math.Max(maxZ, vertices[i].Z);
        }

        double pw = maxX - minX;
        double ph = maxY - minY;
        double pd = maxZ - minZ;
        double min_dim_p = Math.Min(pw, Math.Min(ph, pd));
        if (min_dim_p < 1e-5) min_dim_p = 1e-5;

        double V_p = pw * ph * pd;
        if (V_p < 1e-9) V_p = 1e-9;
        double V_c = W * H * D;

        // Generate rotations
        var rotations = GenerateRotations(vertices, faces);

        object lockObj = new object();
        int bestPackedCount = -1;
        List<PackedItem> bestPackedItems = null;
        double bestS = 0;

        int numThreads = Environment.ProcessorCount;
        if (numThreads < 1) numThreads = 1;

        Parallel.For(0, numThreads, threadId =>
        {
            var random = new Random(threadId ^ 1337);

            double baseS;
            int targetMaxItems = 30000;
            if (V_c / V_p > targetMaxItems)
            {
                baseS = Math.Pow(V_c / targetMaxItems, 1.0 / 3.0);
                baseS = Math.Max(baseS, min_dim_p);
            }
            else
            {
                baseS = min_dim_p;
                double max_container_dim = Math.Max(W, Math.Max(H, D));
                double max_grid_dim = 150.0;
                if (max_container_dim / baseS > max_grid_dim)
                {
                    baseS = max_container_dim / max_grid_dim;
                }
            }

            while (stopwatch.Elapsed.TotalSeconds < timeLimitSeconds)
            {
                double factor = 1.0;
                if (threadId > 0)
                {
                    factor = 0.8 + random.NextDouble() * 0.5; // [0.8, 1.3]
                }

                double S = baseS * factor;
                int G_W = (int)Math.Floor(W / S);
                int G_H = (int)Math.Floor(H / S);
                int G_D = (int)Math.Floor(D / S);

                if (G_W <= 0) G_W = 1;
                if (G_H <= 0) G_H = 1;
                if (G_D <= 0) G_D = 1;

                long gridCells = (long)G_W * G_H * G_D;
                if (gridCells > 12000000)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                // Voxelize for all unique rotations at this S
                var shapes = new List<VoxelShape>();
                foreach (var rot in rotations)
                {
                    var shape = Voxelize(vertices, faces, rot, S, G_W, G_H);
                    bool duplicate = false;
                    foreach (var existing in shapes)
                    {
                        if (ShapesAreIdentical(shape, existing))
                        {
                            duplicate = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (!duplicate)
                    {
                        shapes.Add(shape);
                    }
                }

                var heuristic = (HeuristicType)(random.Next(3));
                int k = random.Next(1, 4);

                var packed = RunPacking(G_W, G_H, G_D, shapes, heuristic, k, random, stopwatch, timeLimitSeconds);
                if (packed != null)
                {
                    lock (lockObj)
                    {
                        if (packed.Count > bestPackedCount)
                        {
                            bestPackedCount = packed.Count;
                            bestPackedItems = packed;
                            bestS = S;
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (V_c / V_p > 20000)
                {
                    break;
                }
            }
        });

        // Print output
        if (bestPackedItems != null)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(bestPackedItems.Count);
            foreach (var item in bestPackedItems)
            {
                double tx = (item.Gx - item.Shape.MinCx) * bestS;
                double ty = (item.Gy - item.Shape.MinCy) * bestS;
                double tz = (item.Gz - item.Shape.MinCz) * bestS;
                var q = item.Shape.Rotation;
                Console.WriteLine($"{tx:F6} {ty:F6} {tz:F6} {q.W:F6} {q.X:F6} {q.Y:F6} {q.Z:F6}");
            }
        }
        else
        {
            Console.WriteLine(0);
        }
    }

    private static List<Quaternion> GenerateRotations(Vector3D[] vertices, int[][] faces)
    {
        var list = new List<Quaternion>();
        var primaryAxes = new Vector3D[]
        {
            new Vector3D(1, 0, 0),
            new Vector3D(-1, 0, 0),
            new Vector3D(0, 1, 0),
            new Vector3D(0, -1, 0),
            new Vector3D(0, 0, 1),
            new Vector3D(0, 0, -1)
        };

        // 1. Add 24 standard orthogonal rotations
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
        {
            var vx = primaryAxes[i];
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++)
            {
                var vy = primaryAxes[j];
                if (Math.Abs(Vector3D.Dot(vx, vy)) < 1e-9)
                {
                    var vz = Vector3D.Cross(vx, vy);
                    var q = MatrixToQuaternion(vx, vy, vz);
                    list.Add(q);
                }
            }
        }

        // 2. Add face-aligned rotations
        var uniqueNormals = new List<Vector3D>();
        for (int f = 0; f < faces.Length; f++)
        {
            var face = faces[f];
            Vector3D a = vertices[face[0]];
            Vector3D b = vertices[face[1]];
            Vector3D c = vertices[face[2]];
            Vector3D normal = Vector3D.Cross(b - a, c - a).Normalized();

            if (normal.Length() > 0.1)
            {
                bool duplicate = false;
                foreach (var un in uniqueNormals)
                {
                    if (Math.Abs(Vector3D.Dot(normal, un)) > 0.99)
                    {
                        duplicate = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!duplicate)
                {
                    uniqueNormals.Add(normal);
                }
            }
        }

        foreach (var n in uniqueNormals)
        {
            foreach (var u in primaryAxes)
            {
                var qAlign = GetRotationToAlign(n, u);
                double[] angles = { 0, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI, 3 * Math.PI / 2 };
                foreach (var angle in angles)
                {
                    var qRot = new Quaternion(
                        Math.Cos(angle / 2.0),
                        u.X * Math.Sin(angle / 2.0),
                        u.Y * Math.Sin(angle / 2.0),
                        u.Z * Math.Sin(angle / 2.0)
                    );
                    var qCombined = Quaternion.Multiply(qRot, qAlign).Normalized();
                    list.Add(qCombined);
                }
            }
        }

        // Filter duplicates
        var uniqueRotations = new List<Quaternion>();
        foreach (var q in list)
        {
            bool duplicate = false;
            foreach (var uq in uniqueRotations)
            {
                double dot = q.W * uq.W + q.X * uq.X + q.Y * uq.Y + q.Z * uq.Z;
                if (Math.Abs(dot) > 0.9999)
                {
                    duplicate = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!duplicate)
            {
                uniqueRotations.Add(q);
            }
        }

        return uniqueRotations;
    }

    private static Quaternion MatrixToQuaternion(Vector3D vx, Vector3D vy, Vector3D vz)
    {
        double m00 = vx.X, m01 = vy.X, m02 = vz.X;
        double m10 = vx.Y, m11 = vy.Y, m12 = vz.Y;
        double m20 = vx.Z, m21 = vy.Z, m22 = vz.Z;

        double tr = m00 + m11 + m22;
        double qw, qx, qy, qz;

        if (tr > 0)
        {
            double S = Math.Sqrt(tr + 1.0) * 2.0;
            qw = 0.25 * S;
            qx = (m21 - m12) / S;
            qy = (m02 - m20) / S;
            qz = (m10 - m01) / S;
        }
        else if ((m00 > m11) && (m00 > m22))
        {
            double S = Math.Sqrt(1.0 + m00 - m11 - m22) * 2.0;
            qw = (m21 - m12) / S;
            qx = 0.25 * S;
            qy = (m01 + m10) / S;
            qz = (m02 + m20) / S;
        }
        else if (m11 > m22)
        {
            double S = Math.Sqrt(1.0 + m11 - m00 - m22) * 2.0;
            qw = (m02 - m20) / S;
            qx = (m01 + m10) / S;
            qy = 0.25 * S;
            qz = (m12 + m21) / S;
        }
        else
        {
            double S = Math.Sqrt(1.0 + m22 - m00 - m11) * 2.0;
            qw = (m10 - m01) / S;
            qx = (m02 + m20) / S;
            qy = (m12 + m21) / S;
            qz = 0.25 * S;
        }

        return new Quaternion(qw, qx, qy, qz).Normalized();
    }

    private static Quaternion GetRotationToAlign(Vector3D n, Vector3D u)
    {
        double d = Vector3D.Dot(n, u);
        if (d > 0.99999)
        {
            return new Quaternion(1, 0, 0, 0);
        }
        else if (d < -0.99999)
        {
            Vector3D p;
            if (Math.Abs(n.X) > 0.5) p = new Vector3D(-n.Y, n.X, 0).Normalized();
            else p = new Vector3D(0, -n.Z, n.Y).Normalized();
            return new Quaternion(0, p.X, p.Y, p.Z);
        }
        else
        {
            Vector3D v = Vector3D.Cross(n, u);
            return new Quaternion(d + 1, v.X, v.Y, v.Z).Normalized();
        }
    }

    private static VoxelShape Voxelize(Vector3D[] vertices, int[][] faces, Quaternion rot, double S, int gridWidth, int gridHeight)
    {
        var rotVertices = new Vector3D[vertices.Length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vertices.Length; i++)
        {
            rotVertices[i] = rot.Rotate(vertices[i]);
        }

        double minX = double.MaxValue, maxX = double.MinValue;
        double minY = double.MaxValue, maxY = double.MinValue;
        double minZ = double.MaxValue, maxZ = double.MinValue;
        foreach (var v in rotVertices)
        {
            minX = Math.Min(minX, v.X); maxX = Math.Max(maxX, v.X);
            minY = Math.Min(minY, v.Y); maxY = Math.Max(maxY, v.Y);
            minZ = Math.Min(minZ, v.Z); maxZ = Math.Max(maxZ, v.Z);
        }

        // Shrink slightly towards center to avoid boundary touching problems
        double cX = (minX + maxX) / 2.0;
        double cY = (minY + maxY) / 2.0;
        double cZ = (minZ + maxZ) / 2.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < rotVertices.Length; i++)
        {
            rotVertices[i] = new Vector3D(
                cX + (rotVertices[i].X - cX) * 0.9999,
                cY + (rotVertices[i].Y - cY) * 0.9999,
                cZ + (rotVertices[i].Z - cZ) * 0.9999
            );
        }

        // Recalculate bounding box on shrunken vertices
        minX = double.MaxValue; maxX = double.MinValue;
        minY = double.MaxValue; maxY = double.MinValue;
        minZ = double.MaxValue; maxZ = double.MinValue;
        foreach (var v in rotVertices)
        {
            minX = Math.Min(minX, v.X); maxX = Math.Max(maxX, v.X);
            minY = Math.Min(minY, v.Y); maxY = Math.Max(maxY, v.Y);
            minZ = Math.Min(minZ, v.Z); maxZ = Math.Max(maxZ, v.Z);
        }

        int minCx = (int)Math.Floor(minX / S);
        int maxCx = (int)Math.Floor(maxX / S);
        int minCy = (int)Math.Floor(minY / S);
        int maxCy = (int)Math.Floor(maxY / S);
        int minCz = (int)Math.Floor(minZ / S);
        int maxCz = (int)Math.Floor(maxZ / S);

        int width = maxCx - minCx + 1;
        int height = maxCy - minCy + 1;
        int depth = maxCz - minCz + 1;

        if (width <= 0) width = 1;
        if (height <= 0) height = 1;
        if (depth <= 0) depth = 1;

        bool[,,] occupied = new bool[width, height, depth];
        Vector3D boxHalfSize = new Vector3D(S / 2.0 + 1e-9, S / 2.0 + 1e-9, S / 2.0 + 1e-9);

        for (int f = 0; f < faces.Length; f++)
        {
            var face = faces[f];
            Vector3D a = rotVertices[face[0]];
            Vector3D b = rotVertices[face[1]];
            Vector3D c = rotVertices[face[2]];

            double fMinX = Math.Min(a.X, Math.Min(b.X, c.X));
            double fMaxX = Math.Max(a.X, Math.Max(b.X, c.X));
            double fMinY = Math.Min(a.Y, Math.Min(b.Y, c.Y));
            double fMaxY = Math.Max(a.Y, Math.Max(b.Y, c.Y));
            double fMinZ = Math.Min(a.Z, Math.Min(b.Z, c.Z));
            double fMaxZ = Math.Max(a.Z, Math.Max(b.Z, c.Z));

            int fMinCx = (int)Math.Floor(fMinX / S);
            int fMaxCx = (int)Math.Floor(fMaxX / S);
            int fMinCy = (int)Math.Floor(fMinY / S);
            int fMaxCy = (int)Math.Floor(fMaxY / S);
            int fMinCz = (int)Math.Floor(fMinZ / S);
            int fMaxCz = (int)Math.Floor(fMaxZ / S);

            fMinCx = Math.Max(fMinCx, minCx); fMaxCx = Math.Min(fMaxCx, maxCx);
            fMinCy = Math.Max(fMinCy, minCy); fMaxCy = Math.Min(fMaxCy, maxCy);
            fMinCz = Math.Max(fMinCz, minCz); fMaxCz = Math.Min(fMaxCz, maxCz);

            for (int cx = fMinCx; cx <= fMaxCx; cx++)
            {
                for (int cy = fMinCy; cy <= fMaxCy; cy++)
                {
                    for (int cz = fMinCz; cz <= fMaxCz; cz++)
                    {
                        int ix = cx - minCx;
                        int iy = cy - minCy;
                        int iz = cz - minCz;

                        if (occupied[ix, iy, iz]) continue;

                        Vector3D boxCenter = new Vector3D((cx + 0.5) * S, (cy + 0.5) * S, (cz + 0.5) * S);
                        if (TestTriangleBox(a, b, c, boxCenter, boxHalfSize))
                        {
                            occupied[ix, iy, iz] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        var intersections = new List<double>();
        for (int ix = 0; ix < width; ix++)
        {
            int cx = minCx + ix;
            double rx = (cx + 0.5) * S + 1e-9;

            for (int iy = 0; iy < height; iy++)
            {
                int cy = minCy + iy;
                double ry = (cy + 0.5) * S + 1e-9;

                intersections.Clear();

                for (int f = 0; f < faces.Length; f++)
                {
                    var face = faces[f];
                    Vector3D a = rotVertices[face[0]];
                    Vector3D b = rotVertices[face[1]];
                    Vector3D c = rotVertices[face[2]];

                    if (PointInTriangle2D(rx, ry, a, b, c))
                    {
                        Vector3D ab = b - a;
                        Vector3D ac = c - a;
                        Vector3D normal = Vector3D.Cross(ab, ac);
                        if (Math.Abs(normal.Z) > 1e-9)
                        {
                            double z = a.Z - (normal.X * (rx - a.X) + normal.Y * (ry - a.Y)) / normal.Z;
                            intersections.Add(z);
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (intersections.Count >= 2)
                {
                    intersections.Sort();
                    for (int k = 0; k < intersections.Count - 1; k += 2)
                    {
                        double zStart = intersections[k];
                        double zEnd = intersections[k + 1];

                        int czStart = (int)Math.Ceiling(zStart / S - 0.5);
                        int czEnd = (int)Math.Floor(zEnd / S - 0.5);

                        czStart = Math.Max(czStart, minCz);
                        czEnd = Math.Min(czEnd, maxCz);

                        for (int cz = czStart; cz <= czEnd; cz++)
                        {
                            int iz = cz - minCz;
                            occupied[ix, iy, iz] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        var voxels = new List<Vector3Int>();
        for (int ix = 0; ix < width; ix++)
        {
            for (int iy = 0; iy < height; iy++)
            {
                for (int iz = 0; iz < depth; iz++)
                {
                    if (occupied[ix, iy, iz])
                    {
                        voxels.Add(new Vector3Int(ix, iy, iz));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (voxels.Count == 0)
        {
            voxels.Add(new Vector3Int(0, 0, 0));
        }

        return new VoxelShape(width, height, depth, minCx, minCy, minCz, rot, voxels.ToArray(), gridWidth, gridHeight);
    }

    private static bool PointInTriangle2D(double px, double py, Vector3D a, Vector3D b, Vector3D c)
    {
        double sign1 = (b.X - a.X) * (py - a.Y) - (b.Y - a.Y) * (px - a.X);
        double sign2 = (c.X - b.X) * (py - b.Y) - (c.Y - b.Y) * (px - b.X);
        double sign3 = (a.X - c.X) * (py - c.Y) - (a.Y - c.Y) * (px - c.X);

        bool has_neg = (sign1 < 0) || (sign2 < 0) || (sign3 < 0);
        bool has_pos = (sign1 > 0) || (sign2 > 0) || (sign3 > 0);

        return !(has_neg && has_pos);
    }

    private static bool TestTriangleBox(Vector3D a, Vector3D b, Vector3D c, Vector3D boxCenter, Vector3D boxHalfSize)
    {
        Vector3D v0 = a - boxCenter;
        Vector3D v1 = b - boxCenter;
        Vector3D v2 = c - boxCenter;

        Vector3D e0 = v1 - v0;
        Vector3D e1 = v2 - v1;
        Vector3D e2 = v0 - v2;

        double r, p0, p1, p2, minP, maxP;

        // Test 1: Box normals
        minP = Math.Min(v0.X, Math.Min(v1.X, v2.X));
        maxP = Math.Max(v0.X, Math.Max(v1.X, v2.X));
        if (minP > boxHalfSize.X || maxP < -boxHalfSize.X) return false;

        minP = Math.Min(v0.Y, Math.Min(v1.Y, v2.Y));
        maxP = Math.Max(v0.Y, Math.Max(v1.Y, v2.Y));
        if (minP > boxHalfSize.Y || maxP < -boxHalfSize.Y) return false;

        minP = Math.Min(v0.Z, Math.Min(v1.Z, v2.Z));
        maxP = Math.Max(v0.Z, Math.Max(v1.Z, v2.Z));
        if (minP > boxHalfSize.Z || maxP < -boxHalfSize.Z) return false;

        // Test 2: Triangle normal
        Vector3D normal = Vector3D.Cross(e0, e1);
        r = boxHalfSize.X * Math.Abs(normal.X) + boxHalfSize.Y * Math.Abs(normal.Y) + boxHalfSize.Z * Math.Abs(normal.Z);
        double d = Vector3D.Dot(normal, v0);
        if (Math.Abs(d) > r) return false;

        // Test 3: 9 cross product axes
        // Axis: X x e0
        r = boxHalfSize.Y * Math.Abs(e0.Z) + boxHalfSize.Z * Math.Abs(e0.Y);
        p0 = -v0.Y * e0.Z + v0.Z * e0.Y;
        p2 = -v2.Y * e0.Z + v2.Z * e0.Y;
        if (Math.Min(p0, p2) > r || Math.Max(p0, p2) < -r) return false;

        // Axis: X x e1
        r = boxHalfSize.Y * Math.Abs(e1.Z) + boxHalfSize.Z * Math.Abs(e1.Y);
        p0 = -v0.Y * e1.Z + v0.Z * e1.Y;
        p1 = -v1.Y * e1.Z + v1.Z * e1.Y;
        if (Math.Min(p0, p1) > r || Math.Max(p0, p1) < -r) return false;

        // Axis: X x e2
        r = boxHalfSize.Y * Math.Abs(e2.Z) + boxHalfSize.Z * Math.Abs(e2.Y);
        p0 = -v0.Y * e2.Z + v0.Z * e2.Y;
        p1 = -v1.Y * e2.Z + v1.Z * e2.Y;
        if (Math.Min(p0, p1) > r || Math.Max(p0, p1) < -r) return false;

        // Axis: Y x e0
        r = boxHalfSize.X * Math.Abs(e0.Z) + boxHalfSize.Z * Math.Abs(e0.X);
        p0 = v0.X * e0.Z - v0.Z * e0.X;
        p2 = v2.X * e0.Z - v2.Z * e0.X;
        if (Math.Min(p0, p2) > r || Math.Max(p0, p2) < -r) return false;

        // Axis: Y x e1
        r = boxHalfSize.X * Math.Abs(e1.Z) + boxHalfSize.Z * Math.Abs(e1.X);
        p0 = v0.X * e1.Z - v0.Z * e1.X;
        p1 = v1.X * e1.Z - v1.Z * e1.X;
        if (Math.Min(p0, p1) > r || Math.Max(p0, p1) < -r) return false;

        // Axis: Y x e2
        r = boxHalfSize.X * Math.Abs(e2.Z) + boxHalfSize.Z * Math.Abs(e2.X);
        p0 = v0.X * e2.Z - v0.Z * e2.X;
        p1 = v1.X * e2.Z - v1.Z * e2.X;
        if (Math.Min(p0, p1) > r || Math.Max(p0, p1) < -r) return false;

        // Axis: Z x e0
        r = boxHalfSize.X * Math.Abs(e0.Y) + boxHalfSize.Y * Math.Abs(e0.X);
        p0 = -v0.X * e0.Y + v0.Y * e0.X;
        p2 = -v2.X * e0.Y + v2.Y * e0.X;
        if (Math.Min(p0, p2) > r || Math.Max(p0, p2) < -r) return false;

        // Axis: Z x e1
        r = boxHalfSize.X * Math.Abs(e1.Y) + boxHalfSize.Y * Math.Abs(e1.X);
        p0 = -v0.X * e1.Y + v0.Y * e1.X;
        p1 = -v1.X * e1.Y + v1.Y * e1.X;
        if (Math.Min(p0, p1) > r || Math.Max(p0, p1) < -r) return false;

        // Axis: Z x e2
        r = boxHalfSize.X * Math.Abs(e2.Y) + boxHalfSize.Y * Math.Abs(e2.X);
        p0 = -v0.X * e2.Y + v0.Y * e2.X;
        p1 = -v1.X * e2.Y + v1.Y * e2.X;
        if (Math.Min(p0, p1) > r || Math.Max(p0, p1) < -r) return false;

        return true;
    }

    private static bool ShapesAreIdentical(VoxelShape s1, VoxelShape s2)
    {
        if (s1.Width != s2.Width || s1.Height != s2.Height || s1.Depth != s2.Depth) return false;
        if (s1.Voxels.Length != s2.Voxels.Length) return false;
        for (int i = 0; i < s1.Voxels.Length; i++)
        {
            if (s1.Voxels[i].X != s2.Voxels[i].X ||
                s1.Voxels[i].Y != s2.Voxels[i].Y ||
                s1.Voxels[i].Z != s2.Voxels[i].Z)
            {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    private static List<PackedItem> RunPacking(
        int G_W, int G_H, int G_D,
        List<VoxelShape> shapes,
        HeuristicType heuristic,
        int k,
        Random random,
        Stopwatch stopwatch,
        double timeLimitSeconds)
    {
        var grid = new VoxelGrid(G_W, G_H, G_D);
        var eps = new List<ExtremePoint> { new ExtremePoint(0, 0, 0) };
        var packedItems = new List<PackedItem>();

        int currentMaxX = 0, currentMaxY = 0, currentMaxZ = 0;

        var candidates = new List<Candidate>();
        var validCandidates = new List<Candidate>();

        while (eps.Count > 0)
        {
            if (stopwatch.Elapsed.TotalSeconds >= timeLimitSeconds)
            {
                return null;
            }

            candidates.Clear();

            for (int i = 0; i < eps.Count; i++)
            {
                var ep = eps[i];
                for (int j = 0; j < shapes.Count; j++)
                {
                    var shape = shapes[j];
                    if (ep.X + shape.Width <= G_W &&
                        ep.Y + shape.Height <= G_H &&
                        ep.Z + shape.Depth <= G_D)
                    {
                        double score = ScorePlacement(ep.X, ep.Y, ep.Z, shape, heuristic, currentMaxX, currentMaxY, currentMaxZ);
                        candidates.Add(new Candidate(ep, shape, score));
                    }
                }
            }

            if (candidates.Count == 0) break;

            candidates.Sort((c1, c2) => c1.Score.CompareTo(c2.Score));

            Candidate chosen = null;
            if (k == 1)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < candidates.Count; i++)
                {
                    var c = candidates[i];
                    if (grid.CanPlace(c.Shape, c.EP.X, c.EP.Y, c.EP.Z))
                    {
                        chosen = c;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            else
            {
                validCandidates.Clear();
                for (int i = 0; i < candidates.Count; i++)
                {
                    var c = candidates[i];
                    if (grid.CanPlace(c.Shape, c.EP.X, c.EP.Y, c.EP.Z))
                    {
                        validCandidates.Add(c);
                        if (validCandidates.Count >= k) break;
                    }
                }

                if (validCandidates.Count > 0)
                {
                    int idx = random.Next(validCandidates.Count);
                    chosen = validCandidates[idx];
                }
            }

            if (chosen == null) break;

            grid.Place(chosen.Shape, chosen.EP.X, chosen.EP.Y, chosen.EP.Z);
            packedItems.Add(new PackedItem(chosen.EP.X, chosen.EP.Y, chosen.EP.Z, chosen.Shape));

            currentMaxX = Math.Max(currentMaxX, chosen.EP.X + chosen.Shape.Width);
            currentMaxY = Math.Max(currentMaxY, chosen.EP.Y + chosen.Shape.Height);
            currentMaxZ = Math.Max(currentMaxZ, chosen.EP.Z + chosen.Shape.Depth);

            int x1 = chosen.EP.X;
            int x2 = x1 + chosen.Shape.Width - 1;
            int y1 = chosen.EP.Y;
            int y2 = y1 + chosen.Shape.Height - 1;
            int z1 = chosen.EP.Z;
            int z2 = z1 + chosen.Shape.Depth - 1;

            var nextEps = new List<ExtremePoint>(eps.Count + 3);
            nextEps.Add(new ExtremePoint(x2 + 1, chosen.EP.Y, chosen.EP.Z));
            nextEps.Add(new ExtremePoint(chosen.EP.X, y2 + 1, chosen.EP.Z));
            nextEps.Add(new ExtremePoint(chosen.EP.X, chosen.EP.Y, z2 + 1));

            for (int i = 0; i < eps.Count; i++)
            {
                var ep = eps[i];
                if (ep.X >= x1 && ep.X <= x2 && ep.Y >= y1 && ep.Y <= y2 && ep.Z >= z1 && ep.Z <= z2)
                {
                    nextEps.Add(new ExtremePoint(x2 + 1, ep.Y, ep.Z));
                    nextEps.Add(new ExtremePoint(ep.X, y2 + 1, ep.Z));
                    nextEps.Add(new ExtremePoint(ep.X, ep.Y, z2 + 1));
                }
                else
                {
                    nextEps.Add(ep);
                }
            }

            eps.Clear();
            var visited = new HashSet<ExtremePoint>();
            for (int i = 0; i < nextEps.Count; i++)
            {
                var ep = nextEps[i];
                if (ep.X < G_W && ep.Y < G_H && ep.Z < G_D)
                {
                    if (!grid.IsOccupied(ep.X, ep.Y, ep.Z))
                    {
                        if (visited.Add(ep))
                        {
                            eps.Add(ep);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return packedItems;
    }

    private static double ScorePlacement(int gx, int gy, int gz, VoxelShape shape, HeuristicType heuristic, int currentMaxX, int currentMaxY, int currentMaxZ)
    {
        switch (heuristic)
        {
            case HeuristicType.DBL:
                return gz * 1000000.0 + gy * 1000.0 + gx;
            case HeuristicType.CornerDistance:
                double cx = gx + shape.Width;
                double cy = gy + shape.Height;
                double cz = gz + shape.Depth;
                return cx * cx + cy * cy + cz * cz;
            case HeuristicType.MinHeight:
                int newMaxZ = Math.Max(currentMaxZ, gz + shape.Depth);
                int newMaxY = Math.Max(currentMaxY, gy + shape.Height);
                int newMaxX = Math.Max(currentMaxX, gx + shape.Width);
                return newMaxZ * 1000000.0 + newMaxY * 1000.0 + newMaxX;
            default:
                return gz * 1000000.0 + gy * 1000.0 + gx;
        }
    }
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <random>
#include <thread>
#include <atomic>

// ============================================================================
// Suffix Automaton (SAM) Solver for Small, Medium, and Large Scales
// Time Complexity: O(Sum of |S_i| * log(Sigma)), Space Complexity: O(Min(|S_i|))
// ============================================================================

struct SAM {
    struct State {
        int len, link;
        std::map<char, int> next;
        int first_pos;
    };
    std::vector<State> st;
    int sz, last;
    
    void init(int maxlen) {
        st.clear();
        st.resize(maxlen * 2 + 10);
        st[0].len = 0;
        st[0].link = -1;
        st[0].first_pos = -1;
        sz = 1;
        last = 0;
    }
    
    void extend(char c, int pos) {
        int cur = sz++;
        st[cur].len = st[last].len + 1;
        st[cur].first_pos = pos;
        int p = last;
        while (p != -1 && !st[p].next.count(c)) {
            st[p].next[c] = cur;
            p = st[p].link;
        }
        if (p == -1) {
            st[cur].link = 0;
        } else {
            int q = st[p].next[c];
            if (st[p].len + 1 == st[q].len) {
                st[cur].link = q;
            } else {
                int clone = sz++;
                st[clone].len = st[p].len + 1;
                st[clone].next = st[q].next;
                st[clone].link = st[q].link;
                st[clone].first_pos = st[q].first_pos;
                while (p != -1 && st[p].next[c] == q) {
                    st[p].next[c] = clone;
                    p = st[p].link;
                }
                st[q].link = st[cur].link = clone;
            }
        }
        last = cur;
    }
};

std::string solve_sam(const std::vector<std::string>& S) {
    int N = S.size();
    if (N == 0) return "";
    if (N == 1) return S[0];
    
    int s0_idx = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < N; ++i) {
        if (S[i].size() < S[s0_idx].size()) {
            s0_idx = i;
        }
    }
    const std::string& S0 = S[s0_idx];
    
    SAM sam;
    sam.init(S0.size());
    for (int i = 0; i < S0.size(); ++i) {
        sam.extend(S0[i], i);
    }
    
    int num_states = sam.sz;
    std::vector<int> min_match(num_states);
    for (int i = 0; i < num_states; ++i) {
        min_match[i] = sam.st[i].len;
    }
    
    std::vector<int> order(num_states);
    for (int i = 0; i < num_states; ++i) order[i] = i;
    std::sort(order.begin(), order.end(), [&](int a, int b) {
        return sam.st[a].len > sam.st[b].len;
    });
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        if (i == s0_idx) continue;
        const std::string& Si = S[i];
        std::vector<int> curr_match(num_states, 0);
        int curr = 0, curr_len = 0;
        for (char c : Si) {
            while (curr != -1 && !sam.st[curr].next.count(c)) {
                curr = sam.st[curr].link;
                if (curr != -1) curr_len = sam.st[curr].len;
            }
            if (curr == -1) {
                curr = 0;
                curr_len = 0;
            } else {
                curr = sam.st[curr].next[c];
                curr_len++;
            }
            curr_match[curr] = std::max(curr_match[curr], curr_len);
        }
        
        for (int u : order) {
            if (u == 0) continue;
            int link = sam.st[u].link;
            curr_match[link] = std::max(curr_match[link], std::min(sam.st[link].len, curr_match[u]));
        }
        
        for (int j = 0; j < num_states; ++j) {
            min_match[j] = std::min(min_match[j], curr_match[j]);
        }
    }
    
    int max_len = 0;
    int best_u = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < num_states; ++i) {
        if (min_match[i] > max_len) {
            max_len = min_match[i];
            best_u = i;
        }
    }
    
    if (max_len == 0) return "";
    int end_pos = sam.st[best_u].first_pos;
    return S0.substr(end_pos - max_len + 1, max_len);
}

// ============================================================================
// Parallel Rolling Hash Solver for Extreme Scale (10MB+ strings, 100+ strings)
// Time Complexity: O(Sum of |S_i| log |S_i| / Cores), Space Complexity: O(Peak Memory)
// ============================================================================

struct RollingHash {
    std::unique_ptr<uint64_t[]> P;
    size_t n = 0;
    static std::vector<uint64_t> Pow;
    static uint64_t B;
    
    static void init_powers(size_t max_len) {
        if (Pow.size() >= max_len + 1) return;
        size_t old_size = Pow.size();
        Pow.resize(max_len + 1);
        if (old_size == 0) {
            Pow[0] = 1;
            old_size = 1;
        }
        for (size_t i = old_size; i <= max_len; ++i) {
            Pow[i] = Pow[i-1] * B;
        }
    }
    
    void init(const std::string& s) {
        n = s.size();
        P = std::unique_ptr<uint64_t[]>(new uint64_t[n + 1]);
        P[0] = 0;
        const uint8_t* data = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(s.data());
        uint64_t cur = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            cur = cur * B + data[i];
            P[i+1] = cur;
        }
    }
    
    uint64_t get_hash(size_t i, size_t L) const {
        return P[i+L] - P[i] * Pow[L];
    }
};

uint64_t RollingHash::B = 0;
std::vector<uint64_t> RollingHash::Pow;

struct Candidate {
    uint64_t hash;
    int start_idx;
    bool operator<(const Candidate& o) const {
        return hash < o.hash;
    }
    bool operator==(const Candidate& o) const {
        return hash == o.hash;
    }
};

void radix_sort_uint64(uint64_t* data, uint64_t* temp, size_t n) {
    const int BITS = 16;
    const int BUCKETS = 1 << BITS;
    const uint64_t MASK = BUCKETS - 1;
    
    size_t count[BUCKETS];
    uint64_t* src = data;
    uint64_t* dst = temp;
    
    for (int shift = 0; shift < 64; shift += BITS) {
        std::fill(count, count + BUCKETS, 0);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            count[(src[i] >> shift) & MASK]++;
        }
        size_t pref = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < BUCKETS; ++i) {
            size_t c = count[i];
            count[i] = pref;
            pref += c;
        }
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            size_t digit = (src[i] >> shift) & MASK;
            dst[count[digit]++] = src[i];
        }
        std::swap(src, dst);
    }
}

void radix_sort_candidate(Candidate* data, Candidate* temp, size_t n) {
    const int BITS = 16;
    const int BUCKETS = 1 << BITS;
    const uint64_t MASK = BUCKETS - 1;
    
    size_t count[BUCKETS];
    Candidate* src = data;
    Candidate* dst = temp;
    
    for (int shift = 0; shift < 64; shift += BITS) {
        std::fill(count, count + BUCKETS, 0);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            count[(src[i].hash >> shift) & MASK]++;
        }
        size_t pref = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < BUCKETS; ++i) {
            size_t c = count[i];
            count[i] = pref;
            pref += c;
        }
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            size_t digit = (src[i].hash >> shift) & MASK;
            dst[count[digit]++] = src[i];
        }
        std::swap(src, dst);
    }
}

template<typename F>
void parallel_for(int start, int end, int num_threads, F&& f) {
    int actual_threads = std::min(num_threads, end - start);
    if (actual_threads <= 1) {
        for (int i = start; i < end; ++i) {
            f(i);
        }
        return;
    }
    std::atomic<int> current_idx(start);
    std::vector<std::thread> threads;
    for (int t = 0; t < actual_threads; ++t) {
        threads.emplace_back([&]() {
            while (true) {
                int idx = current_idx.fetch_add(1);
                if (idx >= end) break;
                f(idx);
            }
        });
    }
    for (auto& t : threads) {
        t.join();
    }
}

bool check_length(int L, const std::vector<std::string>& S, const RollingHash& rh0, int num_threads, std::string& out_str) {
    int N = S.size();
    const std::string& S0 = S[0];
    size_t count0 = S0.size() - L + 1;
    
    std::vector<Candidate> current_candidates(count0);
    for (size_t j = 0; j < count0; ++j) {
        current_candidates[j] = { rh0.get_hash(j, L), static_cast<int>(j) };
    }
    
    std::vector<Candidate> temp_cand(count0);
    radix_sort_candidate(current_candidates.data(), temp_cand.data(), count0);
    
    auto last = std::unique(current_candidates.begin(), current_candidates.end());
    current_candidates.erase(last, current_candidates.end());
    
    int next_str_idx = 1;
    
    // Process sequentially until candidate size < 1000 to avoid memory/CPU overhead
    while (next_str_idx < N && current_candidates.size() >= 1000) {
        int i = next_str_idx++;
        
        RollingHash rhi;
        rhi.init(S[i]);
        size_t count_i = S[i].size() - L + 1;
        
        std::unique_ptr<uint64_t[]> hashes_i(new uint64_t[count_i]);
        for (size_t j = 0; j < count_i; ++j) {
            hashes_i[j] = rhi.get_hash(j, L);
        }
        
        std::unique_ptr<uint64_t[]> temp_i(new uint64_t[count_i]);
        radix_sort_uint64(hashes_i.get(), temp_i.get(), count_i);
        
        size_t unique_count = std::unique(hashes_i.get(), hashes_i.get() + count_i) - hashes_i.get();
        
        std::vector<Candidate> next_res;
        auto it1 = current_candidates.begin();
        uint64_t* it2 = hashes_i.get();
        uint64_t* end2 = hashes_i.get() + unique_count;
        
        while (it1 != current_candidates.end() && it2 != end2) {
            if (it1->hash == *it2) {
                next_res.push_back(*it1);
                it1++;
                it2++;
            } else if (it1->hash < *it2) {
                it1++;
            } else {
                it2++;
            }
        }
        current_candidates = std::move(next_res);
        if (current_candidates.empty()) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    if (next_str_idx >= N) {
        // We checked all strings
        for (const auto& cand : current_candidates) {
            std::string_view sub(S0.data() + cand.start_idx, L);
            bool ok = true;
            for (int i = 1; i < N; ++i) {
                if (S[i].find(sub) == std::string::npos) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (ok) {
                out_str = std::string(sub);
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    std::atomic<bool> abort_search(false);
    
    // Check remaining strings in parallel using find (highly optimized parallel search)
    parallel_for(next_str_idx, N, num_threads, [&](int i) {
        if (abort_search.load()) return;
        
        bool has_any = false;
        for (const auto& cand : current_candidates) {
            std::string_view sub(S0.data() + cand.start_idx, L);
            if (S[i].find(sub) != std::string::npos) {
                has_any = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!has_any) {
            abort_search.store(true);
        }
    });
    
    if (abort_search.load()) {
        return false;
    }
    
    for (const auto& cand : current_candidates) {
        std::string_view sub(S0.data() + cand.start_idx, L);
        bool ok = true;
        for (int i = next_str_idx; i < N; ++i) {
            if (S[i].find(sub) == std::string::npos) {
                ok = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (ok) {
            out_str = std::string(sub);
            return true;
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}

std::string solve_parallel_hash(const std::vector<std::string>& S) {
    int N = S.size();
    if (N == 0) return "";
    if (N == 1) return S[0];
    
    int s0_idx = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < N; ++i) {
        if (S[i].size() < S[s0_idx].size()) {
            s0_idx = i;
        }
    }
    
    std::vector<std::string> strings = S;
    std::swap(strings[0], strings[s0_idx]);
    
    const std::string& S0 = strings[0];
    size_t M = S0.size();
    
    std::random_device rd;
    std::mt19937_64 rng(rd());
    RollingHash::B = rng() | 1;
    
    size_t max_len = 0;
    for (const auto& s : strings) {
        max_len = std::max(max_len, s.size());
    }
    RollingHash::init_powers(max_len);
    
    RollingHash rh0;
    rh0.init(S0);
    
    int low = 1, high = M;
    std::string best_lcs = "";
    
    size_t mem_per_thread = max_len * 16;
    int num_threads = std::thread::hardware_concurrency();
    if (num_threads < 1) num_threads = 1;
    if (mem_per_thread > 0) {
        // Safe limit of 32 GB memory allocation for threads
        int safe_threads = static_cast<int>((32ULL * 1024 * 1024 * 1024ULL) / mem_per_thread);
        if (safe_threads < 1) safe_threads = 1;
        num_threads = std::min(num_threads, safe_threads);
    }
    
    while (low <= high) {
        int mid = low + (high - low) / 2;
        std::string current_match = "";
        if (check_length(mid, strings, rh0, num_threads, current_match)) {
            best_lcs = std::move(current_match);
            low = mid + 1;
        } else {
            high = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    
    return best_lcs;
}

// ============================================================================
// Adaptive Orchestration
// ============================================================================

std::string solve(std::vector<std::string>& S) {
    // 1. Remove duplicate strings to optimize search space
    std::sort(S.begin(), S.end());
    auto last = std::unique(S.begin(), S.end());
    S.erase(last, S.end());
    
    int N = S.size();
    if (N == 0) return "";
    if (N == 1) return S[0];
    
    size_t total_len = 0;
    for (const auto& s : S) {
        total_len += s.size();
    }
    
    // Threshold of 1MB total length to switch from deterministic SAM to Parallel Rolling Hash
    if (total_len <= 1000000ULL) {
        return solve_sam(S);
    } else {
        return solve_parallel_hash(S);
    }
}

int main() {
    // Optimize standard input/output streams for speed
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(NULL);
    
    int N;
    if (!(std::cin >> N)) {
        std::cout << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    
    std::vector<std::string> S;
    S.reserve(N);
    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line); // consume newline after N
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        if (std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
            if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') {
                line.pop_back();
            }
            S.push_back(std::move(line));
        }
    }
    
    std::string lcs = solve(S);
    std::cout << lcs << "\n";
    
    return 0;
}

/// <summary>
/// A high-performance solver for localized constraint satisfaction in Minesweeper.
/// Uses a depth-first search with pruning and node limits to solve complex local patterns.
/// Instances are designed to be completely allocation-free during search execution.
/// </summary>
class LocalCspSolver {
    public int[] Variables = new int[24];
    public int VarCount = 0;
    
    public int[] CandidateConstraints = new int[24];
    public int CandCount = 0;
    
    public int[] Constraints = new int[24];
    public int ConstCount = 0;
    
    public int[] ConstraintTargets = new int[24];
    public int[] ConstraintCurrentSums = new int[24];
    public int[] ConstraintUnassigned = new int[24];
    
    // Flat adjacency representation: VarConstraintIndices maps var index to constraint index.
    // Each variable belongs to at most 8 constraints.
    public int[] VarConstraintIndices = new int[24 * 8];
    public int[] VarConstraintCount = new int[24];
    
    public int[] Assignment = new int[24];
    public bool FoundAny = false;
    public long SafeMask = 0;
    public long MineMask = 0;
    public int NodeCount = 0;
    public bool Aborted = false;
    
    public Queue<int> Queue = new Queue<int>();
    
    public void Reset() {
        VarCount = 0;
        CandCount = 0;
        ConstCount = 0;
        FoundAny = false;
        SafeMask = 0;
        MineMask = 0;
        NodeCount = 0;
        Aborted = false;
        Queue.Clear();
    }
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Builds a local neighborhood of unknown cells and constraints starting from a seed revealed cell.
    /// Bounds the size of variables and constraints to keep the search space small and fast.
    /// </summary>
    public void BuildNeighborhood(int startRevealed, byte[] state, int H, int W) {
        Reset();
        
        CandidateConstraints[CandCount++] = startRevealed;
        Queue.Enqueue(startRevealed);
        
        // BFS to gather variables (unknown cells) up to a hard limit
        while (Queue.Count > 0 && VarCount < 20) {
            int currConst = Queue.Dequeue();
            int cr = currConst / W;
            int cc = currConst % W;
            
            for (int dr = -1; dr <= 1; dr++) {
                int nr = cr + dr;
                if (nr < 0 || nr >= H) continue;
                for (int dc = -1; dc <= 1; dc++) {
                    if (dr == 0 && dc == 0) continue;
                    int nc = cc + dc;
                    if (nc < 0 || nc >= W) continue;
                    int nb = nr * W + nc;
                    
                    if (state[nb] == ' ') {
                        int varIdx = -1;
                        for (int i = 0; i < VarCount; i++) {
                            if (Variables[i] == nb) {
                                varIdx = i;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (varIdx == -1) {
                            if (VarCount >= 20) break;
                            varIdx = VarCount;
                            Variables[VarCount++] = nb;
                            
                            // Traverse this new variable's neighbors to expand the local constraint frontier
                            int vr = nb / W;
                            int vc = nb % W;
                            for (int vdr = -1; vdr <= 1; vdr++) {
                                int vnr = vr + vdr;
                                if (vnr < 0 || vnr >= H) continue;
                                for (int vdc = -1; vdc <= 1; vdc++) {
                                    if (vdr == 0 && vdc == 0) continue;
                                    int vnc = vc + vdc;
                                    if (vnc < 0 || vnc >= W) continue;
                                    int vnb = vnr * W + vnc;
                                    char s = (char)state[vnb];
                                    if (s >= '1' && s <= '8') {
                                        bool foundCand = false;
                                        for (int k = 0; k < CandCount; k++) {
                                            if (CandidateConstraints[k] == vnb) {
                                                foundCand = true;
                                                break;
                                            }
                                        }
                                        if (!foundCand && CandCount < 24) {
                                            CandidateConstraints[CandCount++] = vnb;
                                            Queue.Enqueue(vnb);
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (VarCount >= 20) break;
            }
        }
        
        // Filter candidate constraints: we only include constraints whose unknown neighbors
        // are fully contained within the selected local variables.
        for (int i = 0; i < CandCount; i++) {
            int cIdx = CandidateConstraints[i];
            bool allIn = true;
            int cr = cIdx / W;
            int cc = cIdx % W;
            for (int dr = -1; dr <= 1; dr++) {
                int nr = cr + dr;
                if (nr < 0 || nr >= H) continue;
                for (int dc = -1; dc <= 1; dc++) {
                    if (dr == 0 && dc == 0) continue;
                    int nc = cc + dc;
                    if (nc < 0 || nc >= W) continue;
                    int nb = nr * W + nc;
                    if (state[nb] == ' ') {
                        bool inVars = false;
                        for (int v = 0; v < VarCount; v++) {
                            if (Variables[v] == nb) {
                                inVars = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (!inVars) {
                            allIn = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (!allIn) break;
            }
            if (allIn && ConstCount < 24) {
                Constraints[ConstCount++] = cIdx;
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Prepares the local constraint graph for the DFS.
    /// Sets targets and maps variables to constraints.
    /// </summary>
    public void PrepareDfs(int[] remainingMines, int H, int W) {
        for (int i = 0; i < VarCount; i++) {
            VarConstraintCount[i] = 0;
        }
        
        for (int j = 0; j < ConstCount; j++) {
            int cIdx = Constraints[j];
            ConstraintTargets[j] = remainingMines[cIdx];
            ConstraintCurrentSums[j] = 0;
            
            int cr = cIdx / W;
            int cc = cIdx % W;
            int unassigned = 0;
            
            for (int dr = -1; dr <= 1; dr++) {
                int nr = cr + dr;
                if (nr < 0 || nr >= H) continue;
                for (int dc = -1; dc <= 1; dc++) {
                    if (dr == 0 && dc == 0) continue;
                    int nc = cc + dc;
                    if (nc < 0 || nc >= W) continue;
                    int nb = nr * W + nc;
                    
                    for (int v = 0; v < VarCount; v++) {
                        if (Variables[v] == nb) {
                            unassigned++;
                            int idx = v * 8 + VarConstraintCount[v];
                            VarConstraintIndices[idx] = j;
                            VarConstraintCount[v]++;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            ConstraintUnassigned[j] = unassigned;
        }
    }
    
    public void Solve() {
        Dfs(0);
    }
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Depth-First Search with backtracking, pruning, and node limits.
    /// </summary>
    private void Dfs(int varIdx) {
        NodeCount++;
        if (NodeCount > 2000) {
            Aborted = true;
            return;
        }
        
        if (varIdx == VarCount) {
            FoundAny = true;
            for (int i = 0; i < VarCount; i++) {
                if (Assignment[i] == 0) {
                    SafeMask |= (1L << i);
                } else {
                    MineMask |= (1L << i);
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        
        // Try value 0 (Safe)
        if (IsValid(varIdx, 0)) {
            Assign(varIdx, 0);
            Dfs(varIdx + 1);
            if (Aborted) return;
            Unassign(varIdx, 0);
        }
        
        // Try value 1 (Mine)
        if (IsValid(varIdx, 1)) {
            Assign(varIdx, 1);
            Dfs(varIdx + 1);
            if (Aborted) return;
            Unassign(varIdx, 1);
        }
    }
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Checks if assigning a value to a variable violates any constraints.
    /// </summary>
    private bool IsValid(int varIdx, int val) {
        int count = VarConstraintCount[varIdx];
        int start = varIdx * 8;
        for (int k = 0; k < count; k++) {
            int cIdx = VarConstraintIndices[start + k];
            int nextSum = ConstraintCurrentSums[cIdx] + val;
            int nextUnassigned = ConstraintUnassigned[cIdx] - 1;
            
            // Prune if current mines exceed target OR remaining spaces cannot satisfy target
            if (nextSum > ConstraintTargets[cIdx] || nextSum + nextUnassigned < ConstraintTargets[cIdx]) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    private void Assign(int varIdx, int val) {
        Assignment[varIdx] = val;
        int count = VarConstraintCount[varIdx];
        int start = varIdx * 8;
        for (int k = 0; k < count; k++) {
            int cIdx = VarConstraintIndices[start + k];
            ConstraintCurrentSums[cIdx] += val;
            ConstraintUnassigned[cIdx]--;
        }
    }
    
    private void Unassign(int varIdx, int val) {
        int count = VarConstraintCount[varIdx];
        int start = varIdx * 8;
        for (int k = 0; k < count; k++) {
            int cIdx = VarConstraintIndices[start + k];
            ConstraintCurrentSums[cIdx] -= val;
            ConstraintUnassigned[cIdx]++;
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Main solver orchestrator combining basic propagation, pairwise checks, and parallel Local CSP.
/// </summary>
class Solver {
    private int H;
    private int W;
    private byte[] state;
    private int[] remainingMines;
    private int[] remainingUnknowns;
    private Queue<int> activeQueue;
    private bool[] inQueue;
    private List<int> frontierUnknowns;
    
    // Pre-allocated arrays for pairwise checking (zero allocations)
    private int[] U_A = new int[8];
    private int[] U_B = new int[8];
    private int[] S = new int[8];
    private int[] A_minus_S = new int[8];
    private int[] B_minus_S = new int[8];
    private int[] rev = new int[8];
    
    private ThreadLocal<LocalCspSolver> solverPool;
    
    public Solver(int h, int w, string[] board) {
        H = h;
        W = w;
        state = new byte[H * W];
        remainingMines = new int[H * W];
        remainingUnknowns = new int[H * W];
        activeQueue = new Queue<int>();
        inQueue = new bool[H * W];
        frontierUnknowns = new List<int>();
        
        solverPool = new ThreadLocal<LocalCspSolver>(() => new LocalCspSolver());
        
        // Copy board characters to the state byte array
        for (int r = 0; r < H; r++) {
            string row = board[r];
            for (int c = 0; c < W; c++) {
                state[r * W + c] = (byte)row[c];
            }
        }
        
        // Initialize counts for remaining mines and unknowns
        for (int idx = 0; idx < H * W; idx++) {
            char s = (char)state[idx];
            if (s >= '1' && s <= '8') {
                int unknownCount = 0;
                int mineCount = 0;
                
                int r = idx / W;
                int c = idx % W;
                for (int dr = -1; dr <= 1; dr++) {
                    int nr = r + dr;
                    if (nr < 0 || nr >= H) continue;
                    for (int dc = -1; dc <= 1; dc++) {
                        if (dr == 0 && dc == 0) continue;
                        int nc = c + dc;
                        if (nc < 0 || nc >= W) continue;
                        int nb = nr * W + nc;
                        char nbs = (char)state[nb];
                        if (nbs == ' ') {
                            unknownCount++;
                        } else if (nbs == '*') {
                            mineCount++;
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                remainingMines[idx] = (s - '0') - mineCount;
                remainingUnknowns[idx] = unknownCount;
                
                // If a revealed number is immediately satisfied or trivial, queue it
                if (unknownCount > 0 && (remainingMines[idx] == 0 || remainingMines[idx] == unknownCount)) {
                    activeQueue.Enqueue(idx);
                    inQueue[idx] = true;
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Collect all frontier unknown cells to focus searches
        for (int i = 0; i < H * W; i++) {
            if (state[i] == ' ' && HasRevealedNeighbor(i)) {
                frontierUnknowns.Add(i);
            }
        }
    }
    
    private bool HasRevealedNeighbor(int idx) {
        int r = idx / W;
        int c = idx % W;
        for (int dr = -1; dr <= 1; dr++) {
            int nr = r + dr;
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= H) continue;
            for (int dc = -1; dc <= 1; dc++) {
                if (dr == 0 && dc == 0) continue;
                int nc = c + dc;
                if (nc < 0 || nc >= W) continue;
                int nb = nr * W + nc;
                char s = (char)state[nb];
                if (s >= '1' && s <= '8') return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    private void UpdateRevealedNeighborsOfSafe(int safeIdx) {
        int r = safeIdx / W;
        int c = safeIdx % W;
        for (int dr = -1; dr <= 1; dr++) {
            int nr = r + dr;
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= H) continue;
            for (int dc = -1; dc <= 1; dc++) {
                if (dr == 0 && dc == 0) continue;
                int nc = c + dc;
                if (nc < 0 || nc >= W) continue;
                int nb = nr * W + nc;
                char s = (char)state[nb];
                if (s >= '1' && s <= '8') {
                    remainingUnknowns[nb]--;
                    if (remainingUnknowns[nb] > 0 && (remainingMines[nb] == 0 || remainingMines[nb] == remainingUnknowns[nb])) {
                        if (!inQueue[nb]) {
                            activeQueue.Enqueue(nb);
                            inQueue[nb] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    private void UpdateRevealedNeighborsOfMine(int mineIdx) {
        int r = mineIdx / W;
        int c = mineIdx % W;
        for (int dr = -1; dr <= 1; dr++) {
            int nr = r + dr;
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= H) continue;
            for (int dc = -1; dc <= 1; dc++) {
                if (dr == 0 && dc == 0) continue;
                int nc = c + dc;
                if (nc < 0 || nc >= W) continue;
                int nb = nr * W + nc;
                char s = (char)state[nb];
                if (s >= '1' && s <= '8') {
                    remainingUnknowns[nb]--;
                    remainingMines[nb]--;
                    if (remainingUnknowns[nb] > 0 && (remainingMines[nb] == 0 || remainingMines[nb] == remainingUnknowns[nb])) {
                        if (!inQueue[nb]) {
                            activeQueue.Enqueue(nb);
                            inQueue[nb] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Implements standard Minesweeper logic (all-safe or all-mine rules per cell).
    /// </summary>
    private bool RunBasicPropagation() {
        bool changed = false;
        while (activeQueue.Count > 0) {
            int idx = activeQueue.Dequeue();
            inQueue[idx] = false;
            
            int remMines = remainingMines[idx];
            int remUnknown = remainingUnknowns[idx];
            if (remUnknown == 0) continue;
            
            if (remMines == 0) {
                int r = idx / W;
                int c = idx % W;
                for (int dr = -1; dr <= 1; dr++) {
                    int nr = r + dr;
                    if (nr < 0 || nr >= H) continue;
                    for (int dc = -1; dc <= 1; dc++) {
                        if (dr == 0 && dc == 0) continue;
                        int nc = c + dc;
                        if (nc < 0 || nc >= W) continue;
                        int nb = nr * W + nc;
                        if (state[nb] == ' ') {
                            state[nb] = (byte)'s';
                            changed = true;
                            UpdateRevealedNeighborsOfSafe(nb);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else if (remMines == remUnknown) {
                int r = idx / W;
                int c = idx % W;
                for (int dr = -1; dr <= 1; dr++) {
                    int nr = r + dr;
                    if (nr < 0 || nr >= H) continue;
                    for (int dc = -1; dc <= 1; dc++) {
                        if (dr == 0 && dc == 0) continue;
                        int nc = c + dc;
                        if (nc < 0 || nc >= W) continue;
                        int nb = nr * W + nc;
                        if (state[nb] == ' ') {
                            state[nb] = (byte)'m';
                            changed = true;
                            UpdateRevealedNeighborsOfMine(nb);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return changed;
    }
    
    private void GetUnknownNeighborsList(int idx, int[] list, out int count) {
        count = 0;
        int r = idx / W;
        int c = idx % W;
        for (int dr = -1; dr <= 1; dr++) {
            int nr = r + dr;
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= H) continue;
            for (int dc = -1; dc <= 1; dc++) {
                if (dr == 0 && dc == 0) continue;
                int nc = c + dc;
                if (nc < 0 || nc >= W) continue;
                int nb = nr * W + nc;
                if (state[nb] == ' ') {
                    list[count++] = nb;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Performs generalized pairwise constraint reductions between overlapping constraints.
    /// </summary>
    private bool ProcessPair(int A, int B) {
        int sizeA = 0;
        GetUnknownNeighborsList(A, U_A, out sizeA);
        
        int sizeB = 0;
        GetUnknownNeighborsList(B, U_B, out sizeB);
        
        if (sizeA == 0 || sizeB == 0) return false;
        
        int sizeS = 0;
        int sizeA_minus_S = 0;
        int sizeB_minus_S = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < sizeA; i++) {
            bool inB = false;
            for (int j = 0; j < sizeB; j++) {
                if (U_A[i] == U_B[j]) {
                    inB = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (inB) {
                S[sizeS++] = U_A[i];
            } else {
                A_minus_S[sizeA_minus_S++] = U_A[i];
            }
        }
        
        for (int j = 0; j < sizeB; j++) {
            bool inA = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < sizeS; i++) {
                if (U_B[j] == S[i]) {
                    inA = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!inA) {
                B_minus_S[sizeB_minus_S++] = U_B[j];
            }
        }
        
        if (sizeS == 0) return false;
        
        int C_prime_A = remainingMines[A];
        int C_prime_B = remainingMines[B];
        
        bool changed = false;
        
        // Rule 1: L(A, S) == U(B, S)
        int L_A_S = Math.Max(0, C_prime_A - sizeA_minus_S);
        int U_B_S = Math.Min(C_prime_B, sizeS);
        if (L_A_S == U_B_S) {
            for (int i = 0; i < sizeA_minus_S; i++) {
                int x = A_minus_S[i];
                if (state[x] == ' ') {
                    state[x] = (byte)'m';
                    UpdateRevealedNeighborsOfMine(x);
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < sizeB_minus_S; i++) {
                int x = B_minus_S[i];
                if (state[x] == ' ') {
                    state[x] = (byte)'s';
                    UpdateRevealedNeighborsOfSafe(x);
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Rule 2: L(B, S) == U(A, S)
        int L_B_S = Math.Max(0, C_prime_B - sizeB_minus_S);
        int U_A_S = Math.Min(C_prime_A, sizeS);
        if (L_B_S == U_A_S) {
            for (int i = 0; i < sizeB_minus_S; i++) {
                int x = B_minus_S[i];
                if (state[x] == ' ') {
                    state[x] = (byte)'m';
                    UpdateRevealedNeighborsOfMine(x);
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < sizeA_minus_S; i++) {
                int x = A_minus_S[i];
                if (state[x] == ' ') {
                    state[x] = (byte)'s';
                    UpdateRevealedNeighborsOfSafe(x);
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
        }
        
        return changed;
    }
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Scans the frontier of unknown cells, running pairwise constraint checks.
    /// </summary>
    private bool RunPairwisePropagation() {
        bool changed = false;
        for (int k = 0; k < frontierUnknowns.Count; k++) {
            int idx = frontierUnknowns[k];
            if (state[idx] == ' ') {
                int r = idx / W;
                int c = idx % W;
                int revCount = 0;
                for (int dr = -1; dr <= 1; dr++) {
                    int nr = r + dr;
                    if (nr < 0 || nr >= H) continue;
                    for (int dc = -1; dc <= 1; dc++) {
                        if (dr == 0 && dc == 0) continue;
                        int nc = c + dc;
                        if (nc < 0 || nc >= W) continue;
                        int nb = nr * W + nc;
                        char s = (char)state[nb];
                        if (s >= '1' && s <= '8') {
                            rev[revCount++] = nb;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (revCount >= 2) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < revCount; i++) {
                        for (int j = i + 1; j < revCount; j++) {
                            if (ProcessPair(rev[i], rev[j])) {
                                changed = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return changed;
    }
    
    private List<int> GetUnresolvedRevealedCells() {
        List<int> list = new List<int>();
        for (int i = 0; i < H * W; i++) {
            char s = (char)state[i];
            if (s >= '1' && s <= '8' && remainingUnknowns[i] > 0) {
                list.Add(i);
            }
        }
        return list;
    }
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the full solver workflow, adapting to grid size and complexity.
    /// </summary>
    public void Solve() {
        // Step 1: Run fast initial basic propagation
        RunBasicPropagation();
        
        // Step 2: Loop basic + pairwise checks to solve simple patterns
        bool changed = true;
        while (changed) {
            changed = false;
            if (RunBasicPropagation()) changed = true;
            if (RunPairwisePropagation()) changed = true;
        }
        
        // Step 3: Run Local CSP solver on remaining unresolved cells
        bool globalChanged = true;
        int loopCount = 0;
        while (globalChanged && loopCount < 5) {
            globalChanged = false;
            loopCount++;
            
            List<int> unresolved = GetUnresolvedRevealedCells();
            if (unresolved.Count == 0) break;
            
            List<(int idx, bool isMine)> globalDeductions = new List<(int, bool)>();
            
            // Choose adaptive path: parallel execution on massive boards, sequential on small boards
            bool parallelCsp = (H * W > 256) && (unresolved.Count >= 20);
            
            if (parallelCsp) {
                object globalLock = new object();
                Parallel.ForEach(
                    unresolved,
                    () => new List<(int idx, bool isMine)>(),
                    (cell, loopState, localList) => {
                        var solver = solverPool.Value;
                        solver.BuildNeighborhood(cell, state, H, W);
                        solver.PrepareDfs(remainingMines, H, W);
                        solver.Solve();
                        if (solver.FoundAny && !solver.Aborted) {
                            for (int i = 0; i < solver.VarCount; i++) {
                                bool isSafe = (solver.MineMask & (1L << i)) == 0;
                                bool isMine = (solver.SafeMask & (1L << i)) == 0;
                                if (isSafe) {
                                    localList.Add((solver.Variables[i], false));
                                } else if (isMine) {
                                    localList.Add((solver.Variables[i], true));
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        return localList;
                    },
                    (localList) => {
                        lock (globalLock) {
                            globalDeductions.AddRange(localList);
                        }
                    }
                );
            } else {
                var solver = solverPool.Value;
                foreach (var cell in unresolved) {
                    solver.BuildNeighborhood(cell, state, H, W);
                    solver.PrepareDfs(remainingMines, H, W);
                    solver.Solve();
                    if (solver.FoundAny && !solver.Aborted) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < solver.VarCount; i++) {
                            bool isSafe = (solver.MineMask & (1L << i)) == 0;
                            bool isMine = (solver.SafeMask & (1L << i)) == 0;
                            if (isSafe) {
                                globalDeductions.Add((solver.Variables[i], false));
                            } else if (isMine) {
                                globalDeductions.Add((solver.Variables[i], true));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Apply all deductions found in this pass
            if (globalDeductions.Count > 0) {
                foreach (var deduction in globalDeductions) {
                    int cellIdx = deduction.idx;
                    bool isMine = deduction.isMine;
                    if (state[cellIdx] == ' ') {
                        if (isMine) {
                            state[cellIdx] = (byte)'m';
                            UpdateRevealedNeighborsOfMine(cellIdx);
                        } else {
                            state[cellIdx] = (byte)'s';
                            UpdateRevealedNeighborsOfSafe(cellIdx);
                        }
                        globalChanged = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // If Local CSP updated any cells, re-run basic + pairwise propagation to propagate effects
            if (globalChanged) {
                bool innerChanged = true;
                while (innerChanged) {
                    innerChanged = false;
                    if (RunBasicPropagation()) innerChanged = true;
                    if (RunPairwisePropagation()) innerChanged = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Outputs results using high-performance buffered streams.
    /// </summary>
    public void PrintResults() {
        List<int> safeCells = new List<int>();
        for (int i = 0; i < H * W; i++) {
            if (state[i] == 's') {
                safeCells.Add(i);
            }
        }
        
        Console.WriteLine(safeCells.Count);
        using (StreamWriter writer = new StreamWriter(Console.OpenStandardOutput(), System.Text.Encoding.ASCII, 65536)) {
            for (int i = 0; i < safeCells.Count; i++) {
                int idx = safeCells[i];
                int r = idx / W;
                int c = idx % W;
                writer.Write(c);
                writer.Write(' ');
                writer.Write(r);
                writer.WriteLine();
            }
        }
    }
}

Typical Prompt:
You are solving a Shadow Covering problem with tetrahedrons in Rust.

**The Challenge:**
Your program will be tested with polygons ranging from simple shapes to very complex geometries.
The same program must work efficiently across ALL scales.

**Input format (stdin):**
Line 1: NV (number of polygon vertices)
Next NV lines: x y (polygon vertices on z=0 plane)
Last line: sx sy sz (sun direction vector, points from sun toward ground)

**Output format (stdout):**
Line 1: count (number of tetrahedrons)
Next count lines: px py pz qw qx qy qz scale
px,py,pz: center position
qw,qx,qy,qz: rotation quaternion (w is scalar)
scale: uniform scale factor

**Standard Tetrahedron Reference:**
Vertices (before transform):
[1.0, 0.0, -0.707]
[-1.0, 0.0, -0.707]
[0.0, 1.0, 0.707]
[0.0, -1.0, 0.707]

- Combined shadows must completely cover target polygon
- Tetrahedrons must not intersect each other in 3D
- Maximum scale factor per tetrahedron: 10.0
- Minimize number of tetrahedrons
