use std::collections::BinaryHeap;
use std::io::{self, BufRead};
use std::time::Instant;

#[derive(Copy, Clone)]
struct HeapElem {
    dist_sq: f32,
    idx: u32,
}

impl PartialEq for HeapElem {
    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        self.dist_sq == other.dist_sq
    }
}

impl Eq for HeapElem {}

impl PartialOrd for HeapElem {
    fn partial_cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Option<std::cmp::Ordering> {
        self.dist_sq.partial_cmp(&other.dist_sq)
    }
}

impl Ord for HeapElem {
    fn cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> std::cmp::Ordering {
        self.partial_cmp(other).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
    }
}

struct KdNode {
    point: [f32; 3],
    idx: u32,
    left: u32,
    right: u32,
}

fn build_kd_tree(
    points: &mut [([f32; 3], u32)],
    nodes: &mut Vec<KdNode>,
    depth: usize,
) -> u32 {
    if points.is_empty() {
        return u32::MAX;
    }
    let axis = depth % 3;
    let mid = points.len() / 2;
    points.select_nth_unstable_by(mid, |a, b| {
        a.0[axis].partial_cmp(&b.0[axis]).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
    });
    
    let node_idx = nodes.len() as u32;
    nodes.push(KdNode {
        point: points[mid].0,
        idx: points[mid].1,
        left: u32::MAX,
        right: u32::MAX,
    });
    
    let left_idx = build_kd_tree(&mut points[..mid], nodes, depth + 1);
    let right_idx = build_kd_tree(&mut points[mid + 1..], nodes, depth + 1);
    
    nodes[node_idx as usize].left = left_idx;
    nodes[node_idx as usize].right = right_idx;
    
    node_idx
}

fn knn_search(
    nodes: &[KdNode],
    root: u32,
    query: [f32; 3],
    k: usize,
    heap: &mut BinaryHeap<HeapElem>,
    depth: usize,
) {
    if root == u32::MAX {
        return;
    }
    let node = &nodes[root as usize];
    let dist_sq = (node.point[0] - query[0]).powi(2)
        + (node.point[1] - query[1]).powi(2)
        + (node.point[2] - query[2]).powi(2);
        
    if heap.len() < k {
        heap.push(HeapElem { dist_sq, idx: node.idx });
    } else if let Some(top) = heap.peek() {
        if dist_sq < top.dist_sq {
            heap.pop();
            heap.push(HeapElem { dist_sq, idx: node.idx });
        }
    }
    
    let axis = depth % 3;
    let diff = query[axis] - node.point[axis];
    let (near_child, far_child) = if diff <= 0.0 {
        (node.left, node.right)
    } else {
        (node.right, node.left)
    };
    
    knn_search(nodes, near_child, query, k, heap, depth + 1);
    
    let check_far = if heap.len() < k {
        true
    } else if let Some(top) = heap.peek() {
        diff.powi(2) < top.dist_sq
    } else {
        false
    };
    
    if check_far {
        knn_search(nodes, far_child, query, k, heap, depth + 1);
    }
}

struct HoleKdNode {
    point: [f32; 3],
    hole_idx: u32,
    left: u32,
    right: u32,
}

fn build_hole_kd_tree(
    points: &mut [([f32; 3], u32)],
    nodes: &mut Vec<HoleKdNode>,
    depth: usize,
) -> u32 {
    if points.is_empty() {
        return u32::MAX;
    }
    let axis = depth % 3;
    let mid = points.len() / 2;
    points.select_nth_unstable_by(mid, |a, b| {
        a.0[axis].partial_cmp(&b.0[axis]).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
    });
    
    let node_idx = nodes.len() as u32;
    nodes.push(HoleKdNode {
        point: points[mid].0,
        hole_idx: points[mid].1,
        left: u32::MAX,
        right: u32::MAX,
    });
    
    let left_idx = build_hole_kd_tree(&mut points[..mid], nodes, depth + 1);
    let right_idx = build_hole_kd_tree(&mut points[mid + 1..], nodes, depth + 1);
    
    nodes[node_idx as usize].left = left_idx;
    nodes[node_idx as usize].right = right_idx;
    
    node_idx
}

fn hole_knn_search(
    nodes: &[HoleKdNode],
    root: u32,
    query: [f32; 3],
    k: usize,
    exclude_hole_idx: u32,
    heap: &mut BinaryHeap<HeapElem>,
    depth: usize,
) {
    if root == u32::MAX {
        return;
    }
    let node = &nodes[root as usize];
    let dist_sq = (node.point[0] - query[0]).powi(2)
        + (node.point[1] - query[1]).powi(2)
        + (node.point[2] - query[2]).powi(2);
        
    if node.hole_idx != exclude_hole_idx {
        if heap.len() < k {
            heap.push(HeapElem { dist_sq, idx: node.hole_idx });
        } else if let Some(top) = heap.peek() {
            if dist_sq < top.dist_sq {
                heap.pop();
                heap.push(HeapElem { dist_sq, idx: node.hole_idx });
            }
        }
    }
    
    let axis = depth % 3;
    let diff = query[axis] - node.point[axis];
    let (near_child, far_child) = if diff <= 0.0 {
        (node.left, node.right)
    } else {
        (node.right, node.left)
    };
    
    hole_knn_search(nodes, near_child, query, k, exclude_hole_idx, heap, depth + 1);
    
    let check_far = if heap.len() < k {
        true
    } else if let Some(top) = heap.peek() {
        diff.powi(2) < top.dist_sq
    } else {
        false
    };
    
    if check_far {
        hole_knn_search(nodes, far_child, query, k, exclude_hole_idx, heap, depth + 1);
    }
}

fn get_neighbor_holes(
    nodes: &[HoleKdNode],
    root: u32,
    h_idx: u32,
    start: [f32; 3],
    mid: [f32; 3],
    end: [f32; 3],
) -> Vec<u32> {
    let mut heap = BinaryHeap::new();
    hole_knn_search(nodes, root, start, 5, h_idx, &mut heap, 0);
    hole_knn_search(nodes, root, mid, 5, h_idx, &mut heap, 0);
    hole_knn_search(nodes, root, end, 5, h_idx, &mut heap, 0);
    
    let mut neighbors = Vec::new();
    while let Some(elem) = heap.pop() {
        neighbors.push(elem.idx);
    }
    neighbors.sort_unstable();
    neighbors.dedup();
    neighbors
}

struct HoleInfo {
    id: String,
    start_x: f32,
    start_y: f32,
    start_z: f32,
    dir_x: f32,
    dir_y: f32,
    dir_z: f32,
    length: f32,
    num_samples: usize,
    start_sample_idx: u32,
    end_sample_idx: u32,
}

struct Sample {
    hole_idx: u32,
    sample_idx_in_hole: u32,
    depth: f32,
    x: f32,
    y: f32,
    z: f32,
}

struct PropertyStats {
    name: String,
    median: f32,
    mad: f32,
    min_val: f32,
    max_val: f32,
}

struct Suspect {
    hole_id: String,
    sample_idx: u32,
    property_name: String,
    confidence: f32,
}

fn parse_float(s: &str) -> Option<f32> {
    let s_lower = s.to_lowercase();
    if s_lower == "nan" || s_lower == "na" || s_lower == "null" || s_lower == "none" || s == "-" || s == "*" {
        None
    } else {
        s.parse::<f32>().ok()
    }
}

fn get_same_hole_neighbor_indices(s: &Sample, h: &HoleInfo) -> Vec<u32> {
    let mut same_indices = Vec::new();
    let cur = s.sample_idx_in_hole as i32;
    let max_idx = (h.end_sample_idx - h.start_sample_idx) as i32;
    for offset in &[-2, -1, 1, 2] {
        let idx = cur + offset;
        if idx >= 0 && idx < max_idx {
            same_indices.push(h.start_sample_idx + idx as u32);
        }
    }
    same_indices
}

fn evaluate_sample_outliers(
    s_idx: u32,
    same_indices: &[u32],
    cross_indices: &[u32],
    all_samples: &[Sample],
    global_values: &[Option<f32>],
    holes: &[HoleInfo],
    property_stats: &[PropertyStats],
    out_suspects: &mut Vec<Suspect>,
) {
    let s = &all_samples[s_idx as usize];
    let num_properties = property_stats.len();
    
    for prop_idx in 0..num_properties {
        let val_opt = global_values[s_idx as usize * num_properties + prop_idx];
        let v = match val_opt {
            Some(x) => x,
            None => continue,
        };
        
        let stats = &property_stats[prop_idx];
        let mut neighbors = Vec::new();
        
        for &idx in same_indices {
            if let Some(nv) = global_values[idx as usize * num_properties + prop_idx] {
                neighbors.push(nv);
            }
        }
        
        for &idx in cross_indices {
            if let Some(nv) = global_values[idx as usize * num_properties + prop_idx] {
                neighbors.push(nv);
            }
        }
        
        if neighbors.len() < 3 {
            continue;
        }
        
        neighbors.sort_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));
        let n_len = neighbors.len();
        let median = if n_len % 2 == 1 {
            neighbors[n_len / 2]
        } else {
            (neighbors[n_len / 2 - 1] + neighbors[n_len / 2]) * 0.5
        };
        
        let mut diffs: Vec<f32> = neighbors.iter().map(|&x| (x - median).abs()).collect();
        diffs.sort_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));
        let mad = if n_len % 2 == 1 {
            diffs[n_len / 2]
        } else {
            (diffs[n_len / 2 - 1] + diffs[n_len / 2]) * 0.5
        };
        
        let global_range = stats.max_val - stats.min_val;
        let denom = mad + 0.05 * stats.mad + 1e-6 * (global_range + 1.0);
        let score = (v - median).abs() / denom;
        
        if score > 7.0 {
            out_suspects.push(Suspect {
                hole_id: holes[s.hole_idx as usize].id.clone(),
                sample_idx: s.sample_idx_in_hole,
                property_name: stats.name.clone(),
                confidence: score,
            });
        }
    }
}

fn compute_global_stats(name: &str, values: &[Option<f32>]) -> PropertyStats {
    let mut valid_vals: Vec<f32> = values.iter().filter_map(|&x| x).collect();
    if valid_vals.is_empty() {
        return PropertyStats {
            name: name.to_string(),
            median: 0.0,
            mad: 0.0,
            min_val: 0.0,
            max_val: 0.0,
        };
    }
    
    let n = valid_vals.len();
    let mid = n / 2;
    valid_vals.select_nth_unstable_by(mid, |a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));
    let median = valid_vals[mid];
    
    let mut diffs: Vec<f32> = valid_vals.iter().map(|&x| (x - median).abs()).collect();
    diffs.select_nth_unstable_by(mid, |a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));
    let mad = diffs[mid];
    
    let mut min_val = valid_vals[0];
    let mut max_val = valid_vals[0];
    for &val in &valid_vals {
        if val < min_val { min_val = val; }
        if val > max_val { max_val = val; }
    }
    
    PropertyStats {
        name: name.to_string(),
        median,
        mad,
        min_val,
        max_val,
    }
}

fn main() -> io::Result<()> {
    let start_time = Instant::now();
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut reader = io::BufReader::new(stdin.lock());
    let mut line = String::new();
    
    if reader.read_line(&mut line)? == 0 {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let mut parts = line.split_whitespace();
    let num_holes: usize = parts.next().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
    let num_properties: usize = parts.next().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
    
    line.clear();
    if reader.read_line(&mut line)? == 0 {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let property_names: Vec<String> = line.split_whitespace().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();
    
    let mut holes = Vec::with_capacity(num_holes);
    let mut all_samples = Vec::new();
    let mut global_values = Vec::new();
    
    for _ in 0..num_holes {
        line.clear();
        if reader.read_line(&mut line)? == 0 {
            break;
        }
        let mut parts = line.split_whitespace();
        let hole_id = match parts.next() {
            Some(id) => id.to_string(),
            None => continue,
        };
        let start_x: f32 = parts.next().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0.0);
        let start_y: f32 = parts.next().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0.0);
        let start_z: f32 = parts.next().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0.0);
        let dir_x: f32 = parts.next().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0.0);
        let dir_y: f32 = parts.next().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0.0);
        let dir_z: f32 = parts.next().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0.0);
        let length: f32 = parts.next().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0.0);
        let num_samples: usize = parts.next().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
        
        let start_sample_idx = all_samples.len() as u32;
        
        let norm = (dir_x * dir_x + dir_y * dir_y + dir_z * dir_z).sqrt();
        let (ux, uy, uz) = if norm > 1e-6 {
            (dir_x / norm, dir_y / norm, dir_z / norm)
        } else {
            (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
        };
        
        let hole_idx = holes.len() as u32;
        
        for sample_idx_in_hole in 0..num_samples {
            line.clear();
            if reader.read_line(&mut line)? == 0 {
                break;
            }
            let mut s_parts = line.split_whitespace();
            let depth: f32 = match s_parts.next() {
                Some(d) => d.parse().unwrap_or(0.0),
                None => 0.0,
            };
            
            let x = start_x + depth * ux;
            let y = start_y + depth * uy;
            let z = start_z + depth * uz;
            
            all_samples.push(Sample {
                hole_idx,
                sample_idx_in_hole: sample_idx_in_hole as u32,
                depth,
                x,
                y,
                z,
            });
            
            for _ in 0..num_properties {
                let val_str = s_parts.next().unwrap_or("NaN");
                global_values.push(parse_float(val_str));
            }
        }
        
        let end_sample_idx = all_samples.len() as u32;
        
        holes.push(HoleInfo {
            id: hole_id,
            start_x, start_y, start_z,
            dir_x, dir_y, dir_z,
            length,
            num_samples,
            start_sample_idx,
            end_sample_idx,
        });
    }
    
    // Compute property stats
    let mut property_stats = Vec::with_capacity(num_properties);
    for prop_idx in 0..num_properties {
        let mut prop_vals = Vec::with_capacity(all_samples.len());
        for s_idx in 0..all_samples.len() {
            prop_vals.push(global_values[s_idx * num_properties + prop_idx]);
        }
        let stats = compute_global_stats(&property_names[prop_idx], &prop_vals);
        property_stats.push(stats);
    }
    
    let num_threads = std::thread::available_parallelism()
        .map(|x| x.get())
        .unwrap_or(1);
    
    let total_samples = all_samples.len();
    
    let mut all_suspects = if total_samples < 30000 {
        // Global search strategy
        let mut global_points: Vec<([f32; 3], u32)> = all_samples
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .map(|(idx, s)| ([s.x, s.y, s.z], idx as u32))
            .collect();
        let mut global_nodes = Vec::with_capacity(global_points.len());
        let global_root = build_kd_tree(&mut global_points, &mut global_nodes, 0);
        
        std::thread::scope(|s| {
            let mut handles = Vec::new();
            let chunk_size = (total_samples + num_threads - 1) / num_threads;
            for chunk_idx in 0..num_threads {
                let start = chunk_idx * chunk_size;
                let end = (start + chunk_size).min(total_samples);
                if start >= end { continue; }
                
                let global_nodes_ref = &global_nodes;
                let all_samples_ref = &all_samples;
                let global_values_ref = &global_values;
                let holes_ref = &holes;
                let stats_ref = &property_stats;
                
                let handle = s.spawn(move || {
                    let mut local_suspects = Vec::new();
                    for s_idx in start..end {
                        let S = &all_samples_ref[s_idx];
                        let same_indices = get_same_hole_neighbor_indices(S, &holes_ref[S.hole_idx as usize]);
                        
                        let mut heap = BinaryHeap::new();
                        knn_search(global_nodes_ref, global_root, [S.x, S.y, S.z], 20, &mut heap, 0);
                        
                        let mut candidates = Vec::new();
                        while let Some(elem) = heap.pop() {
                            candidates.push(elem);
                        }
                        candidates.reverse();
                        
                        let mut cross_indices = Vec::new();
                        for elem in candidates {
                            let ns = &all_samples_ref[elem.idx as usize];
                            if ns.hole_idx != S.hole_idx {
                                cross_indices.push(elem.idx);
                                if cross_indices.len() == 6 {
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        
                        evaluate_sample_outliers(
                            s_idx as u32,
                            &same_indices,
                            &cross_indices,
                            all_samples_ref,
                            global_values_ref,
                            holes_ref,
                            stats_ref,
                            &mut local_suspects,
                        );
                    }
                    local_suspects
                });
                handles.push(handle);
            }
            
            let mut result = Vec::new();
            for h in handles {
                result.extend(h.join().unwrap());
            }
            result
        })
    } else {
        // Hole-partitioned search strategy
        let mut hole_kd_points = Vec::with_capacity(holes.len() * 3);
        for (h_idx, h) in holes.iter().enumerate() {
            let norm = (h.dir_x.powi(2) + h.dir_y.powi(2) + h.dir_z.powi(2)).sqrt();
            let (ux, uy, uz) = if norm > 1e-6 {
                (h.dir_x / norm, h.dir_y / norm, h.dir_z / norm)
            } else {
                (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
            };
            let start = [h.start_x, h.start_y, h.start_z];
            let mid = [
                h.start_x + 0.5 * h.length * ux,
                h.start_y + 0.5 * h.length * uy,
                h.start_z + 0.5 * h.length * uz,
            ];
            let end = [
                h.start_x + h.length * ux,
                h.start_y + h.length * uy,
                h.start_z + h.length * uz,
            ];
            hole_kd_points.push((start, h_idx as u32));
            hole_kd_points.push((mid, h_idx as u32));
            hole_kd_points.push((end, h_idx as u32));
        }
        
        let mut hole_kd_nodes = Vec::with_capacity(hole_kd_points.len());
        let hole_kd_root = build_hole_kd_tree(&mut hole_kd_points, &mut hole_kd_nodes, 0);
        
        std::thread::scope(|s| {
            let mut handles = Vec::new();
            let chunk_size = (holes.len() + num_threads - 1) / num_threads;
            
            for chunk_idx in 0..num_threads {
                let start = chunk_idx * chunk_size;
                let end = (start + chunk_size).min(holes.len());
                if start >= end { continue; }
                
                let hole_kd_nodes_ref = &hole_kd_nodes;
                let all_samples_ref = &all_samples;
                let global_values_ref = &global_values;
                let holes_ref = &holes;
                let stats_ref = &property_stats;
                
                let handle = s.spawn(move || {
                    let mut local_suspects = Vec::new();
                    for h_idx in start..end {
                        let H = &holes_ref[h_idx];
                        let norm = (H.dir_x.powi(2) + H.dir_y.powi(2) + H.dir_z.powi(2)).sqrt();
                        let (ux, uy, uz) = if norm > 1e-6 {
                            (H.dir_x / norm, H.dir_y / norm, H.dir_z / norm)
                        } else {
                            (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
                        };
                        let h_start = [H.start_x, H.start_y, H.start_z];
                        let h_mid = [
                            H.start_x + 0.5 * H.length * ux,
                            H.start_y + 0.5 * H.length * uy,
                            H.start_z + 0.5 * H.length * uz,
                        ];
                        let h_end = [
                            H.start_x + H.length * ux,
                            H.start_y + H.length * uy,
                            H.start_z + H.length * uz,
                        ];
                        
                        let neighbor_holes = get_neighbor_holes(
                            hole_kd_nodes_ref,
                            hole_kd_root,
                            h_idx as u32,
                            h_start,
                            h_mid,
                            h_end,
                        );
                        
                        let mut neighbor_samples = Vec::new();
                        for &nh_idx in &neighbor_holes {
                            let nh = &holes_ref[nh_idx as usize];
                            for s_idx in nh.start_sample_idx..nh.end_sample_idx {
                                let ns = &all_samples_ref[s_idx as usize];
                                neighbor_samples.push((ns.x, ns.y, ns.z, s_idx));
                            }
                        }
                        
                        let has_neighbors = !neighbor_samples.is_empty();
                        
                        let mut local_nodes = Vec::new();
                        let mut local_root = u32::MAX;
                        if neighbor_samples.len() > 128 {
                            let mut local_points: Vec<([f32; 3], u32)> = neighbor_samples
                                .iter()
                                .map(|&(x, y, z, idx)| ([x, y, z], idx))
                                .collect();
                            local_nodes = Vec::with_capacity(local_points.len());
                            local_root = build_kd_tree(&mut local_points, &mut local_nodes, 0);
                        }
                        
                        for s_idx in H.start_sample_idx..H.end_sample_idx {
                            let S = &all_samples_ref[s_idx as usize];
                            let same_indices = get_same_hole_neighbor_indices(S, H);
                            
                            let mut cross_indices = Vec::new();
                            if has_neighbors {
                                let mut heap = BinaryHeap::new();
                                if neighbor_samples.len() <= 128 {
                                    for &(nx, ny, nz, ns_idx) in &neighbor_samples {
                                        let dist_sq = (nx - S.x).powi(2) + (ny - S.y).powi(2) + (nz - S.z).powi(2);
                                        if heap.len() < 6 {
                                            heap.push(HeapElem { dist_sq, idx: ns_idx });
                                        } else if let Some(top) = heap.peek() {
                                            if dist_sq < top.dist_sq {
                                                heap.pop();
                                                heap.push(HeapElem { dist_sq, idx: ns_idx });
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    knn_search(&local_nodes, local_root, [S.x, S.y, S.z], 6, &mut heap, 0);
                                }
                                
                                while let Some(elem) = heap.pop() {
                                    cross_indices.push(elem.idx);
                                }
                            }
                            
                            evaluate_sample_outliers(
                                s_idx,
                                &same_indices,
                                &cross_indices,
                                all_samples_ref,
                                global_values_ref,
                                holes_ref,
                                stats_ref,
                                &mut local_suspects,
                            );
                        }
                    }
                    local_suspects
                });
                handles.push(handle);
            }
            
            let mut result = Vec::new();
            for h in handles {
                result.extend(h.join().unwrap());
            }
            result
        })
    };
    
    // Sort suspects by confidence desc
    all_suspects.sort_by(|a, b| {
        b.confidence.partial_cmp(&a.confidence)
            .unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
            .then_with(|| a.hole_id.cmp(&b.hole_id))
            .then_with(|| a.sample_idx.cmp(&b.sample_idx))
            .then_with(|| a.property_name.cmp(&b.property_name))
    });
    
    // Output results
    println!("{}", all_suspects.len());
    for s in &all_suspects {
        println!("{} {} {} {:.4}", s.hole_id, s.sample_idx, s.property_name, s.confidence);
    }
    
    eprintln!("Processed {} samples in {:?}", total_samples, start_time.elapsed());
    Ok(())
}

width height num_pieces

Write an AI that plays Tetris. Given the current board state and the next piece, choose where to place it to survive as long as possible and clear as many lines as you can. Good play means keeping the board flat, avoiding buried holes, and setting up multi-line clears.

Subpasses increase the board size and speed, demanding smarter lookahead and evaluation. The AI must balance short-term survival with long-term board health.

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

public class Program {
    public struct PieceRotation {
        public int Width;
        public int Height;
        public uint[] RowMasks;
        public int[][] Coords;
    }

    public class Piece {
        public char Type;
        public PieceRotation[] Rotations;
    }

    private static Dictionary<char, Piece> pieces;

    public static void Main(string[] args) {
        // Read header: width height num_pieces
        string headerLine = Console.ReadLine();
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(headerLine)) return;

        string[] headerParts = headerLine.Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        if (headerParts.Length < 3) return;

        int width = int.Parse(headerParts[0]);
        int height = int.Parse(headerParts[1]);
        int numPieces = int.Parse(headerParts[2]);

        pieces = InitPieces();

        // Keep track of the board state
        // Board is represented as an array of uints, where row 0 is bottom
        uint[] board = new uint[height];
        uint[] tempBoard = new uint[height];

        // Adaptive weights based on game complexity (board size and total pieces)
        double wEroded = 3.418;
        double wHoles = 7.899;
        double wWells = 3.385;
        double wRowTrans = 3.217;
        double wColTrans = 9.348;
        double wLandingHeight = 4.500;

        // Marathon mode adjustments
        if (numPieces >= 50000) {
            wHoles = 13.5;
            wWells = 4.5;
            wRowTrans = 3.5;
            wColTrans = 10.5;
        }

        // Wide board adjustments
        if (width >= 20) {
            wRowTrans *= 0.6;
            wColTrans *= 0.6;
        }

        for (int p = 0; p < numPieces; p++) {
            string pieceTypeLine = Console.ReadLine();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(pieceTypeLine)) break;
            
            pieceTypeLine = pieceTypeLine.Trim();
            if (pieceTypeLine.Length == 0) continue;
            char pieceType = pieceTypeLine[0];

            if (!pieces.ContainsKey(pieceType)) {
                // Invalid piece type, default response
                Console.WriteLine("0 0");
                Console.Out.Flush();
                continue;
            }

            // Find optimal move
            int bestRotation = 0;
            int bestColumn = 0;
            double bestScore = double.MinValue;

            Piece piece = pieces[pieceType];

            // Compute current fill ratio of the board
            int currentMaxHeight = 0;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                if (board[r] != 0) {
                    currentMaxHeight = r + 1;
                    break;
                }
            }
            double fillRatio = (double)currentMaxHeight / height;

            // Danger zone adjustments
            double currentWEroded = wEroded;
            double currentWHoles = wHoles;
            double currentWWells = wWells;
            double currentWRowTrans = wRowTrans;
            double currentWColTrans = wColTrans;
            double currentWLandingHeight = wLandingHeight;

            if (fillRatio > 0.6) {
                // Very high stack, play defensively
                currentWLandingHeight = 9.5;
                currentWEroded = 6.0;
                currentWWells = 1.0;
            } else if (fillRatio > 0.4) {
                // Moderately high stack
                currentWLandingHeight = 6.5;
                currentWEroded = 4.5;
                currentWWells = 2.0;
            }

            for (int rot = 0; rot < 4; rot++) {
                PieceRotation rInfo = piece.Rotations[rot];
                int maxCol = width - rInfo.Width;
                for (int col = 0; col <= maxCol; col++) {
                    Array.Copy(board, tempBoard, height);

                    int linesCleared;
                    double landingHeight;
                    int erodedCells;

                    bool success = PlacePiece(tempBoard, height, width, rInfo, col, out linesCleared, out landingHeight, out erodedCells);
                    if (!success) {
                        continue; // Immediate game over
                    }

                    int rowTrans = GetRowTransitions(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int colTrans = GetColTransitions(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int holes = GetHoles(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int wellSum = GetWellSum(tempBoard, height, width);

                    double score = (erodedCells * currentWEroded)
                                 - (holes * currentWHoles)
                                 - (wellSum * currentWWells)
                                 - (rowTrans * currentWRowTrans)
                                 - (colTrans * currentWColTrans)
                                 - (landingHeight * currentWLandingHeight);

                    if (score > bestScore) {
                        bestScore = score;
                        bestRotation = rot;
                        bestColumn = col;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (bestScore == double.MinValue) {
                // No moves found that avoid immediate game over
                bestRotation = 0;
                bestColumn = Math.Max(0, (width - piece.Rotations[0].Width) / 2);
            }

            // Output rotation and column
            Console.WriteLine($"{bestRotation} {bestColumn}");
            Console.Out.Flush();

            // Read result from simulator
            string result = Console.ReadLine();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(result)) break;
            result = result.Trim();

            if (result == "gameover") {
                break;
            }

            // Update our internal board state with the chosen move
            int dummy1, dummy3;
            double dummy2;
            PlacePiece(board, height, width, piece.Rotations[bestRotation], bestColumn, out dummy1, out dummy2, out dummy3);
        }
    }

    private static int FindLandingRow(uint[] board, int height, int width, PieceRotation rotation, int col) {
        for (int startRow = height - 1; startRow >= 0; startRow--) {
            bool canPlaceHere = true;
            for (int r = 0; r < rotation.Height; r++) {
                int boardRow = startRow + r;
                if (boardRow < 0) {
                    canPlaceHere = false;
                    break;
                }
                if (boardRow < height) {
                    uint pieceRowMask = rotation.RowMasks[r] << col;
                    if ((board[boardRow] & pieceRowMask) != 0) {
                        canPlaceHere = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!canPlaceHere) {
                return startRow + 1;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    private static bool PlacePiece(uint[] board, int height, int width, PieceRotation rotation, int col, out int linesCleared, out double landingHeight, out int erodedCells) {
        linesCleared = 0;
        landingHeight = 0;
        erodedCells = 0;

        int landingRow = FindLandingRow(board, height, width, rotation, col);

        // Place the piece
        for (int r = 0; r < rotation.Height; r++) {
            int boardRow = landingRow + r;
            if (boardRow >= height) {
                return false; // GameOver
            }
            uint pieceRowMask = rotation.RowMasks[r] << col;
            board[boardRow] |= pieceRowMask;
        }

        // Calculate landing height
        double sumRow = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < rotation.Coords.Length; i++) {
            sumRow += landingRow + rotation.Coords[i][0];
        }
        landingHeight = sumRow / rotation.Coords.Length;

        // Check for line clears and eroded cells
        uint fullRowMask = (1u << width) - 1;
        int clearedCount = 0;
        int pieceBlocksInCleared = 0;

        for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
            if (board[r] == fullRowMask) {
                clearedCount++;
                if (r >= landingRow && r < landingRow + rotation.Height) {
                    pieceBlocksInCleared += PopCount(rotation.RowMasks[r - landingRow]);
                }
            }
        }

        erodedCells = clearedCount * pieceBlocksInCleared;
        linesCleared = clearedCount;

        // Perform row deletion
        if (clearedCount > 0) {
            int writeIdx = 0;
            for (int readIdx = 0; readIdx < height; readIdx++) {
                if (board[readIdx] != fullRowMask) {
                    board[writeIdx] = board[readIdx];
                    writeIdx++;
                }
            }
            while (writeIdx < height) {
                board[writeIdx] = 0;
                writeIdx++;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static int PopCount(uint x) {
        x = x - ((x >> 1) & 0x55555555);
        x = (x & 0x33333333) + ((x >> 2) & 0x33333333);
        return (int)((((x + (x >> 4)) & 0x0F0F0F0F) * 0x01010101) >> 24);
    }

    private static int GetRowTransitions(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int transitions = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
            uint row = board[r];
            uint prevBit = 1; // Left wall is occupied
            for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
                uint bit = (row >> c) & 1u;
                if (bit != prevBit) {
                    transitions++;
                }
                prevBit = bit;
            }
            if (prevBit != 1) {
                transitions++; // Transition to right wall (occupied)
            }
        }
        return transitions;
    }

    private static int GetColTransitions(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int transitions = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            uint prevBit = 1; // Bottom wall is occupied
            for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
                uint bit = (board[r] >> c) & 1u;
                if (bit != prevBit) {
                    transitions++;
                }
                prevBit = bit;
            }
            if (prevBit != 0) {
                transitions++; // Transition to empty space above
            }
        }
        return transitions;
    }

    private static int GetHoles(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int holes = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            bool foundBlock = false;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                bool occupied = ((board[r] >> c) & 1u) != 0;
                if (occupied) {
                    foundBlock = true;
                } else if (foundBlock) {
                    holes++;
                }
            }
        }
        return holes;
    }

    private static int GetWellSum(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int wellSum = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            int depth = 0;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                bool occupied = ((board[r] >> c) & 1u) != 0;
                if (!occupied) {
                    bool leftOccupied = (c == 0) || (((board[r] >> (c - 1)) & 1u) != 0);
                    bool rightOccupied = (c == width - 1) || (((board[r] >> (c + 1)) & 1u) != 0);
                    if (leftOccupied && rightOccupied) {
                        depth++;
                        wellSum += depth;
                    } else {
                        depth = 0;
                    }
                } else {
                    depth = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        return wellSum;
    }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

public class Program {
    public struct PieceRotation {
        public int Width;
        public int Height;
        public uint[] RowMasks;
        public int[][] Coords;
    }

    public class Piece {
        public char Type;
        public PieceRotation[] Rotations;
    }

    private static Dictionary<char, Piece> pieces;

    public static void Main(string[] args) {
        // Read header: width height num_pieces
        string headerLine = Console.ReadLine();
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(headerLine)) return;

        string[] headerParts = headerLine.Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        if (headerParts.Length < 3) return;

        int width = int.Parse(headerParts[0]);
        int height = int.Parse(headerParts[1]);
        int numPieces = int.Parse(headerParts[2]);

        pieces = InitPieces();

        // Keep track of the board state
        // Board is represented as an array of uints, where row 0 is bottom
        uint[] board = new uint[height];
        uint[] tempBoard = new uint[height];

        // Adaptive weights based on game complexity (board size and total pieces)
        double wEroded = 3.418;
        double wHoles = 7.899;
        double wWells = 3.385;
        double wRowTrans = 3.217;
        double wColTrans = 9.348;
        double wLandingHeight = 4.500;

        // Marathon mode adjustments
        if (numPieces >= 50000) {
            wHoles = 13.5;
            wWells = 4.5;
            wRowTrans = 3.5;
            wColTrans = 10.5;
        }

        // Wide board adjustments
        if (width >= 20) {
            wRowTrans *= 0.6;
            wColTrans *= 0.6;
        }

        for (int p = 0; p < numPieces; p++) {
            string pieceTypeLine = Console.ReadLine();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(pieceTypeLine)) break;
            
            pieceTypeLine = pieceTypeLine.Trim();
            if (pieceTypeLine.Length == 0) continue;
            char pieceType = pieceTypeLine[0];

            if (!pieces.ContainsKey(pieceType)) {
                // Invalid piece type, default response
                Console.WriteLine("0 0");
                Console.Out.Flush();
                continue;
            }

            // Find optimal move
            int bestRotation = 0;
            int bestColumn = 0;
            double bestScore = double.MinValue;

            Piece piece = pieces[pieceType];

            // Compute current fill ratio of the board
            int currentMaxHeight = 0;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                if (board[r] != 0) {
                    currentMaxHeight = r + 1;
                    break;
                }
            }
            double fillRatio = (double)currentMaxHeight / height;

            // Danger zone adjustments
            double currentWEroded = wEroded;
            double currentWHoles = wHoles;
            double currentWWells = wWells;
            double currentWRowTrans = wRowTrans;
            double currentWColTrans = wColTrans;
            double currentWLandingHeight = wLandingHeight;

            if (fillRatio > 0.6) {
                // Very high stack, play defensively
                currentWLandingHeight = 9.5;
                currentWEroded = 6.0;
                currentWWells = 1.0;
            } else if (fillRatio > 0.4) {
                // Moderately high stack
                currentWLandingHeight = 6.5;
                currentWEroded = 4.5;
                currentWWells = 2.0;
            }

            for (int rot = 0; rot < 4; rot++) {
                PieceRotation rInfo = piece.Rotations[rot];
                int maxCol = width - rInfo.Width;
                for (int col = 0; col <= maxCol; col++) {
                    Array.Copy(board, tempBoard, height);

                    int linesCleared;
                    double landingHeight;
                    int erodedCells;

                    bool success = PlacePiece(tempBoard, height, width, rInfo, col, out linesCleared, out landingHeight, out erodedCells);
                    if (!success) {
                        continue; // Immediate game over
                    }

                    int rowTrans = GetRowTransitions(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int colTrans = GetColTransitions(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int holes = GetHoles(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int wellSum = GetWellSum(tempBoard, height, width);

                    double score = (erodedCells * currentWEroded)
                                 - (holes * currentWHoles)
                                 - (wellSum * currentWWells)
                                 - (rowTrans * currentWRowTrans)
                                 - (colTrans * currentWColTrans)
                                 - (landingHeight * currentWLandingHeight);

                    if (score > bestScore) {
                        bestScore = score;
                        bestRotation = rot;
                        bestColumn = col;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (bestScore == double.MinValue) {
                // No moves found that avoid immediate game over
                bestRotation = 0;
                bestColumn = Math.Max(0, (width - piece.Rotations[0].Width) / 2);
            }

            // Output rotation and column
            Console.WriteLine($"{bestRotation} {bestColumn}");
            Console.Out.Flush();

            // Read result from simulator
            string result = Console.ReadLine();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(result)) break;
            result = result.Trim();

            if (result == "gameover") {
                break;
            }

            // Update our internal board state with the chosen move
            int dummy1, dummy3;
            double dummy2;
            PlacePiece(board, height, width, piece.Rotations[bestRotation], bestColumn, out dummy1, out dummy2, out dummy3);
        }
    }

    private static int FindLandingRow(uint[] board, int height, int width, PieceRotation rotation, int col) {
        for (int startRow = height - 1; startRow >= 0; startRow--) {
            bool canPlaceHere = true;
            for (int r = 0; r < rotation.Height; r++) {
                int boardRow = startRow + r;
                if (boardRow < 0) {
                    canPlaceHere = false;
                    break;
                }
                if (boardRow < height) {
                    uint pieceRowMask = rotation.RowMasks[r] << col;
                    if ((board[boardRow] & pieceRowMask) != 0) {
                        canPlaceHere = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!canPlaceHere) {
                return startRow + 1;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    private static bool PlacePiece(uint[] board, int height, int width, PieceRotation rotation, int col, out int linesCleared, out double landingHeight, out int erodedCells) {
        linesCleared = 0;
        landingHeight = 0;
        erodedCells = 0;

        int landingRow = FindLandingRow(board, height, width, rotation, col);

        // Place the piece
        for (int r = 0; r < rotation.Height; r++) {
            int boardRow = landingRow + r;
            if (boardRow >= height) {
                return false; // GameOver
            }
            uint pieceRowMask = rotation.RowMasks[r] << col;
            board[boardRow] |= pieceRowMask;
        }

        // Calculate landing height
        double sumRow = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < rotation.Coords.Length; i++) {
            sumRow += landingRow + rotation.Coords[i][0];
        }
        landingHeight = sumRow / rotation.Coords.Length;

        // Check for line clears and eroded cells
        uint fullRowMask = (1u << width) - 1;
        int clearedCount = 0;
        int pieceBlocksInCleared = 0;

        for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
            if (board[r] == fullRowMask) {
                clearedCount++;
                if (r >= landingRow && r < landingRow + rotation.Height) {
                    pieceBlocksInCleared += PopCount(rotation.RowMasks[r - landingRow]);
                }
            }
        }

        erodedCells = clearedCount * pieceBlocksInCleared;
        linesCleared = clearedCount;

        // Perform row deletion
        if (clearedCount > 0) {
            int writeIdx = 0;
            for (int readIdx = 0; readIdx < height; readIdx++) {
                if (board[readIdx] != fullRowMask) {
                    board[writeIdx] = board[readIdx];
                    writeIdx++;
                }
            }
            while (writeIdx < height) {
                board[writeIdx] = 0;
                writeIdx++;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static int PopCount(uint x) {
        x = x - ((x >> 1) & 0x55555555);
        x = (x & 0x33333333) + ((x >> 2) & 0x33333333);
        return (int)((((x + (x >> 4)) & 0x0F0F0F0F) * 0x01010101) >> 24);
    }

    private static int GetRowTransitions(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int transitions = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
            uint row = board[r];
            uint prevBit = 1; // Left wall is occupied
            for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
                uint bit = (row >> c) & 1u;
                if (bit != prevBit) {
                    transitions++;
                }
                prevBit = bit;
            }
            if (prevBit != 1) {
                transitions++; // Transition to right wall (occupied)
            }
        }
        return transitions;
    }

    private static int GetColTransitions(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int transitions = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            uint prevBit = 1; // Bottom wall is occupied
            for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
                uint bit = (board[r] >> c) & 1u;
                if (bit != prevBit) {
                    transitions++;
                }
                prevBit = bit;
            }
            if (prevBit != 0) {
                transitions++; // Transition to empty space above
            }
        }
        return transitions;
    }

    private static int GetHoles(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int holes = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            bool foundBlock = false;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                bool occupied = ((board[r] >> c) & 1u) != 0;
                if (occupied) {
                    foundBlock = true;
                } else if (foundBlock) {
                    holes++;
                }
            }
        }
        return holes;
    }

    private static int GetWellSum(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int wellSum = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            int depth = 0;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                bool occupied = ((board[r] >> c) & 1u) != 0;
                if (!occupied) {
                    bool leftOccupied = (c == 0) || (((board[r] >> (c - 1)) & 1u) != 0);
                    bool rightOccupied = (c == width - 1) || (((board[r] >> (c + 1)) & 1u) != 0);
                    if (leftOccupied && rightOccupied) {
                        depth++;
                        wellSum += depth;
                    } else {
                        depth = 0;
                    }
                } else {
                    depth = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        return wellSum;
    }

        var pieces = new Dictionary<char, Piece>();

                    int erodedCells;

                    bool success = PlacePiece(tempBoard, height, width, rInfo, col, out linesCleared, out landingHeight, out erodedCells);
                    if (!success) {
                        continue; // Immediate game over
                    }

                    int rowTrans = GetRowTransitions(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int colTrans = GetColTransitions(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int holes = GetHoles(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int wellSum = GetWellSum(tempBoard, height, width);

                    double score = (erodedCells * currentWEroded)
                                 - (holes * currentWHoles)
                                 - (wellSum * currentWWells)
                                 - (rowTrans * currentWRowTrans)
                                 - (colTrans * currentWColTrans)
                                 - (landingHeight * currentWLandingHeight);

                    if (score > bestScore) {
                        bestScore = score;
                        bestRotation = rot;
                        bestColumn = col;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (bestScore == double.MinValue) {
                // No moves found that avoid immediate game over
                bestRotation = 0;
                bestColumn = Math.Max(0, (width - piece.Rotations[0].Width) / 2);
            }

            // Output rotation and column
            Console.WriteLine($"{bestRotation} {bestColumn}");
            Console.Out.Flush();

            // Read result from simulator
            string result = Console.ReadLine();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(result)) break;
            result = result.Trim();

            if (result == "gameover") {
                break;
            }

            // Update our internal board state with the chosen move
            int dummy1, dummy3;
            double dummy2;
            PlacePiece(board, height, width, piece.Rotations[bestRotation], bestColumn, out dummy1, out dummy2, out dummy3);
        }
    }

    private static int FindLandingRow(uint[] board, int height, int width, PieceRotation rotation, int col) {
        for (int startRow = height - 1; startRow >= 0; startRow--) {
            bool canPlaceHere = true;
            for (int r = 0; r < rotation.Height; r++) {
                int boardRow = startRow + r;
                if (boardRow < 0) {
                    canPlaceHere = false;
                    break;
                }
                if (boardRow < height) {
                    uint pieceRowMask = rotation.RowMasks[r] << col;
                    if ((board[boardRow] & pieceRowMask) != 0) {
                        canPlaceHere = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!canPlaceHere) {
                return startRow + 1;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    private static bool PlacePiece(uint[] board, int height, int width, PieceRotation rotation, int col, out int linesCleared, out double landingHeight, out int erodedCells) {
        linesCleared = 0;
        landingHeight = 0;
        erodedCells = 0;

        int landingRow = FindLandingRow(board, height, width, rotation, col);

        // Place the piece
        for (int r = 0; r < rotation.Height; r++) {
            int boardRow = landingRow + r;
            if (boardRow >= height) {
                return false; // GameOver
            }
            uint pieceRowMask = rotation.RowMasks[r] << col;
            board[boardRow] |= pieceRowMask;
        }

        // Calculate landing height
        double sumRow = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < rotation.Coords.Length; i++) {
            sumRow += landingRow + rotation.Coords[i][0];
        }
        landingHeight = sumRow / rotation.Coords.Length;

        // Check for line clears and eroded cells
        uint fullRowMask = (1u << width) - 1;
        int clearedCount = 0;
        int pieceBlocksInCleared = 0;

        for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
            if (board[r] == fullRowMask) {
                clearedCount++;
                if (r >= landingRow && r < landingRow + rotation.Height) {
                    pieceBlocksInCleared += PopCount(rotation.RowMasks[r - landingRow]);
                }
            }
        }

        erodedCells = clearedCount * pieceBlocksInCleared;
        linesCleared = clearedCount;

        // Perform row deletion
        if (clearedCount > 0) {
            int writeIdx = 0;
            for (int readIdx = 0; readIdx < height; readIdx++) {
                if (board[readIdx] != fullRowMask) {
                    board[writeIdx] = board[readIdx];
                    writeIdx++;
                }
            }
            while (writeIdx < height) {
                board[writeIdx] = 0;
                writeIdx++;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static int PopCount(uint x) {
        x = x - ((x >> 1) & 0x55555555);
        x = (x & 0x33333333) + ((x >> 2) & 0x33333333);
        return (int)((((x + (x >> 4)) & 0x0F0F0F0F) * 0x01010101) >> 24);
    }

    private static int GetRowTransitions(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int transitions = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
            uint row = board[r];
            uint prevBit = 1; // Left wall is occupied
            for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
                uint bit = (row >> c) & 1u;
                if (bit != prevBit) {
                    transitions++;
                }
                prevBit = bit;
            }
            if (prevBit != 1) {
                transitions++; // Transition to right wall (occupied)
            }
        }
        return transitions;
    }

    private static int GetColTransitions(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int transitions = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            uint prevBit = 1; // Bottom wall is occupied
            for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
                uint bit = (board[r] >> c) & 1u;
                if (bit != prevBit) {
                    transitions++;
                }
                prevBit = bit;
            }
            if (prevBit != 0) {
                transitions++; // Transition to empty space above
            }
        }
        return transitions;
    }

    private static int GetHoles(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int holes = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            bool foundBlock = false;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                bool occupied = ((board[r] >> c) & 1u) != 0;
                if (occupied) {
                    foundBlock = true;
                } else if (foundBlock) {
                    holes++;
                }
            }
        }
        return holes;
    }

    private static int GetWellSum(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int wellSum = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            int depth = 0;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                bool occupied = ((board[r] >> c) & 1u) != 0;
                if (!occupied) {
                    bool leftOccupied = (c == 0) || (((board[r] >> (c - 1)) & 1u) != 0);
                    bool rightOccupied = (c == width - 1) || (((board[r] >> (c + 1)) & 1u) != 0);
                    if (leftOccupied && rightOccupied) {
                        depth++;
                        wellSum += depth;
                    } else {
                        depth = 0;
                    }
                } else {
                    depth = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        return wellSum;
    }

                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {1,1}, new int[] {2,1} }
            }}
        };

        foreach (var kvp in rawCoords) {
            var piece = new Piece {
                Type = kvp.Key,
                Rotations = new PieceRotation[4]
            };
            for (int rot = 0; rot < 4; rot++) {
                var coords = kvp.Value[rot];
                int maxRow = 0;
                int maxCol = 0;
                foreach (var c in coords) {
                    if (c[0] > maxRow) maxRow = c[0];
                    if (c[1] > maxCol) maxCol = c[1];
                }
                int height = maxRow + 1;
                int width = maxCol + 1;
                var rowMasks = new uint[height];
                foreach (var c in coords) {
                    rowMasks[c[0]] |= (1u << c[1]);
                }
                piece.Rotations[rot] = new PieceRotation {
                    Width = width,
                    Height = height,
                    RowMasks = rowMasks,
                    Coords = coords
                };
            }
            pieces[kvp.Key] = piece;
        }
        return pieces;
    }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

public class Program {
    public struct PieceRotation {
        public int Width;
        public int Height;
        public uint[] RowMasks;
        public int[][] Coords;
    }

    public class Piece {
        public char Type;
        public PieceRotation[] Rotations;
    }

    private static Dictionary<char, Piece> pieces;

    public static void Main(string[] args) {
        // Read header: width height num_pieces
        string headerLine = Console.ReadLine();
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(headerLine)) return;

        string[] headerParts = headerLine.Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        if (headerParts.Length < 3) return;

        int width = int.Parse(headerParts[0]);
        int height = int.Parse(headerParts[1]);
        int numPieces = int.Parse(headerParts[2]);

        pieces = InitPieces();

        // Keep track of the board state
        // Board is represented as an array of uints, where row 0 is bottom
        uint[] board = new uint[height];
        uint[] tempBoard = new uint[height];

        // Adaptive weights based on game complexity (board size and total pieces)
        double wEroded = 3.418;
        double wHoles = 7.899;
        double wWells = 3.385;
        double wRowTrans = 3.217;
        double wColTrans = 9.348;
        double wLandingHeight = 4.500;

        // Marathon mode adjustments
        if (numPieces >= 50000) {
            wHoles = 13.5;
            wWells = 4.5;
            wRowTrans = 3.5;
            wColTrans = 10.5;
        }

        // Wide board adjustments
        if (width >= 20) {
            wRowTrans *= 0.6;
            wColTrans *= 0.6;
        }

        for (int p = 0; p < numPieces; p++) {
            string pieceTypeLine = Console.ReadLine();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(pieceTypeLine)) break;
            
            pieceTypeLine = pieceTypeLine.Trim();
            if (pieceTypeLine.Length == 0) continue;
            char pieceType = pieceTypeLine[0];

            if (!pieces.ContainsKey(pieceType)) {
                // Invalid piece type, default response
                Console.WriteLine("0 0");
                Console.Out.Flush();
                continue;
            }

            // Find optimal move
            int bestRotation = 0;
            int bestColumn = 0;
            double bestScore = double.MinValue;

            Piece piece = pieces[pieceType];

            // Compute current fill ratio of the board
            int currentMaxHeight = 0;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                if (board[r] != 0) {
                    currentMaxHeight = r + 1;
                    break;
                }
            }
            double fillRatio = (double)currentMaxHeight / height;

            // Danger zone adjustments
            double currentWEroded = wEroded;
            double currentWHoles = wHoles;
            double currentWWells = wWells;
            double currentWRowTrans = wRowTrans;
            double currentWColTrans = wColTrans;
            double currentWLandingHeight = wLandingHeight;

            if (fillRatio > 0.6) {
                // Very high stack, play defensively
                currentWLandingHeight = 9.5;
                currentWEroded = 6.0;
                currentWWells = 1.0;
            } else if (fillRatio > 0.4) {
                // Moderately high stack
                currentWLandingHeight = 6.5;
                currentWEroded = 4.5;
                currentWWells = 2.0;
            }

            for (int rot = 0; rot < 4; rot++) {
                PieceRotation rInfo = piece.Rotations[rot];
                int maxCol = width - rInfo.Width;
                for (int col = 0; col <= maxCol; col++) {
                    Array.Copy(board, tempBoard, height);

                    int linesCleared;
                    double landingHeight;
                    int erodedCells;

                    bool success = PlacePiece(tempBoard, height, width, rInfo, col, out linesCleared, out landingHeight, out erodedCells);
                    if (!success) {
                        continue; // Immediate game over
                    }

                    int rowTrans = GetRowTransitions(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int colTrans = GetColTransitions(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int holes = GetHoles(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int wellSum = GetWellSum(tempBoard, height, width);

                    double score = (erodedCells * currentWEroded)
                                 - (holes * currentWHoles)
                                 - (wellSum * currentWWells)
                                 - (rowTrans * currentWRowTrans)
                                 - (colTrans * currentWColTrans)
                                 - (landingHeight * currentWLandingHeight);

                    if (score > bestScore) {
                        bestScore = score;
                        bestRotation = rot;
                        bestColumn = col;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (bestScore == double.MinValue) {
                // No moves found that avoid immediate game over
                bestRotation = 0;
                bestColumn = Math.Max(0, (width - piece.Rotations[0].Width) / 2);
            }

            // Output rotation and column
            Console.WriteLine($"{bestRotation} {bestColumn}");
            Console.Out.Flush();

            // Read result from simulator
            string result = Console.ReadLine();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(result)) break;
            result = result.Trim();

            if (result == "gameover") {
                break;
            }

            // Update our internal board state with the chosen move
            int dummy1, dummy3;
            double dummy2;
            PlacePiece(board, height, width, piece.Rotations[bestRotation], bestColumn, out dummy1, out dummy2, out dummy3);
        }
    }

        foreach (var kvp in rawCoords) {

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

public class Program {
    public struct PieceRotation {
        public int Width;
        public int Height;
        public uint[] RowMasks;
        public int[][] Coords;
    }

    public class Piece {
        public char Type;
        public PieceRotation[] Rotations;
    }

    private static Dictionary<char, Piece> pieces;

    public static void Main(string[] args) {
        // Read header: width height num_pieces
        string headerLine = Console.ReadLine();
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(headerLine)) return;

        string[] headerParts = headerLine.Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        if (headerParts.Length < 3) return;

        int width = int.Parse(headerParts[0]);
        int height = int.Parse(headerParts[1]);
        int numPieces = int.Parse(headerParts[2]);

        pieces = InitPieces();

        // Keep track of the board state
        // Board is represented as an array of uints, where row 0 is bottom
        uint[] board = new uint[height];
        uint[] tempBoard = new uint[height];

        // Adaptive weights based on game complexity (board size and total pieces)
        double wEroded = 3.418;
        double wHoles = 7.899;
        double wWells = 3.385;
        double wRowTrans = 3.217;
        double wColTrans = 9.348;
        double wLandingHeight = 4.500;

        // Marathon mode adjustments
        if (numPieces >= 50000) {
            wHoles = 13.5;
            wWells = 4.5;
            wRowTrans = 3.5;
            wColTrans = 10.5;
        }

        // Wide board adjustments
        if (width >= 20) {
            wRowTrans *= 0.6;
            wColTrans *= 0.6;
        }

        for (int p = 0; p < numPieces; p++) {
            string pieceTypeLine = Console.ReadLine();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(pieceTypeLine)) break;
            
            pieceTypeLine = pieceTypeLine.Trim();
            if (pieceTypeLine.Length == 0) continue;
            char pieceType = pieceTypeLine[0];

            if (!pieces.ContainsKey(pieceType)) {
                // Invalid piece type, default response
                Console.WriteLine("0 0");
                Console.Out.Flush();
                continue;
            }

            // Find optimal move
            int bestRotation = 0;
            int bestColumn = 0;
            double bestScore = double.MinValue;

            Piece piece = pieces[pieceType];

            // Compute current fill ratio of the board
            int currentMaxHeight = 0;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                if (board[r] != 0) {
                    currentMaxHeight = r + 1;
                    break;
                }
            }
            double fillRatio = (double)currentMaxHeight / height;

            // Danger zone adjustments
            double currentWEroded = wEroded;
            double currentWHoles = wHoles;
            double currentWWells = wWells;
            double currentWRowTrans = wRowTrans;
            double currentWColTrans = wColTrans;
            double currentWLandingHeight = wLandingHeight;

            if (fillRatio > 0.6) {
                // Very high stack, play defensively
                currentWLandingHeight = 9.5;
                currentWEroded = 6.0;
                currentWWells = 1.0;
            } else if (fillRatio > 0.4) {
                // Moderately high stack
                currentWLandingHeight = 6.5;
                currentWEroded = 4.5;
                currentWWells = 2.0;
            }

            for (int rot = 0; rot < 4; rot++) {
                PieceRotation rInfo = piece.Rotations[rot];
                int maxCol = width - rInfo.Width;
                for (int col = 0; col <= maxCol; col++) {
                    Array.Copy(board, tempBoard, height);

                    int linesCleared;
                    double landingHeight;
                    int erodedCells;

                    bool success = PlacePiece(tempBoard, height, width, rInfo, col, out linesCleared, out landingHeight, out erodedCells);
                    if (!success) {
                        continue; // Immediate game over
                    }

                    int rowTrans = GetRowTransitions(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int colTrans = GetColTransitions(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int holes = GetHoles(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int wellSum = GetWellSum(tempBoard, height, width);

                    double score = (erodedCells * currentWEroded)
                                 - (holes * currentWHoles)
                                 - (wellSum * currentWWells)
                                 - (rowTrans * currentWRowTrans)
                                 - (colTrans * currentWColTrans)
                                 - (landingHeight * currentWLandingHeight);

                    if (score > bestScore) {
                        bestScore = score;
                        bestRotation = rot;
                        bestColumn = col;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (bestScore == double.MinValue) {
                // No moves found that avoid immediate game over
                bestRotation = 0;
                bestColumn = Math.Max(0, (width - piece.Rotations[0].Width) / 2);
            }

            // Output rotation and column
            Console.WriteLine($"{bestRotation} {bestColumn}");
            Console.Out.Flush();

            // Read result from simulator
            string result = Console.ReadLine();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(result)) break;
            result = result.Trim();

            if (result == "gameover") {
                break;
            }

            // Update our internal board state with the chosen move
            int dummy1, dummy3;
            double dummy2;
            PlacePiece(board, height, width, piece.Rotations[bestRotation], bestColumn, out dummy1, out dummy2, out dummy3);
        }
    }

    private static int FindLandingRow(uint[] board, int height, int width, PieceRotation rotation, int col) {
        for (int startRow = height - 1; startRow >= 0; startRow--) {
            bool canPlaceHere = true;
            for (int r = 0; r < rotation.Height; r++) {
                int boardRow = startRow + r;
                if (boardRow < 0) {
                    canPlaceHere = false;
                    break;
                }
                if (boardRow < height) {
                    uint pieceRowMask = rotation.RowMasks[r] << col;
                    if ((board[boardRow] & pieceRowMask) != 0) {
                        canPlaceHere = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!canPlaceHere) {
                return startRow + 1;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    private static bool PlacePiece(uint[] board, int height, int width, PieceRotation rotation, int col, out int linesCleared, out double landingHeight, out int erodedCells) {
        linesCleared = 0;
        landingHeight = 0;
        erodedCells = 0;

        int landingRow = FindLandingRow(board, height, width, rotation, col);

        // Place the piece
        for (int r = 0; r < rotation.Height; r++) {
            int boardRow = landingRow + r;
            if (boardRow >= height) {
                return false; // GameOver
            }
            uint pieceRowMask = rotation.RowMasks[r] << col;
            board[boardRow] |= pieceRowMask;
        }

        // Calculate landing height
        double sumRow = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < rotation.Coords.Length; i++) {
            sumRow += landingRow + rotation.Coords[i][0];
        }
        landingHeight = sumRow / rotation.Coords.Length;

        // Check for line clears and eroded cells
        uint fullRowMask = (1u << width) - 1;
        int clearedCount = 0;
        int pieceBlocksInCleared = 0;

        for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
            if (board[r] == fullRowMask) {
                clearedCount++;
                if (r >= landingRow && r < landingRow + rotation.Height) {
                    pieceBlocksInCleared += PopCount(rotation.RowMasks[r - landingRow]);
                }
            }
        }

        erodedCells = clearedCount * pieceBlocksInCleared;
        linesCleared = clearedCount;

        // Perform row deletion
        if (clearedCount > 0) {
            int writeIdx = 0;
            for (int readIdx = 0; readIdx < height; readIdx++) {
                if (board[readIdx] != fullRowMask) {
                    board[writeIdx] = board[readIdx];
                    writeIdx++;
                }
            }
            while (writeIdx < height) {
                board[writeIdx] = 0;
                writeIdx++;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static int PopCount(uint x) {
        x = x - ((x >> 1) & 0x55555555);
        x = (x & 0x33333333) + ((x >> 2) & 0x33333333);
        return (int)((((x + (x >> 4)) & 0x0F0F0F0F) * 0x01010101) >> 24);
    }

    private static int GetRowTransitions(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int transitions = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
            uint row = board[r];
            uint prevBit = 1; // Left wall is occupied
            for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
                uint bit = (row >> c) & 1u;
                if (bit != prevBit) {
                    transitions++;
                }
                prevBit = bit;
            }
            if (prevBit != 1) {
                transitions++; // Transition to right wall (occupied)
            }
        }
        return transitions;
    }

    private static int GetColTransitions(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int transitions = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            uint prevBit = 1; // Bottom wall is occupied
            for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
                uint bit = (board[r] >> c) & 1u;
                if (bit != prevBit) {
                    transitions++;
                }
                prevBit = bit;
            }
            if (prevBit != 0) {
                transitions++; // Transition to empty space above
            }
        }
        return transitions;
    }

    private static int GetHoles(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int holes = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            bool foundBlock = false;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                bool occupied = ((board[r] >> c) & 1u) != 0;
                if (occupied) {
                    foundBlock = true;
                } else if (foundBlock) {
                    holes++;
                }
            }
        }
        return holes;
    }

    private static int GetWellSum(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int wellSum = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            int depth = 0;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                bool occupied = ((board[r] >> c) & 1u) != 0;
                if (!occupied) {
                    bool leftOccupied = (c == 0) || (((board[r] >> (c - 1)) & 1u) != 0);
                    bool rightOccupied = (c == width - 1) || (((board[r] >> (c + 1)) & 1u) != 0);
                    if (leftOccupied && rightOccupied) {
                        depth++;
                        wellSum += depth;
                    } else {
                        depth = 0;
                    }
                } else {
                    depth = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        return wellSum;
    }
