        int landingRow = FindLandingRow(board, height, width, rotation, col);

        // Place the piece
        for (int r = 0; r < rotation.Height; r++) {
            int boardRow = landingRow + r;
            if (boardRow >= height) {
                return false; // GameOver
            }
            uint pieceRowMask = rotation.RowMasks[r] << col;
            board[boardRow] |= pieceRowMask;
        }

        // Calculate landing height
        double sumRow = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < rotation.Coords.Length; i++) {
            sumRow += landingRow + rotation.Coords[i][0];
        }
        landingHeight = sumRow / rotation.Coords.Length;

        // Check for line clears and eroded cells
        uint fullRowMask = (1u << width) - 1;
        int clearedCount = 0;
        int pieceBlocksInCleared = 0;

        for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
            if (board[r] == fullRowMask) {
                clearedCount++;
                if (r >= landingRow && r < landingRow + rotation.Height) {
                    pieceBlocksInCleared += PopCount(rotation.RowMasks[r - landingRow]);
                }
            }
        }

        erodedCells = clearedCount * pieceBlocksInCleared;
        linesCleared = clearedCount;

        // Perform row deletion
        if (clearedCount > 0) {
            int writeIdx = 0;
            for (int readIdx = 0; readIdx < height; readIdx++) {
                if (board[readIdx] != fullRowMask) {
                    board[writeIdx] = board[readIdx];
                    writeIdx++;
                }
            }
            while (writeIdx < height) {
                board[writeIdx] = 0;
                writeIdx++;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static int PopCount(uint x) {
        x = x - ((x >> 1) & 0x55555555);
        x = (x & 0x33333333) + ((x >> 2) & 0x33333333);
        return (int)((((x + (x >> 4)) & 0x0F0F0F0F) * 0x01010101) >> 24);
    }

    private static int GetRowTransitions(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int transitions = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
            uint row = board[r];
            uint prevBit = 1; // Left wall is occupied
            for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
                uint bit = (row >> c) & 1u;
                if (bit != prevBit) {
                    transitions++;
                }
                prevBit = bit;
            }
            if (prevBit != 1) {
                transitions++; // Transition to right wall (occupied)
            }
        }
        return transitions;
    }

    private static int GetColTransitions(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int transitions = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            uint prevBit = 1; // Bottom wall is occupied
            for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
                uint bit = (board[r] >> c) & 1u;
                if (bit != prevBit) {
                    transitions++;
                }
                prevBit = bit;
            }
            if (prevBit != 0) {
                transitions++; // Transition to empty space above
            }
        }
        return transitions;
    }

    private static int GetHoles(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int holes = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            bool foundBlock = false;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                bool occupied = ((board[r] >> c) & 1u) != 0;
                if (occupied) {
                    foundBlock = true;
                } else if (foundBlock) {
                    holes++;
                }
            }
        }
        return holes;
    }

    private static int GetWellSum(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int wellSum = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            int depth = 0;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                bool occupied = ((board[r] >> c) & 1u) != 0;
                if (!occupied) {
                    bool leftOccupied = (c == 0) || (((board[r] >> (c - 1)) & 1u) != 0);
                    bool rightOccupied = (c == width - 1) || (((board[r] >> (c + 1)) & 1u) != 0);
                    if (leftOccupied && rightOccupied) {
                        depth++;
                        wellSum += depth;
                    } else {
                        depth = 0;
                    }
                } else {
                    depth = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        return wellSum;
    }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

public class Program {
    public struct PieceRotation {
        public int Width;
        public int Height;
        public uint[] RowMasks;
        public int[][] Coords;
    }

    public class Piece {
        public char Type;
        public PieceRotation[] Rotations;
    }

    private static Dictionary<char, Piece> pieces;

    public static void Main(string[] args) {
        // Read header: width height num_pieces
        string headerLine = Console.ReadLine();
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(headerLine)) return;

        string[] headerParts = headerLine.Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        if (headerParts.Length < 3) return;

        int width = int.Parse(headerParts[0]);
        int height = int.Parse(headerParts[1]);
        int numPieces = int.Parse(headerParts[2]);

        pieces = InitPieces();

        // Keep track of the board state
        // Board is represented as an array of uints, where row 0 is bottom
        uint[] board = new uint[height];
        uint[] tempBoard = new uint[height];

        // Adaptive weights based on game complexity (board size and total pieces)
        double wEroded = 3.418;
        double wHoles = 7.899;
        double wWells = 3.385;
        double wRowTrans = 3.217;
        double wColTrans = 9.348;
        double wLandingHeight = 4.500;

        // Marathon mode adjustments
        if (numPieces >= 50000) {
            wHoles = 13.5;
            wWells = 4.5;
            wRowTrans = 3.5;
            wColTrans = 10.5;
        }

        // Wide board adjustments
        if (width >= 20) {
            wRowTrans *= 0.6;
            wColTrans *= 0.6;
        }

        for (int p = 0; p < numPieces; p++) {
            string pieceTypeLine = Console.ReadLine();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(pieceTypeLine)) break;
            
            pieceTypeLine = pieceTypeLine.Trim();
            if (pieceTypeLine.Length == 0) continue;
            char pieceType = pieceTypeLine[0];

            if (!pieces.ContainsKey(pieceType)) {
                // Invalid piece type, default response
                Console.WriteLine("0 0");
                Console.Out.Flush();
                continue;
            }

            // Find optimal move
            int bestRotation = 0;
            int bestColumn = 0;
            double bestScore = double.MinValue;

            Piece piece = pieces[pieceType];

            // Compute current fill ratio of the board
            int currentMaxHeight = 0;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                if (board[r] != 0) {
                    currentMaxHeight = r + 1;
                    break;
                }
            }
            double fillRatio = (double)currentMaxHeight / height;

            // Danger zone adjustments
            double currentWEroded = wEroded;
            double currentWHoles = wHoles;
            double currentWWells = wWells;
            double currentWRowTrans = wRowTrans;
            double currentWColTrans = wColTrans;
            double currentWLandingHeight = wLandingHeight;

            if (fillRatio > 0.6) {
                // Very high stack, play defensively
                currentWLandingHeight = 9.5;
                currentWEroded = 6.0;
                currentWWells = 1.0;
            } else if (fillRatio > 0.4) {
                // Moderately high stack
                currentWLandingHeight = 6.5;
                currentWEroded = 4.5;
                currentWWells = 2.0;
            }

            for (int rot = 0; rot < 4; rot++) {
                PieceRotation rInfo = piece.Rotations[rot];
                int maxCol = width - rInfo.Width;
                for (int col = 0; col <= maxCol; col++) {
                    Array.Copy(board, tempBoard, height);

                    int linesCleared;
                    double landingHeight;
                    int erodedCells;

                    bool success = PlacePiece(tempBoard, height, width, rInfo, col, out linesCleared, out landingHeight, out erodedCells);
                    if (!success) {
                        continue; // Immediate game over
                    }

                    int rowTrans = GetRowTransitions(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int colTrans = GetColTransitions(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int holes = GetHoles(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int wellSum = GetWellSum(tempBoard, height, width);

                    double score = (erodedCells * currentWEroded)
                                 - (holes * currentWHoles)
                                 - (wellSum * currentWWells)
                                 - (rowTrans * currentWRowTrans)
                                 - (colTrans * currentWColTrans)
                                 - (landingHeight * currentWLandingHeight);

                    if (score > bestScore) {
                        bestScore = score;
                        bestRotation = rot;
                        bestColumn = col;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (bestScore == double.MinValue) {
                // No moves found that avoid immediate game over
                bestRotation = 0;
                bestColumn = Math.Max(0, (width - piece.Rotations[0].Width) / 2);
            }

            // Output rotation and column
            Console.WriteLine($"{bestRotation} {bestColumn}");
            Console.Out.Flush();

            // Read result from simulator
            string result = Console.ReadLine();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(result)) break;
            result = result.Trim();

            if (result == "gameover") {
                break;
            }

            // Update our internal board state with the chosen move
            int dummy1, dummy3;
            double dummy2;
            PlacePiece(board, height, width, piece.Rotations[bestRotation], bestColumn, out dummy1, out dummy2, out dummy3);
        }
    }

    private static int FindLandingRow(uint[] board, int height, int width, PieceRotation rotation, int col) {
        for (int startRow = height - 1; startRow >= 0; startRow--) {
            bool canPlaceHere = true;
            for (int r = 0; r < rotation.Height; r++) {
                int boardRow = startRow + r;
                if (boardRow < 0) {
                    canPlaceHere = false;
                    break;
                }
                if (boardRow < height) {
                    uint pieceRowMask = rotation.RowMasks[r] << col;
                    if ((board[boardRow] & pieceRowMask) != 0) {
                        canPlaceHere = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!canPlaceHere) {
                return startRow + 1;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    private static bool PlacePiece(uint[] board, int height, int width, PieceRotation rotation, int col, out int linesCleared, out double landingHeight, out int erodedCells) {
        linesCleared = 0;
        landingHeight = 0;
        erodedCells = 0;

        int landingRow = FindLandingRow(board, height, width, rotation, col);

        // Place the piece
        for (int r = 0; r < rotation.Height; r++) {
            int boardRow = landingRow + r;
            if (boardRow >= height) {
                return false; // GameOver
            }
            uint pieceRowMask = rotation.RowMasks[r] << col;
            board[boardRow] |= pieceRowMask;
        }

        // Calculate landing height
        double sumRow = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < rotation.Coords.Length; i++) {
            sumRow += landingRow + rotation.Coords[i][0];
        }
        landingHeight = sumRow / rotation.Coords.Length;

        // Check for line clears and eroded cells
        uint fullRowMask = (1u << width) - 1;
        int clearedCount = 0;
        int pieceBlocksInCleared = 0;

        for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
            if (board[r] == fullRowMask) {
                clearedCount++;
                if (r >= landingRow && r < landingRow + rotation.Height) {
                    pieceBlocksInCleared += PopCount(rotation.RowMasks[r - landingRow]);
                }
            }
        }

        erodedCells = clearedCount * pieceBlocksInCleared;
        linesCleared = clearedCount;

        // Perform row deletion
        if (clearedCount > 0) {
            int writeIdx = 0;
            for (int readIdx = 0; readIdx < height; readIdx++) {
                if (board[readIdx] != fullRowMask) {
                    board[writeIdx] = board[readIdx];
                    writeIdx++;
                }
            }
            while (writeIdx < height) {
                board[writeIdx] = 0;
                writeIdx++;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

        x = x - ((x >> 1) & 0x55555555);

                    if (leftOccupied && rightOccupied) {

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

public class Program {
    public struct PieceRotation {
        public int Width;
        public int Height;
        public uint[] RowMasks;
        public int[][] Coords;
    }

    public class Piece {
        public char Type;
        public PieceRotation[] Rotations;
    }

    private static Dictionary<char, Piece> pieces;

    public static void Main(string[] args) {
        // Read header: width height num_pieces
        string headerLine = Console.ReadLine();
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(headerLine)) return;

        string[] headerParts = headerLine.Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        if (headerParts.Length < 3) return;

        int width = int.Parse(headerParts[0]);
        int height = int.Parse(headerParts[1]);
        int numPieces = int.Parse(headerParts[2]);

        pieces = InitPieces();

        // Keep track of the board state
        // Board is represented as an array of uints, where row 0 is bottom
        uint[] board = new uint[height];
        uint[] tempBoard = new uint[height];

        // Adaptive weights based on game complexity (board size and total pieces)
        double wEroded = 3.418;
        double wHoles = 7.899;
        double wWells = 3.385;
        double wRowTrans = 3.217;
        double wColTrans = 9.348;
        double wLandingHeight = 4.500;

        // Marathon mode adjustments
        if (numPieces >= 50000) {
            wHoles = 13.5;
            wWells = 4.5;
            wRowTrans = 3.5;
            wColTrans = 10.5;
        }

        // Wide board adjustments
        if (width >= 20) {
            wRowTrans *= 0.6;
            wColTrans *= 0.6;
        }

        for (int p = 0; p < numPieces; p++) {
            string pieceTypeLine = Console.ReadLine();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(pieceTypeLine)) break;
            
            pieceTypeLine = pieceTypeLine.Trim();
            if (pieceTypeLine.Length == 0) continue;
            char pieceType = pieceTypeLine[0];

            if (!pieces.ContainsKey(pieceType)) {
                // Invalid piece type, default response
                Console.WriteLine("0 0");
                Console.Out.Flush();
                continue;
            }

            // Find optimal move
            int bestRotation = 0;
            int bestColumn = 0;
            double bestScore = double.MinValue;

            Piece piece = pieces[pieceType];

            // Compute current fill ratio of the board
            int currentMaxHeight = 0;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                if (board[r] != 0) {
                    currentMaxHeight = r + 1;
                    break;
                }
            }
            double fillRatio = (double)currentMaxHeight / height;

            // Danger zone adjustments
            double currentWEroded = wEroded;
            double currentWHoles = wHoles;
            double currentWWells = wWells;
            double currentWRowTrans = wRowTrans;
            double currentWColTrans = wColTrans;
            double currentWLandingHeight = wLandingHeight;

            if (fillRatio > 0.6) {
                // Very high stack, play defensively
                currentWLandingHeight = 9.5;
                currentWEroded = 6.0;
                currentWWells = 1.0;
            } else if (fillRatio > 0.4) {
                // Moderately high stack
                currentWLandingHeight = 6.5;
                currentWEroded = 4.5;
                currentWWells = 2.0;
            }

            for (int rot = 0; rot < 4; rot++) {
                PieceRotation rInfo = piece.Rotations[rot];
                int maxCol = width - rInfo.Width;
                for (int col = 0; col <= maxCol; col++) {
                    Array.Copy(board, tempBoard, height);

                    int linesCleared;
                    double landingHeight;
                    int erodedCells;

                    bool success = PlacePiece(tempBoard, height, width, rInfo, col, out linesCleared, out landingHeight, out erodedCells);
                    if (!success) {
                        continue; // Immediate game over
                    }

                    int rowTrans = GetRowTransitions(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int colTrans = GetColTransitions(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int holes = GetHoles(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int wellSum = GetWellSum(tempBoard, height, width);

                    double score = (erodedCells * currentWEroded)
                                 - (holes * currentWHoles)
                                 - (wellSum * currentWWells)
                                 - (rowTrans * currentWRowTrans)
                                 - (colTrans * currentWColTrans)
                                 - (landingHeight * currentWLandingHeight);

                    if (score > bestScore) {
                        bestScore = score;
                        bestRotation = rot;
                        bestColumn = col;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (bestScore == double.MinValue) {
                // No moves found that avoid immediate game over
                bestRotation = 0;
                bestColumn = Math.Max(0, (width - piece.Rotations[0].Width) / 2);
            }

            // Output rotation and column
            Console.WriteLine($"{bestRotation} {bestColumn}");
            Console.Out.Flush();

            // Read result from simulator
            string result = Console.ReadLine();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(result)) break;
            result = result.Trim();

            if (result == "gameover") {
                break;
            }

            // Update our internal board state with the chosen move
            int dummy1, dummy3;
            double dummy2;
            PlacePiece(board, height, width, piece.Rotations[bestRotation], bestColumn, out dummy1, out dummy2, out dummy3);
        }
    }

    private static int FindLandingRow(uint[] board, int height, int width, PieceRotation rotation, int col) {
        for (int startRow = height - 1; startRow >= 0; startRow--) {
            bool canPlaceHere = true;
            for (int r = 0; r < rotation.Height; r++) {
                int boardRow = startRow + r;
                if (boardRow < 0) {
                    canPlaceHere = false;
                    break;
                }
                if (boardRow < height) {
                    uint pieceRowMask = rotation.RowMasks[r] << col;
                    if ((board[boardRow] & pieceRowMask) != 0) {
                        canPlaceHere = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!canPlaceHere) {
                return startRow + 1;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    private static bool PlacePiece(uint[] board, int height, int width, PieceRotation rotation, int col, out int linesCleared, out double landingHeight, out int erodedCells) {
        linesCleared = 0;
        landingHeight = 0;
        erodedCells = 0;

        int landingRow = FindLandingRow(board, height, width, rotation, col);

        // Place the piece
        for (int r = 0; r < rotation.Height; r++) {
            int boardRow = landingRow + r;
            if (boardRow >= height) {
                return false; // GameOver
            }
            uint pieceRowMask = rotation.RowMasks[r] << col;
            board[boardRow] |= pieceRowMask;
        }

        // Calculate landing height
        double sumRow = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < rotation.Coords.Length; i++) {
            sumRow += landingRow + rotation.Coords[i][0];
        }
        landingHeight = sumRow / rotation.Coords.Length;

        // Check for line clears and eroded cells
        uint fullRowMask = (1u << width) - 1;
        int clearedCount = 0;
        int pieceBlocksInCleared = 0;

        for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
            if (board[r] == fullRowMask) {
                clearedCount++;
                if (r >= landingRow && r < landingRow + rotation.Height) {
                    pieceBlocksInCleared += PopCount(rotation.RowMasks[r - landingRow]);
                }
            }
        }

        erodedCells = clearedCount * pieceBlocksInCleared;
        linesCleared = clearedCount;

        // Perform row deletion
        if (clearedCount > 0) {
            int writeIdx = 0;
            for (int readIdx = 0; readIdx < height; readIdx++) {
                if (board[readIdx] != fullRowMask) {
                    board[writeIdx] = board[readIdx];
                    writeIdx++;
                }
            }
            while (writeIdx < height) {
                board[writeIdx] = 0;
                writeIdx++;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static int PopCount(uint x) {
        x = x - ((x >> 1) & 0x55555555);
        x = (x & 0x33333333) + ((x >> 2) & 0x33333333);
        return (int)((((x + (x >> 4)) & 0x0F0F0F0F) * 0x01010101) >> 24);
    }

    private static int GetRowTransitions(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int transitions = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
            uint row = board[r];
            uint prevBit = 1; // Left wall is occupied
            for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
                uint bit = (row >> c) & 1u;
                if (bit != prevBit) {
                    transitions++;
                }
                prevBit = bit;
            }
            if (prevBit != 1) {
                transitions++; // Transition to right wall (occupied)
            }
        }
        return transitions;
    }

    private static int GetColTransitions(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int transitions = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            uint prevBit = 1; // Bottom wall is occupied
            for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
                uint bit = (board[r] >> c) & 1u;
                if (bit != prevBit) {
                    transitions++;
                }
                prevBit = bit;
            }
            if (prevBit != 0) {
                transitions++; // Transition to empty space above
            }
        }
        return transitions;
    }

    private static int GetHoles(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int holes = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            bool foundBlock = false;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                bool occupied = ((board[r] >> c) & 1u) != 0;
                if (occupied) {
                    foundBlock = true;
                } else if (foundBlock) {
                    holes++;
                }
            }
        }
        return holes;
    }

    private static int GetWellSum(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int wellSum = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            int depth = 0;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                bool occupied = ((board[r] >> c) & 1u) != 0;
                if (!occupied) {
                    bool leftOccupied = (c == 0) || (((board[r] >> (c - 1)) & 1u) != 0);
                    bool rightOccupied = (c == width - 1) || (((board[r] >> (c + 1)) & 1u) != 0);
                    if (leftOccupied && rightOccupied) {
                        depth++;
                        wellSum += depth;
                    } else {
                        depth = 0;
                    }
                } else {
                    depth = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        return wellSum;
    }

        var pieces = new Dictionary<char, Piece>();

                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {1,1}, new int[] {2,1} }
            }}
        };

        foreach (var kvp in rawCoords) {
            var piece = new Piece {
                Type = kvp.Key,
                Rotations = new PieceRotation[4]
            };
            for (int rot = 0; rot < 4; rot++) {
                var coords = kvp.Value[rot];
                int maxRow = 0;
                int maxCol = 0;
                foreach (var c in coords) {
                    if (c[0] > maxRow) maxRow = c[0];
                    if (c[1] > maxCol) maxCol = c[1];

                int height = maxRow + 1;
                int width = maxCol + 1;
                var rowMasks = new uint[height];
                foreach (var c in coords) {
                    rowMasks[c[0]] |= (1u << c[1]);
                }
                piece.Rotations[rot] = new PieceRotation {
                    Width = width,
                    Height = height,
                    RowMasks = rowMasks,
                    Coords = coords
                };
            }
            pieces[kvp.Key] = piece;
        }
        return pieces;
    }

                prevBit = bit;
            }
            if (prevBit != 0) {
                transitions++; // Transition to empty space above
            }
        }
        return transitions;
    }

    private static int GetHoles(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int holes = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            bool foundBlock = false;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                bool occupied = ((board[r] >> c) & 1u) != 0;
                if (occupied) {
                    foundBlock = true;
                } else if (foundBlock) {
                    holes++;
                }
            }
        }
        return holes;
    }

    private static int GetWellSum(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int wellSum = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            int depth = 0;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                bool occupied = ((board[r] >> c) & 1u) != 0;
                if (!occupied) {
                    bool leftOccupied = (c == 0) || (((board[r] >> (c - 1)) & 1u) != 0);
                    bool rightOccupied = (c == width - 1) || (((board[r] >> (c + 1)) & 1u) != 0);
                    if (leftOccupied && rightOccupied) {
                        depth++;
                        wellSum += depth;
                    } else {
                        depth = 0;
                    }
                } else {
                    depth = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        return wellSum;
    }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

public class Program {
    public struct PieceRotation {
        public int Width;
        public int Height;
        public uint[] RowMasks;
        public int[][] Coords;
    }

    public class Piece {
        public char Type;
        public PieceRotation[] Rotations;
    }

    private static Dictionary<char, Piece> pieces;

    public static void Main(string[] args) {
        // Read header: width height num_pieces
        string headerLine = Console.ReadLine();
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(headerLine)) return;

        string[] headerParts = headerLine.Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        if (headerParts.Length < 3) return;

        int width = int.Parse(headerParts[0]);
        int height = int.Parse(headerParts[1]);
        int numPieces = int.Parse(headerParts[2]);

        pieces = InitPieces();

        // Keep track of the board state
        // Board is represented as an array of uints, where row 0 is bottom
        uint[] board = new uint[height];
        uint[] tempBoard = new uint[height];

        // Adaptive weights based on game complexity (board size and total pieces)
        double wEroded = 3.418;
        double wHoles = 7.899;
        double wWells = 3.385;
        double wRowTrans = 3.217;
        double wColTrans = 9.348;
        double wLandingHeight = 4.500;

        // Marathon mode adjustments
        if (numPieces >= 50000) {
            wHoles = 13.5;
            wWells = 4.5;
            wRowTrans = 3.5;
            wColTrans = 10.5;
        }

        // Wide board adjustments
        if (width >= 20) {
            wRowTrans *= 0.6;
            wColTrans *= 0.6;
        }

        for (int p = 0; p < numPieces; p++) {
            string pieceTypeLine = Console.ReadLine();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(pieceTypeLine)) break;
            
            pieceTypeLine = pieceTypeLine.Trim();
            if (pieceTypeLine.Length == 0) continue;
            char pieceType = pieceTypeLine[0];

            if (!pieces.ContainsKey(pieceType)) {
                // Invalid piece type, default response
                Console.WriteLine("0 0");
                Console.Out.Flush();
                continue;
            }

            // Find optimal move
            int bestRotation = 0;
            int bestColumn = 0;
            double bestScore = double.MinValue;

            Piece piece = pieces[pieceType];

            // Compute current fill ratio of the board
            int currentMaxHeight = 0;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                if (board[r] != 0) {
                    currentMaxHeight = r + 1;
                    break;
                }
            }
            double fillRatio = (double)currentMaxHeight / height;

            // Danger zone adjustments
            double currentWEroded = wEroded;
            double currentWHoles = wHoles;
            double currentWWells = wWells;
            double currentWRowTrans = wRowTrans;
            double currentWColTrans = wColTrans;
            double currentWLandingHeight = wLandingHeight;

            if (fillRatio > 0.6) {
                // Very high stack, play defensively
                currentWLandingHeight = 9.5;
                currentWEroded = 6.0;
                currentWWells = 1.0;
            } else if (fillRatio > 0.4) {
                // Moderately high stack
                currentWLandingHeight = 6.5;
                currentWEroded = 4.5;
                currentWWells = 2.0;
            }

            for (int rot = 0; rot < 4; rot++) {
                PieceRotation rInfo = piece.Rotations[rot];
                int maxCol = width - rInfo.Width;
                for (int col = 0; col <= maxCol; col++) {
                    Array.Copy(board, tempBoard, height);

                    int linesCleared;
                    double landingHeight;
                    int erodedCells;

                    bool success = PlacePiece(tempBoard, height, width, rInfo, col, out linesCleared, out landingHeight, out erodedCells);
                    if (!success) {
                        continue; // Immediate game over
                    }

                    int rowTrans = GetRowTransitions(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int colTrans = GetColTransitions(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int holes = GetHoles(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int wellSum = GetWellSum(tempBoard, height, width);

                    double score = (erodedCells * currentWEroded)
                                 - (holes * currentWHoles)
                                 - (wellSum * currentWWells)
                                 - (rowTrans * currentWRowTrans)
                                 - (colTrans * currentWColTrans)
                                 - (landingHeight * currentWLandingHeight);

                    if (score > bestScore) {
                        bestScore = score;
                        bestRotation = rot;
                        bestColumn = col;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (bestScore == double.MinValue) {
                // No moves found that avoid immediate game over
                bestRotation = 0;
                bestColumn = Math.Max(0, (width - piece.Rotations[0].Width) / 2);
            }

            // Output rotation and column
            Console.WriteLine($"{bestRotation} {bestColumn}");
            Console.Out.Flush();

            // Read result from simulator
            string result = Console.ReadLine();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(result)) break;
            result = result.Trim();

            if (result == "gameover") {
                break;
            }

            // Update our internal board state with the chosen move
            int dummy1, dummy3;
            double dummy2;
            PlacePiece(board, height, width, piece.Rotations[bestRotation], bestColumn, out dummy1, out dummy2, out dummy3);
        }
    }

    private static int FindLandingRow(uint[] board, int height, int width, PieceRotation rotation, int col) {
        for (int startRow = height - 1; startRow >= 0; startRow--) {
            bool canPlaceHere = true;
            for (int r = 0; r < rotation.Height; r++) {
                int boardRow = startRow + r;
                if (boardRow < 0) {
                    canPlaceHere = false;
                    break;
                }
                if (boardRow < height) {
                    uint pieceRowMask = rotation.RowMasks[r] << col;
                    if ((board[boardRow] & pieceRowMask) != 0) {
                        canPlaceHere = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!canPlaceHere) {
                return startRow + 1;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    private static bool PlacePiece(uint[] board, int height, int width, PieceRotation rotation, int col, out int linesCleared, out double landingHeight, out int erodedCells) {
        linesCleared = 0;
        landingHeight = 0;
        erodedCells = 0;

        int landingRow = FindLandingRow(board, height, width, rotation, col);

        // Place the piece
        for (int r = 0; r < rotation.Height; r++) {
            int boardRow = landingRow + r;
            if (boardRow >= height) {
                return false; // GameOver
            }
            uint pieceRowMask = rotation.RowMasks[r] << col;
            board[boardRow] |= pieceRowMask;
        }

        // Calculate landing height
        double sumRow = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < rotation.Coords.Length; i++) {
            sumRow += landingRow + rotation.Coords[i][0];
        }
        landingHeight = sumRow / rotation.Coords.Length;

        // Check for line clears and eroded cells
        uint fullRowMask = (1u << width) - 1;
        int clearedCount = 0;
        int pieceBlocksInCleared = 0;

        for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
            if (board[r] == fullRowMask) {
                clearedCount++;
                if (r >= landingRow && r < landingRow + rotation.Height) {
                    pieceBlocksInCleared += PopCount(rotation.RowMasks[r - landingRow]);
                }
            }
        }

        erodedCells = clearedCount * pieceBlocksInCleared;
        linesCleared = clearedCount;

        // Perform row deletion
        if (clearedCount > 0) {
            int writeIdx = 0;
            for (int readIdx = 0; readIdx < height; readIdx++) {
                if (board[readIdx] != fullRowMask) {
                    board[writeIdx] = board[readIdx];
                    writeIdx++;
                }
            }
            while (writeIdx < height) {
                board[writeIdx] = 0;
                writeIdx++;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static int PopCount(uint x) {
        x = x - ((x >> 1) & 0x55555555);
        x = (x & 0x33333333) + ((x >> 2) & 0x33333333);
        return (int)((((x + (x >> 4)) & 0x0F0F0F0F) * 0x01010101) >> 24);
    }

    private static int GetRowTransitions(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int transitions = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
            uint row = board[r];
            uint prevBit = 1; // Left wall is occupied
            for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
                uint bit = (row >> c) & 1u;
                if (bit != prevBit) {
                    transitions++;
                }
                prevBit = bit;
            }
            if (prevBit != 1) {
                transitions++; // Transition to right wall (occupied)
            }
        }
        return transitions;
    }

    private static int GetColTransitions(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int transitions = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            uint prevBit = 1; // Bottom wall is occupied
            for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
                uint bit = (board[r] >> c) & 1u;
                if (bit != prevBit) {
                    transitions++;
                }
                prevBit = bit;
            }
            if (prevBit != 0) {
                transitions++; // Transition to empty space above
            }
        }
        return transitions;
    }

    private static int GetHoles(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int holes = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            bool foundBlock = false;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                bool occupied = ((board[r] >> c) & 1u) != 0;
                if (occupied) {
                    foundBlock = true;
                } else if (foundBlock) {
                    holes++;
                }
            }
        }
        return holes;
    }

    private static int GetWellSum(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int wellSum = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            int depth = 0;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                bool occupied = ((board[r] >> c) & 1u) != 0;
                if (!occupied) {
                    bool leftOccupied = (c == 0) || (((board[r] >> (c - 1)) & 1u) != 0);
                    bool rightOccupied = (c == width - 1) || (((board[r] >> (c + 1)) & 1u) != 0);
                    if (leftOccupied && rightOccupied) {
                        depth++;
                        wellSum += depth;
                    } else {
                        depth = 0;
                    }
                } else {
                    depth = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        return wellSum;
    }

            int bestColumn = 0;
            double bestScore = double.MinValue;

            Piece piece = pieces[pieceType];

            // Compute current fill ratio of the board
            int currentMaxHeight = 0;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                if (board[r] != 0) {
                    currentMaxHeight = r + 1;
                    break;
                }
            }
            double fillRatio = (double)currentMaxHeight / height;

            // Danger zone adjustments
            double currentWEroded = wEroded;
            double currentWHoles = wHoles;
            double currentWWells = wWells;
            double currentWRowTrans = wRowTrans;
            double currentWColTrans = wColTrans;
            double currentWLandingHeight = wLandingHeight;

            if (fillRatio > 0.6) {
                // Very high stack, play defensively
                currentWLandingHeight = 9.5;
                currentWEroded = 6.0;
                currentWWells = 1.0;
            } else if (fillRatio > 0.4) {
                // Moderately high stack
                currentWLandingHeight = 6.5;
                currentWEroded = 4.5;
                currentWWells = 2.0;
            }

            for (int rot = 0; rot < 4; rot++) {
                PieceRotation rInfo = piece.Rotations[rot];
                int maxCol = width - rInfo.Width;
                for (int col = 0; col <= maxCol; col++) {
                    Array.Copy(board, tempBoard, height);

                    int linesCleared;
                    double landingHeight;
                    int erodedCells;

                    bool success = PlacePiece(tempBoard, height, width, rInfo, col, out linesCleared, out landingHeight, out erodedCells);
                    if (!success) {
                        continue; // Immediate game over
                    }

                    int rowTrans = GetRowTransitions(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int colTrans = GetColTransitions(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int holes = GetHoles(tempBoard, height, width);
                    int wellSum = GetWellSum(tempBoard, height, width);

                    double score = (erodedCells * currentWEroded)
                                 - (holes * currentWHoles)
                                 - (wellSum * currentWWells)
                                 - (rowTrans * currentWRowTrans)
                                 - (colTrans * currentWColTrans)
                                 - (landingHeight * currentWLandingHeight);

                    if (score > bestScore) {
                        bestScore = score;
                        bestRotation = rot;
                        bestColumn = col;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (bestScore == double.MinValue) {
                // No moves found that avoid immediate game over
                bestRotation = 0;
                bestColumn = Math.Max(0, (width - piece.Rotations[0].Width) / 2);
            }

            // Output rotation and column
            Console.WriteLine($"{bestRotation} {bestColumn}");
            Console.Out.Flush();

            // Read result from simulator
            string result = Console.ReadLine();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(result)) break;
            result = result.Trim();

            if (result == "gameover") {
                break;
            }

            // Update our internal board state with the chosen move
            int dummy1, dummy3;
            double dummy2;
            PlacePiece(board, height, width, piece.Rotations[bestRotation], bestColumn, out dummy1, out dummy2, out dummy3);
        }
    }

    private static int FindLandingRow(uint[] board, int height, int width, PieceRotation rotation, int col) {
        for (int startRow = height - 1; startRow >= 0; startRow--) {
            bool canPlaceHere = true;
            for (int r = 0; r < rotation.Height; r++) {
                int boardRow = startRow + r;
                if (boardRow < 0) {
                    canPlaceHere = false;
                    break;
                }
                if (boardRow < height) {
                    uint pieceRowMask = rotation.RowMasks[r] << col;
                    if ((board[boardRow] & pieceRowMask) != 0) {
                        canPlaceHere = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!canPlaceHere) {
                return startRow + 1;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    private static bool PlacePiece(uint[] board, int height, int width, PieceRotation rotation, int col, out int linesCleared, out double landingHeight, out int erodedCells) {
        linesCleared = 0;
        landingHeight = 0;
        erodedCells = 0;

        int landingRow = FindLandingRow(board, height, width, rotation, col);

        // Place the piece
        for (int r = 0; r < rotation.Height; r++) {
            int boardRow = landingRow + r;
            if (boardRow >= height) {
                return false; // GameOver
            }
            uint pieceRowMask = rotation.RowMasks[r] << col;
            board[boardRow] |= pieceRowMask;
        }

        // Calculate landing height
        double sumRow = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < rotation.Coords.Length; i++) {
            sumRow += landingRow + rotation.Coords[i][0];
        }
        landingHeight = sumRow / rotation.Coords.Length;

        // Check for line clears and eroded cells
        uint fullRowMask = (1u << width) - 1;
        int clearedCount = 0;
        int pieceBlocksInCleared = 0;

        for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
            if (board[r] == fullRowMask) {
                clearedCount++;
                if (r >= landingRow && r < landingRow + rotation.Height) {
                    pieceBlocksInCleared += PopCount(rotation.RowMasks[r - landingRow]);
                }
            }
        }

        erodedCells = clearedCount * pieceBlocksInCleared;
        linesCleared = clearedCount;

        // Perform row deletion
        if (clearedCount > 0) {
            int writeIdx = 0;
            for (int readIdx = 0; readIdx < height; readIdx++) {
                if (board[readIdx] != fullRowMask) {
                    board[writeIdx] = board[readIdx];
                    writeIdx++;
                }
            }
            while (writeIdx < height) {
                board[writeIdx] = 0;
                writeIdx++;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static int PopCount(uint x) {
        x = x - ((x >> 1) & 0x55555555);
        x = (x & 0x33333333) + ((x >> 2) & 0x33333333);
        return (int)((((x + (x >> 4)) & 0x0F0F0F0F) * 0x01010101) >> 24);
    }

    private static int GetRowTransitions(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int transitions = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
            uint row = board[r];
            uint prevBit = 1; // Left wall is occupied
            for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
                uint bit = (row >> c) & 1u;
                if (bit != prevBit) {
                    transitions++;
                }
                prevBit = bit;
            }
            if (prevBit != 1) {
                transitions++; // Transition to right wall (occupied)
            }
        }
        return transitions;
    }

    private static int GetColTransitions(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int transitions = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            uint prevBit = 1; // Bottom wall is occupied
            for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
                uint bit = (board[r] >> c) & 1u;
                if (bit != prevBit) {
                    transitions++;
                }
                prevBit = bit;
            }
            if (prevBit != 0) {
                transitions++; // Transition to empty space above
            }
        }
        return transitions;
    }

    private static int GetHoles(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int holes = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            bool foundBlock = false;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                bool occupied = ((board[r] >> c) & 1u) != 0;
                if (occupied) {
                    foundBlock = true;
                } else if (foundBlock) {
                    holes++;
                }
            }
        }
        return holes;
    }

    private static int GetWellSum(uint[] board, int height, int width) {
        int wellSum = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
            int depth = 0;
            for (int r = height - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
                bool occupied = ((board[r] >> c) & 1u) != 0;
                if (!occupied) {
                    bool leftOccupied = (c == 0) || (((board[r] >> (c - 1)) & 1u) != 0);
                    bool rightOccupied = (c == width - 1) || (((board[r] >> (c + 1)) & 1u) != 0);
                    if (leftOccupied && rightOccupied) {
                        depth++;
                        wellSum += depth;
                    } else {
                        depth = 0;
                    }
                } else {
                    depth = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        return wellSum;
    }

    private static Dictionary<char, Piece> InitPieces() {
        var pieces = new Dictionary<char, Piece>();
        
        var rawCoords = new Dictionary<char, int[][][]> {
            { 'I', new int[][][] {
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {0,2}, new int[] {0,3} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {1,0}, new int[] {2,0}, new int[] {3,0} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {0,2}, new int[] {0,3} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {1,0}, new int[] {2,0}, new int[] {3,0} }
            }},
            { 'O', new int[][][] {
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {1,0}, new int[] {1,1} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {1,0}, new int[] {1,1} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {1,0}, new int[] {1,1} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {1,0}, new int[] {1,1} }
            }},
            { 'T', new int[][][] {
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {0,2}, new int[] {1,1} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {1,0}, new int[] {2,0}, new int[] {1,1} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {1,0}, new int[] {1,1}, new int[] {1,2}, new int[] {0,1} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {1,0}, new int[] {1,1}, new int[] {2,1} }
            }},
            { 'S', new int[][][] {
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {1,1}, new int[] {1,2} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {1,0}, new int[] {1,1}, new int[] {2,0} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {1,1}, new int[] {1,2} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {1,0}, new int[] {1,1}, new int[] {2,0} }
            }},
            { 'Z', new int[][][] {
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {0,2}, new int[] {1,0}, new int[] {1,1} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {1,0}, new int[] {1,1}, new int[] {2,1} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {0,2}, new int[] {1,0}, new int[] {1,1} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {1,0}, new int[] {1,1}, new int[] {2,1} }
            }},
            { 'J', new int[][][] {
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {1,0}, new int[] {1,1}, new int[] {1,2} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {1,0}, new int[] {2,0} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {0,2}, new int[] {1,2} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {1,1}, new int[] {2,0}, new int[] {2,1} }
            }},
            { 'L', new int[][][] {
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,2}, new int[] {1,0}, new int[] {1,1}, new int[] {1,2} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {1,0}, new int[] {2,0}, new int[] {2,1} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {0,2}, new int[] {1,0} },
                new int[][] { new int[] {0,0}, new int[] {0,1}, new int[] {1,1}, new int[] {2,1} }
            }}
        };

        foreach (var kvp in rawCoords) {
            var piece = new Piece {
                Type = kvp.Key,
                Rotations = new PieceRotation[4]
            };
            for (int rot = 0; rot < 4; rot++) {
                var coords = kvp.Value[rot];
                int maxRow = 0;
                int maxCol = 0;
                foreach (var c in coords) {
                    if (c[0] > maxRow) maxRow = c[0];
                    if (c[1] > maxCol) maxCol = c[1];
                }
                int height = maxRow + 1;
                int width = maxCol + 1;
                var rowMasks = new uint[height];
                foreach (var c in coords) {
                    rowMasks[c[0]] |= (1u << c[1]);
                }
                piece.Rotations[rot] = new PieceRotation {
                    Width = width,
                    Height = height,
                    RowMasks = rowMasks,
                    Coords = coords
                };
            }
            pieces[kvp.Key] = piece;
        }
        return pieces;
    }

You are writing Rust code to play Lunar Lander in real-time.

Your Rust lunar lander controller will be tested with scenarios ranging from simple
training environments to very complex landing sites.

Control a lunar lander to safely land on a target pad.
The program receives a 2D voxel map and continuous state updates, and must output thrust/turn
commands to land safely on the target.

Data is streamed to stdin in real time, and you must write to stdout in real time. If your code
doesn't read from stdin fast enough and the io buffer fills up, the ship will likely crash.

Be very careful if writing single threaded / blocking code, this has many failure modes that
async code doesn't have. Multithreaded / asyncio code is HIGHLY recommended.

**Physics:**
- Gravity pulls lander down constantly
- Thrust applies force in lander's facing direction
- Fuel is limited
- Must land softly on target (low velocity)

**Input format (stdin, whitespace seperated decimal numbers):**
Initial map:
```
width height gravity max_thrust fuel
start_x start_y target_x target_y
map rows (. = empty, # = obstacle, S = start, T = target, L = landing zone)
```

Then you recieve continuous state updates (every 0.1 seconds):
```
x y vx vy angle angular_vel fuel_remaining
```
x and y are in meters, from the worlds top left, and y increases downward.
vx and vy are in m/s.
angle is in radians, 0 is facing up.
angular_vel is in radians per second. + is clockwise, - is counterclockwise.
fuel_remaining is seconds at max_thrust.

**Output format (stdout):**
Your code needs to output the following instructions at a frequency of at least 20hz:
```
thrust turn
```
- thrust: 0.0 to 1.0 (fraction of max thrust)
- turn: -1.0 to 1.0 (turning rate, negative = left, positive = right)

To be crystal clear: that's two decimal numbers seperated by a space, followed by a newline.

If your code stalls / freezes for 100ms or more (so it misses 2 consecutive updates), the engine
will automatically cut power. A long freeze and eventually the lander will crash.

Map size can vary from 100x50 to multi-gb maps, so be efficient with memory and processing.

Thrust and gravity are in m/s/s. 100% engine burn burns 1 unit of fuel per second.

Lander size is approximatly 1x1m, and the 2D map grid size is 1m x 1m.

Turn is in radians per second. The lander can not rotate fully around and will clamp rotation to
facing down if attempted.

Y increases downward. Positive vy means moving downward. Gravity is +g.

**Success Conditions:**
- Land on target with |velocity| < 2m/s
- Stay within landing zone boundaries
- Complete landing within time limit

**Failure Conditions:**
- Crash into obstacle or ground too hard
- Run out of fuel
- Exceed time limit

Data is streamed to stdin in real time, and you must write to stdout in real time.
If your code doesn't read from stdin fast enough and the IO buffer fills up, the ship
will likely crash.

Be very careful if writing single threaded / blocking code, this has many failure modes
that async code doesn't have. Multithreaded code is HIGHLY recommended.

**Coordinate System:**
- X: horizontal (East), Y: horizontal (North), Z: UP.
- Gravity acts in the -Z direction.
- All positions are in meters. Velocities in m/s. Angles in radians.

**Physics:**
- Gravity = 1.62 m/s² (lunar) in -Z direction.
- Thrust is along the lander's local "up" axis. When pitch=0 and yaw=0, thrust is
straight up (+Z). Tilting via pitch/yaw redirects thrust.
- Pitch: tilts the lander. +pitch tilts forward, redirecting thrust partially into -X.
Pitch is clamped to [-pi/2, pi/2].
- Yaw: rotates heading around Z.
- Roll: rolls around the thrust axis (cosmetic only, does not affect thrust direction).
- Rotation dynamics: commands apply angular acceleration (2 rad/s² per unit).
Angular rates are damped by 0.95 per tick.
- Fuel: 100% thrust burns 1 unit of fuel per second.

**Input format (stdin):**
Initial header (whitespace separated decimal numbers, except terrain path):
```
width depth height gravity max_thrust fuel
start_x start_y start_z target_x target_y target_z
terrain_file_path
STATE
```

The terrain_file_path is on its own line (the path may contain spaces).
Read the entire line with getline() or equivalent.

**Terrain file format (binary):**
The terrain file defines the 3D world as a binary file. It is a sequence of
uint16_t triplets (little-endian), one per (x, y) cell, stored in row-major order:

```cpp
for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
for (int y = 0; y < depth; y++) {
uint16_t a = read_uint16_le(); // ground rock top
uint16_t b = read_uint16_le(); // floating rock bottom
uint16_t c = read_uint16_le(); // floating rock top
}
}
```

For each column (x, y), the vertical structure is:
- z < a: SOLID ROCK (ground)
- a <= z < b: OPEN AIR
- b <= z < c: SOLID ROCK (floating terrain feature, overhang, arch, etc.)
- c <= z: OPEN AIR

If b == c, there is no floating rock in that column (just ground + open sky).
The file size is exactly width * depth * 6 bytes.

You have a startup grace period to parse this file before state updates begin.
The grace period is 5 seconds plus 10 seconds per gigabyte of terrain file.
For a 100x100 map this is ~5s. For a 100000x10000 map (~6GB) this is ~65s.
You may continue parsing in a background thread after the simulation begins,
but you MUST be reading stdin and writing stdout by then to avoid a crash.

Then continuous state updates (every 0.1 seconds, whitespace separated):
```
x y z vx vy vz pitch yaw roll pitch_rate yaw_rate roll_rate fuel_remaining
```

**Output format (stdout):**
Your code needs to output the following at a frequency of at least 10hz:
```
thrust pitch_cmd yaw_cmd roll_cmd
```
- thrust: 0.0 to 1.0 (fraction of max_thrust)
- pitch_cmd: -1.0 to 1.0 (pitch angular acceleration command)
- yaw_cmd: -1.0 to 1.0 (yaw angular acceleration command)
- roll_cmd: -1.0 to 1.0 (roll angular acceleration command)

To be crystal clear: four decimal numbers separated by spaces, followed by a newline.

If your code stalls / freezes for 100ms or more (misses 2 consecutive updates), the
engine will cut thrust automatically. A long freeze and eventually the lander will crash.

**Landing:**
- The target is at (target_x, target_y, target_z) which is just above the terrain.
- You must land within a small radius of the target with total speed < 3 m/s.
- Landing zone radius is approximately max(5, min(width,depth)*0.02) meters.

**Terrain collisions:**
- You collide if you enter any solid cell as defined by the terrain file.
- Out of bounds (x<0, x>=width, y<0, y>=depth, z<0, z>=height) is also a collision.

**Success Conditions:**
- Land on target with |velocity| < 3 m/s
- Stay within landing zone boundaries

**Failure Conditions:**
- Crash into terrain or ground too hard
- Run out of fuel
- Exceed simulation time limit

#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <sstream>
#include <iomanip>

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

#pragma pack(push, 1)
struct Cell {
    uint16_t a;
    uint16_t b;
    uint16_t c;
};
#pragma pack(pop)

#define NOMINMAX
#include <windows.h>

class Terrain {
private:
    std::string filepath;
    int64_t width = 0;
    int64_t depth = 0;
    int64_t height = 0;

    // Memory mapping handles
    HANDLE file_handle = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
    HANDLE mapping_handle = NULL;
    void* mapped_data = nullptr;

    // Fallback stream
    mutable std::ifstream fallback_file;
    bool use_fallback = false;

public:
    Terrain() = default;
    Terrain(const std::string& path, int64_t w, int64_t d, int64_t h)
        : filepath(path), width(w), depth(d), height(h) {
        
        // Try memory mapping first
        file_handle = CreateFileA(
            filepath.c_str(),
            GENERIC_READ,
            FILE_SHARE_READ,
            NULL,
            OPEN_EXISTING,
            FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL,
            NULL
        );
        if (file_handle != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
            mapping_handle = CreateFileMappingA(
                file_handle,
                NULL,
                PAGE_READONLY,
                0,
                0,
                NULL
            );
            if (mapping_handle != NULL) {
                mapped_data = MapViewOfFile(
                    mapping_handle,
                    FILE_MAP_READ,
                    0,
                    0,
                    0
                );
            }
        }

        if (mapped_data == nullptr) {
            // Clean up handles if mapping failed
            if (mapping_handle != NULL) CloseHandle(mapping_handle);
            if (file_handle != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) CloseHandle(file_handle);
            file_handle = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
            mapping_handle = NULL;

            // Open fallback stream
            fallback_file.open(filepath, std::ios::binary);
            use_fallback = true;
        }
    }

    ~Terrain() {
        if (mapped_data) {
            UnmapViewOfFile(mapped_data);
        }
        if (mapping_handle) {
            CloseHandle(mapping_handle);
        }
        if (file_handle != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
            CloseHandle(file_handle);
        }
    }

    bool isOpen() const {
        return (mapped_data != nullptr) || fallback_file.is_open();
    }

    Cell getCell(int64_t x, int64_t y) const {
        if (x < 0 || x >= width || y < 0 || y >= depth) {
            return {0, 0, 0};
        }
        if (!use_fallback && mapped_data != nullptr) {
            uint64_t offset = (x * depth + y) * 6;
            const uint16_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(static_cast<const char*>(mapped_data) + offset);
            return {ptr[0], ptr[1], ptr[2]};
        } else {
            if (!fallback_file.is_open()) return {0, 0, 0};
            uint64_t offset = (x * depth + y) * 6;
            fallback_file.seekg(offset);
            uint16_t data[3] = {0, 0, 0};
            fallback_file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(data), 6);
            return {data[0], data[1], data[2]};
        }
    }

    double getHMax(double x, double y) const {
        int ix = std::clamp(static_cast<int>(std::floor(x)), 0, static_cast<int>(width - 1));
        int iy = std::clamp(static_cast<int>(std::floor(y)), 0, static_cast<int>(depth - 1));
        Cell cell = getCell(ix, iy);
        double h = cell.a;
        if (cell.b != cell.c) {
            h = std::max(h, static_cast<double>(cell.c));
        }
        return h;
    }
};

enum State {
    CLIMB,
    CRUISE,
    LANDING,
    FINISHED
};

int main() {
    // Set up standard I/O optimization
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(NULL);

    int64_t width, depth, height;
    double gravity, max_thrust, fuel;
    double start_x, start_y, start_z;
    double target_x, target_y, target_z;

    if (!(std::cin >> width >> depth >> height >> gravity >> max_thrust >> fuel)) {
        return 1;
    }
    if (!(std::cin >> start_x >> start_y >> start_z >> target_x >> target_y >> target_z)) {
        return 1;
    }

    // Consume remainder of the line
    std::string dummy;
    std::getline(std::cin, dummy);

    // Read terrain file path
    std::string terrain_file_path;
    if (!std::getline(std::cin, terrain_file_path)) {
        return 1;
    }
    while (!terrain_file_path.empty() && (terrain_file_path.back() == '\r' || terrain_file_path.back() == '\n' || terrain_file_path.back() == ' ')) {
        terrain_file_path.pop_back();
    }
    while (!terrain_file_path.empty() && terrain_file_path.front() == ' ') {
        terrain_file_path.erase(terrain_file_path.begin());
    }

    // Open terrain file
    Terrain terrain(terrain_file_path, width, depth, height);

    // Determine safety margin based on height
    double H_margin = std::min(15.0, height * 0.15);
    if (H_margin < 5.0) H_margin = 5.0;

    // Path Generation (Up-Over-Down style with terrain smoothing)
    double D = std::hypot(target_x - start_x, target_y - start_y);
    uint64_t N = std::max(10ULL, std::min(2000ULL, static_cast<uint64_t>(D / 5.0)));
    std::vector<double> path_x(N), path_y(N), Z_min(N);
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        double u = static_cast<double>(i) / (N - 1);
        path_x[i] = (1.0 - u) * start_x + u * target_x;
        path_y[i] = (1.0 - u) * start_y + u * target_y;
        Z_min[i] = terrain.getHMax(path_x[i], path_y[i]) + H_margin;
    }

    std::vector<double> Z_safe = Z_min;
    Z_safe[0] = std::max(Z_safe[0], start_z);
    Z_safe[N - 1] = std::max(Z_safe[N - 1], target_z);

    // Limit climb/descent slope (e.g. max 0.35 slope)
    double dx = (N > 1) ? D / (N - 1) : 1.0;
    double max_slope = 0.35;
    double max_dz = max_slope * dx;

    // Propagate slope constraints
    for (int pass = 0; pass < 3; ++pass) {
        for (int i = static_cast<int>(N) - 2; i >= 0; --i) {
            Z_safe[i] = std::max(Z_safe[i], Z_safe[i + 1] - max_dz);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < N; ++i) {
            Z_safe[i] = std::max(Z_safe[i], Z_safe[i - 1] - max_dz);
        }
    }

    // Clamp Z_safe below height
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        Z_safe[i] = std::min(Z_safe[i], height - 3.0);
    }

    // Determine cruise speed
    double a_h_max = std::sqrt(std::max(0.1, max_thrust * max_thrust - gravity * gravity));
    double V_cruise = std::min(200.0, std::sqrt(D * 0.3 * a_h_max));
    if (V_cruise < 5.0) V_cruise = 5.0;

    State state = CLIMB;
    uint64_t last_closest_idx = 0;
    double path_yaw = std::atan2(target_y - start_y, target_x - start_x);
    double z_target_moving = -1.0;

    // Start reading states and outputting commands
    std::string line;
    while (std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
        while (!line.empty() && (line.back() == '\r' || line.back() == '\n')) {
            line.pop_back();
        }
        if (line.empty()) continue;
        if (line.find("STATE") != std::string::npos) continue;

        std::stringstream ss(line);
        double x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, pitch, yaw, roll, pitch_rate, yaw_rate, roll_rate, fuel_rem;
        if (!(ss >> x >> y >> z >> vx >> vy >> vz >> pitch >> yaw >> roll >> pitch_rate >> yaw_rate >> roll_rate >> fuel_rem)) {
            continue;
        }

        double D_rem = std::hypot(target_x - x, target_y - y);

        // State Transitions
        if (state == CLIMB) {
            if (z >= Z_safe[0] - 2.0) {
                state = CRUISE;
            }
        } else if (state == CRUISE) {
            if (D_rem < 5.0) {
                state = LANDING;
            }
        }

        double x_target = start_x;
        double y_target = start_y;
        double z_target = Z_safe[0];
        double vx_des = 0.0;
        double vy_des = 0.0;
        double vz_des = 0.0;

        if (state == CLIMB) {
            // Vertical climb only
            x_target = start_x;
            y_target = start_y;
            z_target = Z_safe[0];
            
            vx_des = 1.0 * (x_target - x);
            vy_des = 1.0 * (y_target - y);
            // Limit horizontal drift corrections during climb
            vx_des = std::clamp(vx_des, -2.0, 2.0);
            vy_des = std::clamp(vy_des, -2.0, 2.0);

            vz_des = 2.0; // Steady climb speed
        } else if (state == CRUISE) {
            // Find closest index on path (must be non-decreasing)
            double min_dist_sq = 1e18;
            uint64_t closest_idx = last_closest_idx;
            for (uint64_t i = last_closest_idx; i < N; ++i) {
                double dx_p = x - path_x[i];
                double dy_p = y - path_y[i];
                double dist_sq = dx_p * dx_p + dy_p * dy_p;
                if (dist_sq < min_dist_sq) {
                    min_dist_sq = dist_sq;
                    closest_idx = i;
                }
            }
            last_closest_idx = closest_idx;

            // Lookahead distance scales with speed
            double speed_h = std::hypot(vx, vy);
            double L = 15.0 + 1.5 * speed_h;

            uint64_t lookahead_idx = closest_idx;
            double acc_dist = 0.0;
            for (uint64_t i = closest_idx + 1; i < N; ++i) {
                double dx_p = path_x[i] - path_x[i - 1];
                double dy_p = path_y[i] - path_y[i - 1];
                acc_dist += std::hypot(dx_p, dy_p);
                lookahead_idx = i;
                if (acc_dist >= L) {
                    break;
                }
            }

            x_target = path_x[lookahead_idx];
            y_target = path_y[lookahead_idx];
            z_target = Z_safe[lookahead_idx];

            // Target speed scales down as we approach the end target
            double V_des_h = std::min(V_cruise, std::sqrt(2.0 * 0.5 * a_h_max * D_rem));
            
            double tx_dx = x_target - x;
            double tx_dy = y_target - y;
            double tx_dist = std::hypot(tx_dx, tx_dy);
            if (tx_dist > 1e-3) {
                vx_des = V_des_h * (tx_dx / tx_dist);
                vy_des = V_des_h * (tx_dy / tx_dist);
            }

            vz_des = 0.5 * (z_target - z);
            vz_des = std::clamp(vz_des, -15.0, 15.0);

            // Ensure we do not fly below the local terrain safety limit
            double local_margin = H_margin;
            if (D_rem < 15.0) {
                local_margin = H_margin * (D_rem / 15.0);
            }
            double z_safe_current = terrain.getHMax(x, y) + local_margin;
            if (z_target < z_safe_current) {
                z_target = z_safe_current;
            }
        } else if (state == LANDING) {
            x_target = target_x;
            y_target = target_y;

            vx_des = 1.2 * (x_target - x);
            vy_des = 1.2 * (y_target - y);
            vx_des = std::clamp(vx_des, -2.0, 2.0);
            vy_des = std::clamp(vy_des, -2.0, 2.0);

            // Moving-target vertical descent logic
            if (z_target_moving < 0.0) {
                z_target_moving = z;
            }
            z_target_moving = std::max(target_z, z_target_moving - 1.2 * 0.1); // descend 1.2m/s
            z_target = z_target_moving;
            vz_des = (z_target_moving > target_z) ? -1.2 : 0.0;
        }

        // 3D Force PID / Feedback Controller
        double fx = 1.5 * (vx_des - vx);
        double fy = 1.5 * (vy_des - vy);
        double fz = 0.8 * (z_target - z) + 1.5 * (vz_des - vz) + gravity;

        if (fz < 0.1) fz = 0.1;

        // Thrust Prioritization
        double f_mag = std::sqrt(fx * fx + fy * fy + fz * fz);
        if (f_mag > max_thrust) {
            if (fz > max_thrust) {
                fz = max_thrust;
                fx = 0.0;
                fy = 0.0;
            } else {
                double allowed_h = std::sqrt(max_thrust * max_thrust - fz * fz);
                double current_h = std::hypot(fx, fy);
                if (current_h > 1e-3) {
                    fx = (fx / current_h) * allowed_h;
                    fy = (fy / current_h) * allowed_h;
                }
            }
            f_mag = max_thrust;
        }

        double thrust_cmd = f_mag / max_thrust;
        thrust_cmd = std::max(0.0, std::min(1.0, thrust_cmd));

        // Convert force directions to pitch and yaw
        double tx = fx / f_mag;
        double ty = fy / f_mag;
        double tz = fz / f_mag;

        double p_des = std::acos(std::max(0.0, std::min(1.0, tz)));
        double y_des = path_yaw;
        if (p_des > 0.02) {
            y_des = std::atan2(-ty, -tx);
        }

        double pitch_cmd = 0.0;
        double yaw_cmd = 0.0;
        double roll_cmd = 0.0;

        // Check Touchdown
        if (state == LANDING && std::abs(x - target_x) < 3.0 && std::abs(y - target_y) < 3.0 &&
            (z - target_z < 0.3 || (z - target_z < 1.0 && std::abs(vz) < 0.1))) {
            thrust_cmd = 0.0;
            pitch_cmd = 0.0;
            yaw_cmd = 0.0;
            roll_cmd = 0.0;
            state = FINISHED;
        }

        if (state != FINISHED) {
            // Attitude PD controller
            double e_p = p_des - pitch;
            
            // Branchless and fast angle normalization using fmod
            double e_y = std::fmod(y_des - yaw + M_PI, 2.0 * M_PI);
            if (e_y < 0) e_y += 2.0 * M_PI;
            e_y -= M_PI;

            double e_r = std::fmod(0.0 - roll + M_PI, 2.0 * M_PI);
            if (e_r < 0) e_r += 2.0 * M_PI;
            e_r -= M_PI;

            double u_p = 8.0 * e_p - 4.0 * pitch_rate;
            double u_y = 8.0 * e_y - 4.0 * yaw_rate;
            double u_r = 8.0 * e_r - 4.0 * roll_rate;

            pitch_cmd = std::clamp(u_p, -1.0, 1.0);
            yaw_cmd = std::clamp(u_y, -1.0, 1.0);
            roll_cmd = std::clamp(u_r, -1.0, 1.0);
        }

        // Print command
        std::cout << std::fixed << std::setprecision(6) 
                  << thrust_cmd << " " 
                  << pitch_cmd << " " 
                  << yaw_cmd << " " 
                  << roll_cmd << "\n";
        std::cout.flush();
    }

    return 0;
}

Test 25: Asteroid Interception (C#) Score: 11.00 / 11
Typical Prompt:
You are writing C# code to calculate an asteroid interception trajectory.

You must write a C# solver that can handle an interception and redirection scenarios, from
short warning times (1-2 years), large impactors, generous delta-v, simple trajectories to
very long warning times (30-50 years), very small impactors, very tight delta-v,
advanced trajectory optimization with multi-flyby maneuvers and gravitational assist sequences required.

**Problem:**
Calculate a spacecraft trajectory to intercept and deflect an asteroid on collision course
with Earth using kinetic impact.

**The solver must output:**
1. Launch window and initial trajectory
2. Mid-course correction burn(s)
3. Final approach for kinetic impact

**Input format (stdin, whitespace seperated decimal/scientific notation numbers):**
```
num_bodies warning_days impactor_mass delta_v_budget asteroid_mass t0_unix_utc
body_name mass x y z vx vy vz (for each body)
de421.bsp_file_path
```

All values are in SI units unless otherwise specified. Eg mass of earth is 5.972e24 kg.
All positions + velocities are relative to solar system barycenter.
Delta_v budget is in m/s.

The body name for the asteriod is "Asteroid". The body name for where your spacecraft originates
and you must redirect the asteroid to avoid is "Earth".

**Output format (stdout):**
```
num_burns
launch_time burn_dv_x burn_dv_y burn_dv_z
correction_time1 burn_dv_x burn_dv_y burn_dv_z
...
impact_time impact_dv_x impact_dv_y impact_dv_z
```

**Time units:**
- All times are in **days since scenario start (t=0 at the provided initial state)**.
- The **launch window is [0, warning_days]** (inclusive).
- **t0_unix_utc** is the UTC time of the provided initial state (t=0).

The simulation uses the JPL DE421 model of the solar system with Sun, Earth, Moon, and major planets,
and a KDK integrator to calculate trajectories. The path to the DE421 model is provided in the input
so your code can precisely match the simulation at extreme precision.

**Success Criteria:**
- Spacecraft intercepts asteroid before Earth impact (within 1000km)
- Kinetic impact transfers enough momentum to deflect asteroid sufficiently to miss Earth
- Total delta-v usage stays within budget
- Launch occurs within specified window

**Simulation host environment**
Platform: Windows 11 (build 10.0.26200)
Architecture: AMD64
CPU: AMD64 Family 23 Model 8 Stepping 2, AuthenticAMD
Core count: 64
Memory: 127.87 GB
SIMD: AVX, AVX2, SSE, SSE2, SSE3, SSE4.1, SSE4.2, SSSE3
SIMD detail: AVX=yes, AVX-512F=no, AVX2=yes, SSE=yes, SSE2=yes, SSE3=yes, SSE4.1=yes, SSE4.2=yes, SSSE3=yes

**C# Compiler**
C# (csc.exe 5.5.0-2.26208.13 (3dc781932f83b0792b0d1717a68db3f9604a2cb1)) | max LangVersion 14

**Requirements:**
1. Program must compile with C# .NET/csc
2. Read from stdin, write to stdout
3. Handle variable warning times and delta-v budgets
4. Complete analysis within 5 minutes
5. Must handle varying mission complexities efficiently

Write complete, compilable C# code with a static void Main method.
 Prompt Changes:
Prompt parameters change between subpasses (increasing difficulty)
