public struct ValueList {
    public int[] Array;
    public int Count;
    
    public ValueList(int capacity) {
        Array = new int[capacity];
        Count = 0;
    }
    
    [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
    public void Add(int val) {
        if (Count == Array.Length) {
            System.Array.Resize(ref Array, Array.Length * 2);
        }
        Array[Count++] = val;
    }
    
    [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
    public void Clear() {
        Count = 0;
    }
    
    public int[] ToArray() {
        int[] res = new int[Count];
        System.Array.Copy(Array, 0, res, 0, Count);
        return res;
    }
}

public class BitMatrix {
    public readonly ulong[] Data;
    public readonly int RowWords;
    
    public BitMatrix(int n) {
        RowWords = (n + 63) / 64;
        Data = new ulong[n * RowWords];
    }
    
    [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
    public void AddEdge(int u, int v) {
        int idx1 = u * RowWords + (v >> 6);
        Data[idx1] |= (1UL << (v & 63));
        int idx2 = v * RowWords + (u >> 6);
        Data[idx2] |= (1UL << (u & 63));
    }
    
    [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
    public bool IsAdjacent(int u, int v) {
        int idx = u * RowWords + (v >> 6);
        return (Data[idx] & (1UL << (v & 63))) != 0;
    }
}

public class Graph {
    public int N;
    public int M;
    public int[] Head;
    public int[] AdjData;
    
    public Graph(int n, int m, int[] head, int[] adjData) {
        N = n;
        M = m;
        Head = head;
        AdjData = adjData;
    }
}

public class FastScanner {
    private readonly Stream stream;
    private readonly byte[] buffer = new byte[65536];
    private int head = 0;
    private int tail = 0;
    
    public FastScanner() {
        stream = Console.OpenStandardInput();
    }
    
    [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
    private byte Read() {
        if (head >= tail) {
            head = 0;
            tail = stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
            if (tail <= 0) return 0;
        }
        return buffer[head++];
    }
    
    public int NextInt() {
        byte b = Read();
        while (b <= 32 && b != 0) b = Read();
        if (b == 0) return -1;
        int val = 0;
        while (b > 32) {
            if (b >= '0' && b <= '9') {
                val = val * 10 + (b - '0');
            }
            b = Read();
        }
        return val;
    }
}

public class ThreadLocalState {
    public bool[] IsNeighbor;
    public int[] K_neighbors;
    public List<int> W;
    public List<int> Clique;
    public List<int> C;
    public List<int> NextC;
    public bool[] InClique;
    public List<int>[] CandidateLists;
    public int[] VertexToCliqueIndex;
    
    // For Exact Solver:
    public ValueList CliqueExact;
    public ValueList[] NextCandidates;
    public int[] Colors;
    public bool[] UsedColors;
    public int[] Indices;
    public CancellationToken Token;
    
    public ThreadLocalState(int n, CancellationToken token) {
        IsNeighbor = new bool[n];
        K_neighbors = new int[n];
        W = new List<int>(1000);
        Clique = new List<int>(1000);
        C = new List<int>(1000);
        NextC = new List<int>(1000);
        InClique = new bool[n];
        CandidateLists = new List<int>[2000];
        for (int i = 0; i < 2000; i++) CandidateLists[i] = new List<int>(100);
        VertexToCliqueIndex = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) VertexToCliqueIndex[i] = -1;
        
        CliqueExact = new ValueList(1000);
        NextCandidates = new ValueList[1000];
        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) NextCandidates[i] = new ValueList(1000);
        Colors = new int[1000];
        UsedColors = new bool[n + 2];
        Indices = new int[1000];
        Token = token;
    }
}

public class Solver {
    private static int globalMaxCliqueSize = 0;
    private static int[] globalBestClique = new int[0];
    private static readonly object lockObject = new object();
    
    private static Graph graph;
    private static BitMatrix bitMatrix;
    private static int[] degrees;
    
    [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
    private static bool IsAdjacent(int u, int v) {
        if (bitMatrix != null) {
            return bitMatrix.IsAdjacent(u, v);
        }
        
        int uStart = graph.Head[u];
        int uLen = graph.Head[u + 1] - uStart;
        int vStart = graph.Head[v];
        int vLen = graph.Head[v + 1] - vStart;
        
        int start = uLen <= vLen ? uStart : vStart;
        int len = uLen <= vLen ? uLen : vLen;
        int target = uLen <= vLen ? v : u;
        
        int low = start;
        int high = start + len - 1;
        while (low <= high) {
            int mid = (low + high) >> 1;
            int val = graph.AdjData[mid];
            if (val < target) {
                low = mid + 1;
            } else if (val > target) {
                high = mid - 1;
            } else {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    public static void Main(string[] args) {
        FastScanner scanner = new FastScanner();
        int numVertices = scanner.NextInt();
        if (numVertices <= 0) {
            Console.WriteLine("0");
            return;
        }
        int numEdges = scanner.NextInt();
        if (numEdges < 0) numEdges = 0;
        
        int[] from = new int[numEdges];
        int[] to = new int[numEdges];
        degrees = new int[numVertices];
        
        int actualEdges = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < numEdges; i++) {
            int u = scanner.NextInt();
            if (u == -1) break;
            int v = scanner.NextInt();
            if (v == -1) break;
            if (u >= 0 && u < numVertices && v >= 0 && v < numVertices && u != v) {
                from[actualEdges] = u;
                to[actualEdges] = v;
                degrees[u]++;
                degrees[v]++;
                actualEdges++;
            }
        }
        
        int[] head = new int[numVertices + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < numVertices; i++) {
            head[i + 1] = head[i] + degrees[i];
        }
        
        int[] adjData = new int[2 * actualEdges];
        int[] currentOffset = new int[numVertices];
        Array.Copy(head, currentOffset, numVertices);
        for (int i = 0; i < actualEdges; i++) {
            int u = from[i];
            int v = to[i];
            adjData[currentOffset[u]++] = v;
            adjData[currentOffset[v]++] = u;
        }
        
        // Sort each adjacency list to allow binary search
        for (int i = 0; i < numVertices; i++) {
            Array.Sort(adjData, head[i], head[i + 1] - head[i]);
        }
        
        // Remove duplicates (self-loops already excluded during reading)
        int writePtr = 0;
        int[] newHead = new int[numVertices + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < numVertices; i++) {
            newHead[i] = writePtr;
            int start = head[i];
            int end = head[i + 1];
            int last = -1;
            for (int j = start; j < end; j++) {
                int v = adjData[j];
                if (v == last) continue; // duplicate
                adjData[writePtr++] = v;
                last = v;
            }
        }
        newHead[numVertices] = writePtr;
        head = newHead;
        
        // Update degrees
        for (int i = 0; i < numVertices; i++) {
            degrees[i] = head[i + 1] - head[i];
        }
        
        graph = new Graph(numVertices, writePtr / 2, head, adjData);
        
        // Initialize BitMatrix if V <= 40000
        if (numVertices <= 40000) {
            bitMatrix = new BitMatrix(numVertices);
            for (int u = 0; u < numVertices; u++) {
                int start = head[u];
                int end = head[u + 1];
                for (int i = start; i < end; i++) {
                    bitMatrix.AddEdge(u, adjData[i]);
                }
            }
        }
        
        // CancellationToken for timeout (4.5 minutes = 270 seconds)
        using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(270));
        
        // --- PHASE 1: Run Heuristic Search ---
        // Sort vertices by degree descending to select starting points
        int[] sortedVertices = new int[numVertices];
        for (int i = 0; i < numVertices; i++) sortedVertices[i] = i;
        Array.Sort(sortedVertices, (x, y) => degrees[y].CompareTo(degrees[x]));
        
        // Choose start vertices: top 15000 by degree, and some random ones if V is large
        List<int> startPoints = new List<int>();
        if (numVertices <= 20000) {
            for (int i = 0; i < numVertices; i++) {
                startPoints.Add(i);
            }
        } else {
            HashSet<int> selected = new HashSet<int>();
            for (int i = 0; i < 15000; i++) {
                selected.Add(sortedVertices[i]);
            }
            Random rand = new Random(42);
            while (selected.Count < 20000) {
                int v = rand.Next(numVertices);
                selected.Add(v);
            }
            startPoints = new List<int>(selected);
        }
        
        var threadLocalHeuristic = new ThreadLocal<ThreadLocalState>(
            () => new ThreadLocalState(numVertices, cts.Token), 
            trackAllValues: false
        );
        
        Parallel.ForEach(startPoints, new ParallelOptions { MaxDegreeOfParallelism = Environment.ProcessorCount }, (startV) => {
            var state = threadLocalHeuristic.Value;
            var clique = FastGreedy(graph, startV, state.IsNeighbor, state.Clique, state.C, state.NextC, degrees);
            var improved = ImproveClique(graph, clique, state.IsNeighbor, state.K_neighbors, state.W, state, state.InClique);
            
            if (improved.Count > globalMaxCliqueSize) {
                lock (lockObject) {
                    if (improved.Count > globalMaxCliqueSize) {
                        globalMaxCliqueSize = improved.Count;
                        globalBestClique = improved.ToArray();
                    }
                }
            }
        });
        
        // --- PHASE 2: Exact Solver ---
        // Compute degeneracy ordering
        int[] order = GetDegeneracyOrdering(graph);
        int[] rank = new int[numVertices];
        for (int i = 0; i < numVertices; i++) {
            rank[order[i]] = i;
        }
        
        // Run exact branch-and-bound search
        try {
            Parallel.For(0, numVertices, new ParallelOptions { 
                CancellationToken = cts.Token,
                MaxDegreeOfParallelism = Environment.ProcessorCount 
            }, (step) => {
                int i = numVertices - 1 - step;
                int u = order[i];
                
                var state = threadLocalHeuristic.Value;
                if (state.Token.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                
                // Collect candidates: neighbors of u with rank > i
                ref ValueList candidates = ref state.NextCandidates[0];
                candidates.Clear();
                
                int start = graph.Head[u];
                int end = graph.Head[u + 1];
                for (int j = start; j < end; j++) {
                    int v = graph.AdjData[j];
                    if (rank[v] > i) {
                        candidates.Add(v);
                    }
                }
                
                if (1 + candidates.Count <= globalMaxCliqueSize) {
                    return; // Prune
                }
                
                // Sort candidates by vertex ID to allow fast IntersectSorted
                Array.Sort(candidates.Array, 0, candidates.Count);
                
                ref ValueList clique = ref state.CliqueExact;
                clique.Clear();
                clique.Add(u);
                
                Search(ref clique, ref candidates, 1, state);
            });
        } catch (OperationCanceledException) {
            // Timeout reached, we use the best clique found so far
        }
        
        // Print the result
        Console.WriteLine(globalMaxCliqueSize);
        Console.WriteLine(string.Join(" ", globalBestClique));
    }
    
    public static List<int> FastGreedy(Graph graph, int startVertex, bool[] isNeighbor, List<int> clique, List<int> C, List<int> nextC, int[] degrees) {
        clique.Clear();
        clique.Add(startVertex);
        
        C.Clear();
        int start = graph.Head[startVertex];
        int end = graph.Head[startVertex + 1];
        for (int i = start; i < end; i++) {
            C.Add(graph.AdjData[i]);
        }
        
        while (C.Count > 0) {
            int bestIdx = -1;
            int maxDeg = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < C.Count; i++) {
                int deg = degrees[C[i]];
                if (deg > maxDeg) {
                    maxDeg = deg;
                    bestIdx = i;
                }
            }
            
            int u = C[bestIdx];
            clique.Add(u);
            
            int uStart = graph.Head[u];
            int uEnd = graph.Head[u + 1];
            for (int i = uStart; i < uEnd; i++) {
                isNeighbor[graph.AdjData[i]] = true;
            }
            
            nextC.Clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < C.Count; i++) {
                int w = C[i];
                if (w != u && isNeighbor[w]) {
                    nextC.Add(w);
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = uStart; i < uEnd; i++) {
                isNeighbor[graph.AdjData[i]] = false;
            }
            
            var tmp = C;
            C = nextC;
            nextC = tmp;
        }
        
        return clique;
    }
    
    public static List<int> ImproveClique(Graph graph, List<int> clique, bool[] isNeighbor, int[] K_neighbors, List<int> W, ThreadLocalState state, bool[] inClique) {
        int V = graph.N;
        List<int> K = new List<int>(clique);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < K.Count; i++) inClique[K[i]] = true;
        
        // Compute initial K_neighbors
        foreach (int v in K) {
            int start = graph.Head[v];
            int end = graph.Head[v + 1];
            for (int i = start; i < end; i++) {
                K_neighbors[graph.AdjData[i]]++;
            }
        }
        
        bool improved = true;
        while (improved) {
            improved = false;
            
            W.Clear();
            int kCount = K.Count;
            if (kCount > 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < kCount; j++) {
                    int v = K[j];
                    int start = graph.Head[v];
                    int end = graph.Head[v + 1];
                    for (int idx = start; idx < end; idx++) {
                        int w = graph.AdjData[idx];
                        if (!inClique[w] && K_neighbors[w] == kCount - 1) {
                            W.Add(w);
                            K_neighbors[w] = -1; // mark as added to W to avoid duplicates
                        }
                    }
                }
                // Restore K_neighbors for elements in W
                for (int j = 0; j < W.Count; j++) {
                    K_neighbors[W[j]] = kCount - 1;
                }
            } else {
                for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
                    if (!inClique[i]) W.Add(i);
                }
            }
            
            if (W.Count < 2) break;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < kCount; i++) {
                int v = K[i];
                state.VertexToCliqueIndex[v] = i;
                state.CandidateLists[i].Clear();
            }
            
            foreach (int w in W) {
                int uniqueNonNeighbor = -1;
                foreach (int v in K) {
                    if (!IsAdjacent(w, v)) {
                        uniqueNonNeighbor = v;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (uniqueNonNeighbor != -1) {
                    int idx = state.VertexToCliqueIndex[uniqueNonNeighbor];
                    state.CandidateLists[idx].Add(w);
                }
            }
            
            int targetY = -1;
            int targetX = -1;
            int targetZ = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < kCount; i++) {
                int y = K[i];
                List<int> cand = state.CandidateLists[i];
                if (cand.Count < 2) continue;
                
                bool foundPair = false;
                for (int j = 0; j < cand.Count; j++) {
                    int x = cand[j];
                    for (int l = j + 1; l < cand.Count; l++) {
                        int z = cand[l];
                        if (IsAdjacent(x, z)) {
                            targetY = y;
                            targetX = x;
                            targetZ = z;
                            foundPair = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (foundPair) break;
                }
                if (foundPair) break;
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < kCount; i++) {
                state.VertexToCliqueIndex[K[i]] = -1;
            }
            
            if (targetY != -1) {
                K.Remove(targetY);
                inClique[targetY] = false;
                
                K.Add(targetX);
                inClique[targetX] = true;
                
                K.Add(targetZ);
                inClique[targetZ] = true;
                
                int startY = graph.Head[targetY];
                int endY = graph.Head[targetY + 1];
                for (int i = startY; i < endY; i++) {
                    K_neighbors[graph.AdjData[i]]--;
                }
                
                int startX = graph.Head[targetX];
                int endX = graph.Head[targetX + 1];
                for (int i = startX; i < endX; i++) {
                    K_neighbors[graph.AdjData[i]]++;
                }
                
                int startZ = graph.Head[targetZ];
                int endZ = graph.Head[targetZ + 1];
                for (int i = startZ; i < endZ; i++) {
                    K_neighbors[graph.AdjData[i]]++;
                }
                
                improved = true;
            }
        }
        
        // Cleanup K_neighbors and inClique before returning
        foreach (int v in K) {
            inClique[v] = false;
            int start = graph.Head[v];
            int end = graph.Head[v + 1];
            for (int i = start; i < end; i++) {
                K_neighbors[graph.AdjData[i]] = 0;
            }
        }
        
        return K;
    }
    
    public static int[] GetDegeneracyOrdering(Graph graph) {
        int n = graph.N;
        int[] degrees = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) degrees[i] = graph.Head[i + 1] - graph.Head[i];

        int[] head = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) head[i] = -1;
        int[] next = new int[n];
        int[] prev = new int[n];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int d = degrees[i];
            next[i] = head[d];
            if (head[d] != -1) prev[head[d]] = i;
            prev[i] = -1;
            head[d] = i;
        }
        
        int[] order = new int[n];
        int[] rank = new int[n];
        bool[] removed = new bool[n];
        
        int minDeg = 0;
        for (int step = 0; step < n; step++) {
            while (minDeg < n && head[minDeg] == -1) {
                minDeg++;
            }
            if (minDeg == n) break;
            
            int u = head[minDeg];
            head[minDeg] = next[u];
            if (next[u] != -1) prev[next[u]] = -1;
            
            order[step] = u;
            rank[u] = step;
            removed[u] = true;
            
            int start = graph.Head[u];
            int end = graph.Head[u + 1];
            for (int i = start; i < end; i++) {
                int v = graph.AdjData[i];
                if (!removed[v]) {
                    int d = degrees[v];
                    int p = prev[v];
                    int nx = next[v];
                    if (p != -1) next[p] = nx;
                    else head[d] = nx;
                    if (nx != -1) prev[nx] = p;
                    
                    degrees[v]--;
                    int newD = degrees[v];
                    
                    next[v] = head[newD];
                    if (head[newD] != -1) prev[head[newD]] = v;
                    prev[v] = -1;
                    head[newD] = v;
                    
                    if (newD < minDeg) {
                        minDeg = newD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return order;
    }
    
    public static void IntersectSorted(ref ValueList a, int[] b, int bStart, int bLen, ref ValueList result) {
        result.Clear();
        int aCount = a.Count;
        int[] aArr = a.Array;
        int i = 0, j = 0;
        while (i < aCount && j < bLen) {
            int valA = aArr[i];
            int valB = b[bStart + j];
            if (valA < valB) {
                i++;
            } else if (valA > valB) {
                j++;
            } else {
                result.Add(valA);
                i++;
                j++;
            }
        }
    }
    
    private static void SortIndicesByColor(int[] indices, int[] colors, int left, int right) {
        if (left >= right) return;
        if (right - left <= 12) {
            for (int k = left + 1; k <= right; k++) {
                int key = indices[k];
                int keyColor = colors[key];
                int m = k - 1;
                while (m >= left && colors[indices[m]] > keyColor) {
                    indices[m + 1] = indices[m];
                    m--;
                }
                indices[m + 1] = key;
            }
            return;
        }
        
        int pivot = colors[indices[left + (right - left) / 2]];
        int i = left;
        int j = right;
        while (i <= j) {
            while (colors[indices[i]] < pivot) i++;
            while (colors[indices[j]] > pivot) j--;
            if (i <= j) {
                int tmp = indices[i];
                indices[i] = indices[j];
                indices[j] = tmp;
                i++;
                j--;
            }
        }
        SortIndicesByColor(indices, colors, left, j);
        SortIndicesByColor(indices, colors, i, right);
    }
    
    private static void Search(ref ValueList clique, ref ValueList candidates, int depth, ThreadLocalState state) {
        if (state.Token.IsCancellationRequested) return;
        
        if (clique.Count + candidates.Count <= globalMaxCliqueSize) return;
        if (candidates.Count == 0) {
            if (clique.Count > globalMaxCliqueSize) {
                lock (lockObject) {
                    if (clique.Count > globalMaxCliqueSize) {
                        globalMaxCliqueSize = clique.Count;
                        globalBestClique = clique.ToArray();
                    }
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        
        int candCount = candidates.Count;
        int[] colors = state.Colors;
        if (colors.Length < candCount) {
            state.Colors = new int[candCount * 2];
            colors = state.Colors;
        }
        
        int[] candArr = candidates.Array;
        bool[] usedColors = state.UsedColors;
        int maxColor = 0;
        
        if (bitMatrix != null) {
            ulong[] data = bitMatrix.Data;
            int rowWords = bitMatrix.RowWords;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < candCount; i++) {
                int u = candArr[i];
                int uOffset = u * rowWords;
                for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                    int v = candArr[j];
                    if ((data[uOffset + (v >> 6)] & (1UL << (v & 63))) != 0) {
                        int c = colors[j];
                        usedColors[c] = true;
                    }
                }
                int color = 1;
                while (usedColors[color]) {
                    color++;
                }
                colors[i] = color;
                if (color > maxColor) maxColor = color;
                
                for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                    int v = candArr[j];
                    if ((data[uOffset + (v >> 6)] & (1UL << (v & 63))) != 0) {
                        int c = colors[j];
                        usedColors[c] = false;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int i = 0; i < candCount; i++) {
                int u = candArr[i];
                for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                    if (IsAdjacent(u, candArr[j])) {
                        int c = colors[j];
                        usedColors[c] = true;
                    }
                }
                int color = 1;
                while (usedColors[color]) {
                    color++;
                }
                colors[i] = color;
                if (color > maxColor) maxColor = color;
                
                for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                    if (IsAdjacent(u, candArr[j])) {
                        int c = colors[j];
                        usedColors[c] = false;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (clique.Count + maxColor <= globalMaxCliqueSize) return;
        
        if (maxColor == 1) {
            if (clique.Count + 1 > globalMaxCliqueSize) {
                lock (lockObject) {
                    if (clique.Count + 1 > globalMaxCliqueSize) {
                        globalMaxCliqueSize = clique.Count + 1;
                        int[] res = new int[clique.Count + 1];
                        Array.Copy(clique.Array, 0, res, 0, clique.Count);
                        res[clique.Count] = candArr[0];
                        globalBestClique = res;
                    }
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        
        int[] indices = state.Indices;
        if (indices.Length < candCount) {
            state.Indices = new int[candCount * 2];
            indices = state.Indices;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < candCount; i++) indices[i] = i;
        
        if (candCount > 1) {
            SortIndicesByColor(indices, colors, 0, candCount - 1);
        }
        
        for (int i = candCount - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int idx = indices[i];
            int v = candArr[idx];
            int color = colors[idx];
            
            if (clique.Count + color <= globalMaxCliqueSize) {
                break;
            }
            
            clique.Add(v);
            if (depth >= state.NextCandidates.Length) {
                var newCandidates = new ValueList[state.NextCandidates.Length * 2];
                Array.Copy(state.NextCandidates, newCandidates, state.NextCandidates.Length);
                for (int j = state.NextCandidates.Length; j < newCandidates.Length; j++) {
                    newCandidates[j] = new ValueList(1000);
                }
                state.NextCandidates = newCandidates;
            }
            IntersectSorted(ref candidates, graph.AdjData, graph.Head[v], graph.Head[v + 1] - graph.Head[v], ref state.NextCandidates[depth]);
            Search(ref clique, ref state.NextCandidates[depth], depth + 1, state);
            clique.Count--;
        }
    }
}
Test 30: 3-SAT Solver (Python) Score: 4.00 / 17
Typical Prompt:
You are writing Python code to solve the 3-SAT (Boolean Satisfiability) problem, which is NP-Complete.

**What is 3-SAT?**
You have N boolean variables (x1, x2, ..., xN), each of which is either True or False.
You are given M "clauses". Each clause is a constraint containing exactly 3 "literals".
A literal is either:
- A positive integer (e.g. 5) meaning "variable 5 must be True", or
- A negative integer (e.g. -5) meaning "variable 5 must be False".

A clause is **satisfied** if ANY of its 3 literals evaluates to True.
The formula is **satisfiable** if ALL clauses can be satisfied simultaneously
by some assignment of True/False to the variables.

**Example:**
Variables: x1, x2, x3
Clause "1 -2 3" means: x1=True OR x2=False OR x3=True.
If x1=True, x2=True, x3=False → clause satisfied (x1=True is enough).

Your task: find an assignment of True/False to every variable that satisfies
every clause. All test instances are guaranteed to be satisfiable.

**Input format (stdin):**
```
num_variables num_clauses
lit1 lit2 lit3
lit1 lit2 lit3
...
```
Variables are 1-indexed. Negative literals mean negation.

**Output format (stdout):**
```
SAT
v1 v2 v3 ... vN
```
Where each vi is 1 (True) or 0 (False) for variable i, space-separated.

**Grading:**
- Output "SAT" on the first line, then the assignment on the second line.
- Every clause must be satisfied by your assignment.
- Timeouts, crashes, wrong format, or unsatisfied clauses all score 0.

**Requirements:**
1. Read from stdin, write to stdout.
2. Handle up to 20M variables and 85M clauses.
3. Complete within 5 minutes.

Write complete, runnable Python code.

import sys
import time
import array
import random

def solve():
    t_start = time.time()
    
    # --- 1. Chunked Input Parsing ---
    clauses = array.array('i')
    remainder = b''
    chunk_size = 16 * 1024 * 1024  # 16 MB chunks
    num_vars = 0
    num_clauses = 0
    header_parsed = False
    
    # Read from standard input stream
    stdin_buffer = sys.stdin.buffer
    
    while True:
        chunk = stdin_buffer.read(chunk_size)
        if not chunk:
            break
        
        data = remainder + chunk
        tokens = data.split()
        
        # Determine remainder to handle boundary splits
        if not chunk.endswith((b' ', b'\n', b'\r', b'\t')):
            if tokens:
                remainder = tokens.pop()
            else:
                remainder = b''
        else:
            remainder = b''
            
        if not tokens:
            continue
            
        start_idx = 0
        if not header_parsed:
            if len(tokens) >= 2:
                num_vars = int(tokens[0])
                num_clauses = int(tokens[1])
                header_parsed = True
                start_idx = 2
            else:
                remainder = b' '.join(tokens) + b' ' + remainder
                continue
        
        if start_idx < len(tokens):
            clauses.extend(map(int, tokens[start_idx:]))
            
    if remainder:
        tokens = remainder.split()
        if tokens:
            if not header_parsed:
                if len(tokens) >= 2:
                    num_vars = int(tokens[0])
                    num_clauses = int(tokens[1])
                    header_parsed = True
                    if len(tokens) > 2:
                        clauses.extend(map(int, tokens[2:]))
            else:
                clauses.extend(map(int, tokens))
                
    if num_clauses == 0 or num_vars == 0:
        return
        
    # --- 2. Lit Counts & Majority Vote Initialization ---
    # We count positive and negative occurrences of all literals in one list
    # by using negative list indexing for negative literals.
    counts = [0] * (2 * num_vars + 2)
    for lit in clauses:
        counts[lit] += 1
        
    assignment = bytearray(num_vars + 1)
    for i in range(1, num_vars + 1):
        if counts[i] >= counts[-i]:
            assignment[i] = 1
        else:
            assignment[i] = 0
            
    # --- 3. Build CSR Occurrence Lists ---
    # offsets list of size 2*N + 3.
    # Positive literals range: offsets[i] to offsets[i+1].
    # Negative literals range: offsets[-i] to offsets[-i+1].
    offsets = [0] * (2 * num_vars + 3)
    s = 0
    for i in range(1, num_vars + 1):
        offsets[i] = s
        s += counts[i]
    offsets[num_vars + 1] = s
    for i in range(num_vars, 0, -1):
        offsets[-i] = s
        s += counts[-i]
    offsets[0] = s
    
    # Free counts to release memory
    counts = None
    
    clauses_of_lit = array.array('i', [0]) * s
    curr = list(offsets)
    for c_idx in range(num_clauses):
        idx = 3 * c_idx
        lit1 = clauses[idx]
        lit2 = clauses[idx+1]
        lit3 = clauses[idx+2]
        
        clauses_of_lit[curr[lit1]] = c_idx
        curr[lit1] += 1
        clauses_of_lit[curr[lit2]] = c_idx
        curr[lit2] += 1
        clauses_of_lit[curr[lit3]] = c_idx
        curr[lit3] += 1
        
    curr = None
    
    # --- 4. Evaluate Initial Clause Satisfaction ---
    num_true = bytearray(num_clauses)
    unsat_clauses = []
    unsat_idx_in_list = array.array('i', [-1]) * num_clauses
    
    for c_idx in range(num_clauses):
        idx = 3 * c_idx
        l1 = clauses[idx]
        l2 = clauses[idx+1]
        l3 = clauses[idx+2]
        
        val1 = assignment[l1] if l1 > 0 else (1 - assignment[-l1])
        val2 = assignment[l2] if l2 > 0 else (1 - assignment[-l2])
        val3 = assignment[l3] if l3 > 0 else (1 - assignment[-l3])
        
        nt = val1 + val2 + val3
        num_true[c_idx] = nt
        if nt == 0:
            unsat_idx_in_list[c_idx] = len(unsat_clauses)
            unsat_clauses.append(c_idx)
            
    # --- 5. WalkSAT Solver ---
    flips = 0
    max_flips = 20 * num_vars
    p = 0.5
    
    unsat_clauses_append = unsat_clauses.append
    unsat_clauses_pop = unsat_clauses.pop
    
    while unsat_clauses and flips < max_flips:
        flips += 1
        
        # Periodic timeout check (safe limit of 280 seconds)
        if flips % 500000 == 0:
            if time.time() - t_start > 280.0:
                break
                
        c_idx = random.choice(unsat_clauses)
        idx = 3 * c_idx
        l1 = clauses[idx]
        l2 = clauses[idx+1]
        l3 = clauses[idx+2]
        
        v1 = abs(l1)
        v2 = abs(l2)
        v3 = abs(l3)
        
        # Cyclic permutation of checking order to eliminate bias
        shift = flips % 3
        if shift == 0:
            first, second, third = v1, v2, v3
        elif shift == 1:
            first, second, third = v2, v3, v1
        else:
            first, second, third = v3, v1, v2
            
        # Compute breaks for first (no conditional wraps needed)
        b1 = 0
        if assignment[first]:
            for o_idx in range(offsets[first], offsets[first+1]):
                if num_true[clauses_of_lit[o_idx]] == 1:
                    b1 += 1
        else:
            for o_idx in range(offsets[-first], offsets[-first+1]):
                if num_true[clauses_of_lit[o_idx]] == 1:
                    b1 += 1
                    
        if b1 == 0:
            v_flip = first
        else:
            # Compute breaks for second
            b2 = 0
            if assignment[second]:
                for o_idx in range(offsets[second], offsets[second+1]):
                    if num_true[clauses_of_lit[o_idx]] == 1:
                        b2 += 1
            else:
                for o_idx in range(offsets[-second], offsets[-second+1]):
                    if num_true[clauses_of_lit[o_idx]] == 1:
                        b2 += 1
                        
            if b2 == 0:
                v_flip = second
            else:
                # Compute breaks for third
                b3 = 0
                if assignment[third]:
                    for o_idx in range(offsets[third], offsets[third+1]):
                        if num_true[clauses_of_lit[o_idx]] == 1:
                            b3 += 1
                else:
                    for o_idx in range(offsets[-third], offsets[-third+1]):
                        if num_true[clauses_of_lit[o_idx]] == 1:
                            b3 += 1
                            
                if b3 == 0:
                    v_flip = third
                else:
                    if random.random() < p:
                        v_flip = random.choice((v1, v2, v3))
                    else:
                        min_b = min(b1, b2, b3)
                        if min_b == b1:
                            v_flip = first
                        elif min_b == b2:
                            v_flip = second
                        else:
                            v_flip = third
                            
        # Perform flip of v_flip
        old_val = assignment[v_flip]
        new_val = 1 - old_val
        assignment[v_flip] = new_val
        
        # Update satisfied state arrays
        if old_val == 1:
            for o_idx in range(offsets[v_flip], offsets[v_flip+1]):
                c = clauses_of_lit[o_idx]
                nt = num_true[c]
                num_true[c] = nt - 1
                if nt == 1:
                    unsat_idx_in_list[c] = len(unsat_clauses)
                    unsat_clauses_append(c)
                    
            for o_idx in range(offsets[-v_flip], offsets[-v_flip+1]):
                c = clauses_of_lit[o_idx]
                nt = num_true[c]
                num_true[c] = nt + 1
                if nt == 0:
                    last_c = unsat_clauses[-1]
                    pos_in_list = unsat_idx_in_list[c]
                    unsat_clauses[pos_in_list] = last_c
                    unsat_idx_in_list[last_c] = pos_in_list
                    unsat_clauses_pop()
                    unsat_idx_in_list[c] = -1
        else:
            for o_idx in range(offsets[-v_flip], offsets[-v_flip+1]):
                c = clauses_of_lit[o_idx]
                nt = num_true[c]
                num_true[c] = nt - 1
                if nt == 1:
                    unsat_idx_in_list[c] = len(unsat_clauses)
                    unsat_clauses_append(c)
                    
            for o_idx in range(offsets[v_flip], offsets[v_flip+1]):
                c = clauses_of_lit[o_idx]
                nt = num_true[c]
                num_true[c] = nt + 1
                if nt == 0:
                    last_c = unsat_clauses[-1]
                    pos_in_list = unsat_idx_in_list[c]
                    unsat_clauses[pos_in_list] = last_c
                    unsat_idx_in_list[last_c] = pos_in_list
                    unsat_clauses_pop()
                    unsat_idx_in_list[c] = -1
                    
    # --- 6. Output Assignment ---
    if not unsat_clauses:
        # Loop-free C-level ASCII translation & slice assignment
        table = bytes.maketrans(b'\x00\x01', b'01')
        translated = assignment[1:].translate(table)
        
        out = bytearray(2 * num_vars - 1)
        out[::2] = translated
        out[1::2] = b' ' * (num_vars - 1)
        
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(b"SAT\n")
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(out + b"\n")
    else:
        sys.stdout.write("UNSAT\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Collections.Generic;

class Solver {
    // Fast PRNG
    class FastRandom {
        private uint x = 123456789;
        private uint y = 362436069;
        private uint z = 521288629;
        private uint w = 88675123;

        public FastRandom(int seed) {
            x = (uint)seed;
            y = x ^ 362436069;
            z = y ^ 521288629;
            w = z ^ 88675123;
        }

        public uint NextUInt() {
            uint t = x ^ (x << 11);
            x = y; y = z; z = w;
            return w = w ^ (w >> 19) ^ t ^ (t >> 8);
        }

        public int Next(int max) {
            return (int)(((ulong)NextUInt() * (ulong)max) >> 32);
        }

        public double NextDouble() {
            return (double)NextUInt() / (double)uint.MaxValue;
        }
    }

    // Fast I/O Reader
    class FastReader {
        private Stream stream;
        private byte[] buffer = new byte[65536];
        private int bufferPointer = 0;
        private int bytesRead = 0;

        public FastReader() {
            stream = Console.OpenStandardInput();
        }

        private byte Read() {
            if (bufferPointer == bytesRead) {
                FillBuffer();
            }
            return bytesRead == 0 ? (byte)0 : buffer[bufferPointer++];
        }

        private void FillBuffer() {
            bufferPointer = 0;
            bytesRead = stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
        }

        public int NextInt() {
            int val = 0;
            byte c = Read();
            while (c <= 32) {
                if (c == 0) return -1; // EOF
                c = Read();
            }
            bool neg = false;
            if (c == '-') {
                neg = true;
                c = Read();
            }
            while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                val = val * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = Read();
            }
            return neg ? -val : val;
        }
    }

    static long Cost(int[] p, int[][] F, int[][] D, int N) {
        long cost = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            int pi = p[i];
            int[] Fi = F[i];
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                cost += (long)Fi[j] * D[pi][p[j]];
            }
        }
        return cost;
    }

    static long Delta(int r, int s, int[] p, int[][] F, int[][] D, int[][] F_col, int[][] D_col, int N) {
        int u = p[r];
        int v = p[s];

        int[] Fr = F[r];
        int[] Fs = F[s];
        int[] F_col_r = F_col[r];
        int[] F_col_s = F_col[s];

        int[] Du = D[u];
        int[] Dv = D[v];
        int[] D_col_u = D_col[u];
        int[] D_col_v = D_col[v];

        long delta = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < N; k++) {
            if (k == r || k == s) continue;
            int pk = p[k];

            long diff1 = ((long)Fr[k] - Fs[k]) * ((long)Dv[pk] - Du[pk]);
            long diff2 = ((long)F_col_r[k] - F_col_s[k]) * ((long)D_col_v[pk] - D_col_u[pk]);

            delta += diff1 + diff2;
        }

        delta += ((long)F[r][r] - F[s][s]) * ((long)D[v][v] - D[u][u]);
        delta += ((long)F[r][s] - F[s][r]) * ((long)D[v][u] - D[u][v]);

        return delta;
    }

    static double GetInitialTemperature(int[] p, int[][] F, int[][] D, int[][] F_col, int[][] D_col, int N, FastRandom rand) {
        long sum = 0;
        int count = 0;
        int[] tempP = (int[])p.Clone();
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            int r = rand.Next(N);
            int s = rand.Next(N);
            if (r == s) continue;
            long d = Delta(r, s, tempP, F, D, F_col, D_col, N);
            sum += Math.Abs(d);
            count++;
            
            int tmp = tempP[r];
            tempP[r] = tempP[s];
            tempP[s] = tmp;
        }
        double avg = count > 0 ? (double)sum / count : 1.0;
        if (avg < 1e-5) avg = 1.0;
        return avg;
    }

    static int[] GetSortHeuristicPermutation(int[][] F, int[][] D, int N) {
        long[] f_sum = new long[N];
        long[] d_sum = new long[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                f_sum[i] += F[i][j] + F[j][i];
                d_sum[i] += D[i][j] + D[j][i];
            }
        }

        int[] fac = new int[N];
        int[] loc = new int[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            fac[i] = i;
            loc[i] = i;
        }

        Array.Sort(fac, (a, b) => f_sum[b].CompareTo(f_sum[a]));
        Array.Sort(loc, (a, b) => d_sum[a].CompareTo(d_sum[b]));

        int[] p = new int[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            p[fac[i]] = loc[i];
        }
        return p;
    }

    static int[] GetRandomPermutation(int N, FastRandom rand) {
        int[] p = new int[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            p[i] = i;
        }
        for (int i = N - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            int j = rand.Next(i + 1);
            int tmp = p[i];
            p[i] = p[j];
            p[j] = tmp;
        }
        return p;
    }

    static int[] Perturb(int[] p, int K, FastRandom rand) {
        int[] next = (int[])p.Clone();
        int N = p.Length;
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            int r = rand.Next(N);
            int s = rand.Next(N);
            if (r != s) {
                int tmp = next[r];
                next[r] = next[s];
                next[s] = tmp;
            }
        }
        return next;
    }

    static bool HillClimb(int[] p, ref long currentCost, int[][] F, int[][] D, int[][] F_col, int[][] D_col, int N) {
        bool improved = false;
        bool localOptimal = false;
        while (!localOptimal) {
            localOptimal = true;
            for (int r = 0; r < N - 1; r++) {
                for (int s = r + 1; s < N; s++) {
                    long delta = Delta(r, s, p, F, D, F_col, D_col, N);
                    if (delta < 0) {
                        int tmp = p[r];
                        p[r] = p[s];
                        p[s] = tmp;
                        currentCost += delta;
                        localOptimal = false;
                        improved = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return improved;
    }

    static void RandomizedHillClimb(int[] p, ref long currentCost, int[][] F, int[][] D, int[][] F_col, int[][] D_col, int N, int maxFails, FastRandom rand) {
        int fails = 0;
        while (fails < maxFails) {
            int r = rand.Next(N);
            int s = rand.Next(N);
            if (r == s) continue;
            long delta = Delta(r, s, p, F, D, F_col, D_col, N);
            if (delta < 0) {
                int tmp = p[r];
                p[r] = p[s];
                p[s] = tmp;
                currentCost += delta;
                fails = 0;
            } else {
                fails++;
            }
        }
    }

    static long SolveSA(int[] p, int[] localBestP, ref long localBestCost, int[][] F, int[][] D, int[][] F_col, int[][] D_col, int N, double T0, double alpha, int maxSteps, FastRandom rand, Stopwatch stopwatch, long timeLimitMs) {
        long currentCost = Cost(p, F, D, N);
        localBestCost = currentCost;
        Array.Copy(p, localBestP, N);

        double T = T0;
        int blockSize = 10000;

        for (int step = 0; step < maxSteps; ) {
            int limit = Math.Min(maxSteps - step, blockSize);
            for (int i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
                int r = rand.Next(N);
                int s = rand.Next(N);
                if (r == s) continue;

                long delta = Delta(r, s, p, F, D, F_col, D_col, N);
                if (delta < 0) {
                    int tmp = p[r];
                    p[r] = p[s];
                    p[s] = tmp;
                    currentCost += delta;

                    if (currentCost < localBestCost) {
                        localBestCost = currentCost;
                        Array.Copy(p, localBestP, N);
                    }
                } else if (T > 1e-9) {
                    double arg = -delta / T;
                    if (arg > -20.0 && rand.NextDouble() < Math.Exp(arg)) {
                        int tmp = p[r];
                        p[r] = p[s];
                        p[s] = tmp;
                        currentCost += delta;
                    }
                }
                T *= alpha;
            }
            step += limit;

            if (stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds > timeLimitMs) {
                break;
            }
        }
        return currentCost;
    }

    static void Main() {
        FastReader reader = new FastReader();
        int N = reader.NextInt();
        if (N <= 0) return;

        int[][] F = new int[N][];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            F[i] = new int[N];
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                F[i][j] = reader.NextInt();
            }
        }

        int[][] D = new int[N][];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            D[i] = new int[N];
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                D[i][j] = reader.NextInt();
            }
        }

        // Precompute columns
        int[][] F_col = new int[N][];
        int[][] D_col = new int[N][];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            F_col[i] = new int[N];
            D_col[i] = new int[N];
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                F_col[j][i] = F[i][j];
                D_col[j][i] = D[i][j];
            }
        }

        Stopwatch stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        FastRandom rand = new FastRandom(42);

        // Parameters based on N
        long timeLimitMs;
        int maxNoImprovementRestarts;
        int maxRestarts;
        int saSteps;

        if (N <= 40) {
            timeLimitMs = 5000;
            maxNoImprovementRestarts = 200;
            maxRestarts = 1000;
            saSteps = N * 5000;
        } else if (N <= 100) {
            timeLimitMs = 15000;
            maxNoImprovementRestarts = 150;
            maxRestarts = 1000;
            saSteps = N * 5000;
        } else if (N <= 300) {
            timeLimitMs = 60000;
            maxNoImprovementRestarts = 80;
            maxRestarts = 500;
            saSteps = N * 5000;
        } else if (N <= 800) {
            timeLimitMs = 180000;
            maxNoImprovementRestarts = 30;
            maxRestarts = 200;
            saSteps = N * 4000;
        } else {
            timeLimitMs = 280000;
            maxNoImprovementRestarts = 10;
            maxRestarts = 100;
            saSteps = N * 2000;
        }

        // Initial Permutation: Sort Heuristic
        int[] bestP = GetSortHeuristicPermutation(F, D, N);
        long bestCost = Cost(bestP, F, D, N);

        // Initial Hill Climbing
        long currentCost = bestCost;
        int[] currentP = (int[])bestP.Clone();
        if (N <= 400) {
            HillClimb(currentP, ref currentCost, F, D, F_col, D_col, N);
        } else {
            RandomizedHillClimb(currentP, ref currentCost, F, D, F_col, D_col, N, N * 20, rand);
        }

        if (currentCost < bestCost) {
            bestCost = currentCost;
            Array.Copy(currentP, bestP, N);
        }

        int numRestarts = 0;
        int noImprovementCount = 0;

        int[] startP = new int[N];
        int[] localBestP = new int[N];

        while (stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds < timeLimitMs && numRestarts < maxRestarts && noImprovementCount < maxNoImprovementRestarts) {
            // Decide starting permutation for this ILS restart
            if (rand.NextDouble() < 0.7) {
                // Perturb the best permutation found so far
                int K = Math.Max(3, N / 10);
                startP = Perturb(bestP, K, rand);
            } else if (rand.NextDouble() < 0.85) {
                // Perturb the sort heuristic
                int[] sortP = GetSortHeuristicPermutation(F, D, N);
                int K = Math.Max(3, N / 10);
                startP = Perturb(sortP, K, rand);
            } else {
                // Completely random
                startP = GetRandomPermutation(N, rand);
            }

            double T0 = GetInitialTemperature(startP, F, D, F_col, D_col, N, rand);
            double alpha = Math.Pow(1e-4, 1.0 / saSteps);

            long localBestCost = 0;
            SolveSA(startP, localBestP, ref localBestCost, F, D, F_col, D_col, N, T0, alpha, saSteps, rand, stopwatch, timeLimitMs);

            // Polish the local best solution
            if (N <= 400) {
                HillClimb(localBestP, ref localBestCost, F, D, F_col, D_col, N);
            } else {
                RandomizedHillClimb(localBestP, ref localBestCost, F, D, F_col, D_col, N, N * 20, rand);
            }

            if (localBestCost < bestCost) {
                bestCost = localBestCost;
                Array.Copy(localBestP, bestP, N);
                noImprovementCount = 0;
            } else {
                noImprovementCount++;
            }

            numRestarts++;
        }

        // Print final result
        Console.WriteLine(bestCost);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            Console.Write(bestP[i]);
            if (i < N - 1) Console.Write(" ");
        }
        Console.WriteLine();
    }
}

import sys
import math

def calculate_distance(p1, p2):
    return math.sqrt((p1[0] - p2[0])**2 + (p1[1] - p2[1])**2)

def solve():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not input_data:
        return
    
    ptr = 0
    N = int(input_data[ptr])
    K = int(input_data[ptr+1])

The code reads the number of vertices and edges from `stdin`, constructs an adjacency list, and iteratively adds the vertex that covers the maximum number of currently uncovered vertices to the set until all vertices are covered. The resulting size of the set and the vertices themselves are printed to ...

use std::io::{self, BufRead};

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut lines = stdin.lock().lines();

    let first_line = match lines.next() {
        Some(Ok(l)) => l,
        _ => return,
    };
    let parts: Vec<usize> = first_line.split_whitespace().map(|s| s.parse().unwrap()).collect();
    if parts.len() < 2 { return; }
    let num_vertices = parts[0];
    let num_edges = parts[1];

    let mut adj = vec![Vec::new(); num_vertices];
    for _ in 0..num_edges {
        if let Some(Ok(line)) = lines.next() {
            let edge: Vec<usize> = line.split_whitespace().map(|s| s.parse().unwrap()).collect();
            if edge.len() >= 2 {
                adj[edge[0]].push(edge[1]);
                adj[edge[1]].push(edge[0]);
            }
        }
    }

    let mut covered = vec![false; num_vertices];
    let mut dominating_set = Vec::new();
    let mut num_covered = 0;

    while num_covered < num_vertices {
        let mut best_v = None;
        let mut max_cover_count = 0;

        for v in 0..num_vertices {
            let mut cover_count = 0;
            if !covered[v] {
                cover_count += 1;
            }
            for &neighbor in &adj[v] {
                if !covered[neighbor] {
                    cover_count += 1;
                }
            }

            if cover_count > max_cover_count {
                max_cover_count = cover_count;
                best_v = Some(v);
            }
        }

        if let Some(v) = best_v {
            dominating_set.push(v);
            if !covered[v] {
                covered[v] = true;
                num_covered += 1;
            }
            for &neighbor in &adj[v] {
                if !covered[neighbor] {
                    covered[neighbor] = true;
                    num_covered += 1;
                }
            }
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }

    println!("{}", dominating_set.len());
    let output: Vec<String> = dominating_set.iter().map(|v| v.to_string()).collect();
    println!("{}", output.join(" "));
}

Find the largest group of nodes in a graph such that no two nodes in the group are connected by an edge. Think of seating people at a dinner party where certain pairs don’t get along — seat as many guests as possible with no feuding neighbours at the same table.

This is NP-hard. The test uses planted instances with a known optimal answer for strict pass/fail grading. Subpasses increase the graph size.

Maximum Independent Set - tiny (60 vertices), planted MIS=20

Graph: 60 vertices, ~200 edges, planted optimum size = 20

Approach: The Maximum Independent Set problem is NP-hard. The provided C++ solution uses a backtracking algorithm with pruning (via a bitset for efficient set operations and a degree-based heuristic) to find the exact maximum independent set.

View C++ Code (1951 chars)
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <bitset>

using namespace std;

// Maximum number of vertices for the problem constraints.
// Using a bitset for the adjacency matrix and sets.
const int MAXN = 100;
bitset<MAXN> adj[MAXN];
bitset<MAXN> best_set;
int max_k = 0;

void solve(bitset<MAXN> P, bitset<MAXN> current_set, int k) {
    if (P.none()) {
        if (k > max_k) {
            max_k = k;
            best_set = current_set;
        }
        return;
    }

    // Pruning: if current k + remaining possible vertices <= max_k, return.
    if (k + (int)P.count() <= max_k) {
        return;
    }

    // Heuristic: pick the vertex with the highest degree in the subgraph P.
    int v = -1;
    int max_degree = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) {
        if (P.test(i)) {
            int degree = (int)(adj[i] & P).count();
            if (degree > max_degree) {
                max_degree = degree;
                v = i;
            }
        }
    }

    if (v == -1) return;

    // Branch 1: include v in the independent set
    bitset<MAXN> next_P = P & ~adj[v];
    next_P.reset(v);
    solve(next_P, current_set | bitset<MAXN>().set(v), k + 1);

    // Branch 2: exclude v
    P.reset(v);
    solve(P, current_set, k);
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int n, m;
    if (!(cin >> n >> m)) return 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        if (u >= 0 && u < n && v >= 0 && v < n && u != v) {
            adj[u].set(v);
            adj[v].set(u);
        }
    }

    bitset<MAXN> P;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) P.set(i);

    solve(P, bitset<MAXN>(), 0);

    cout << max_k << "\n";
    bool first = true;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (best_set.test(i)) {
            if (!first) cout << " ";
            cout << i;
            first = false;
        }
    }
    cout << endl;

    return 0;
}

import sys

# Increase recursion depth for deep search trees
sys.setrecursionlimit(20000)

def solve():
    # Read all input from standard input once
    content = sys.stdin.read()
    lines = content.splitlines()
    
    # Find the header line U S
    header_idx = -1
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if line.strip():
            header_idx = i
            break
            
    if header_idx == -1:
        print("NO SOLUTION")
        return
        
    try:
        parts = lines[header_idx].split()
        U = int(parts[0])
        S = int(parts[1])
    except (ValueError, IndexError):
        print("NO SOLUTION")
        return
        
    sets = []
    curr_line = header_idx + 1
    for _ in range(S):
        if curr_line < len(lines):
            line = lines[curr_line]
            curr_line += 1
            # Parse elements, filter to only keep valid elements 0..U-1
            elements = []
            for x in line.split():
                try:
                    val = int(x)
                    if 0 <= val < U:
                        elements.append(val)
                except ValueError:
                    pass
            sets.append(elements)
        else:
            sets.append([])
            
    # Quick check: if U is 0, empty solution is the unique exact cover
    if U == 0:
        print("SOLUTION")
        print("")
        return
        
    # Build bitmasks for each set
    masks = []
    for s in sets:
        m = 0
        for x in s:
            m |= (1 << x)
        masks.append(m)
        
    # Track which set indices cover each element
    sets_covering = [[] for _ in range(U)]
    for j, s in enumerate(sets):
        for x in s:
            sets_covering[x].append(j)
            
    # If any element cannot be covered by any set, there's no solution
    for e in range(U):
        if not sets_covering[e]:
            print("NO SOLUTION")
            return
            
    # Power of 2 lookup for bitwise operations
    pow2 = [1 << e for e in range(U)]
    
    target_mask = (1 << U) - 1
    chosen = []
    
    def solve_dfs(uncovered, covered_mask):
        if not uncovered:
            return True
            
        # MRV: Choose the uncovered element with the fewest compatible sets
        best_e = -1
        min_count = S + 1
        best_sets = []
        
        for e in uncovered:
            curr_sets = [j for j in sets_covering[e] if not (masks[j] & covered_mask)]
            count = len(curr_sets)
            if count < min_count:
                min_count = count
                best_e = e
                best_sets = curr_sets
                if min_count == 0:
                    break
                    
        if min_count == 0:
            return False
            
        # Try all compatible sets for best_e
        for j in best_sets:
            chosen.append(j)
            next_uncovered = [e for e in uncovered if not (masks[j] & pow2[e])]
            if solve_dfs(next_uncovered, covered_mask | masks[j]):
                return True
            chosen.pop()
            
        return False

    initial_uncovered = list(range(U))
    if solve_dfs(initial_uncovered, 0):
        print("SOLUTION")
        # Print sorted list of 0-based chosen set indices
        print(" ".join(map(str, sorted(chosen))))
    else:
        print("NO SOLUTION")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

use std::io::{self, BufRead};
use std::time::Instant;

struct SimpleRng {
    state: u64,
}

impl SimpleRng {
    fn new(seed: u64) -> Self {
        Self { state: seed }
    }
    
    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {
        let mut x = self.state;
        x ^= x << 13;
        x ^= x >> 7;
        x ^= x << 17;
        self.state = x;
        x
    }
    
    fn next_usize(&mut self, limit: usize) -> usize {
        (self.next_u64() as usize) % limit
    }
    
    fn shuffle<T>(&mut self, slice: &mut [T]) {
        for i in (1..slice.len()).rev() {
            let j = self.next_usize(i + 1);
            slice.swap(i, j);
        }
    }
}

const PART_U: u8 = 0;
const PART_A: u8 = 1;
const PART_B: u8 = 2;

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn dfs(
    depth: usize,
    current_cut: i32,
    rem_a: i32,
    rem_b: i32,
    m_u: i32,
    best_cut: &mut i32,
    best_partition: &mut Vec<usize>,
    partition: &mut Vec<u8>,
    d_a: &mut Vec<i32>,
    d_b: &mut Vec<i32>,
    d_u: &mut Vec<i32>,
    adj: &Vec<Vec<usize>>,
    adj_matrix: &Vec<Vec<bool>>,
    order: &Vec<usize>,
    n: usize,
    buffer: &mut [i32],
    start_time: &Instant,
    time_limit_ms: u128,
    timeout: &mut bool,
) {
    if *timeout {
        return;
    }
    if start_time.elapsed().as_millis() > time_limit_ms {
        *timeout = true;
        return;
    }

    if current_cut >= *best_cut {
        return;
    }

    // Optimization: if rem_a == 0, only B is possible
    if rem_a == 0 {
        let mut final_cut = current_cut;
        for i in depth..n {
            final_cut += d_a[order[i]];
        }
        if final_cut < *best_cut {
            *best_cut = final_cut;
            for i in 0..depth {
                best_partition[order[i]] = partition[order[i]] as usize;
            }
            for i in depth..n {
                best_partition[order[i]] = PART_B as usize;
            }
        }
        return;
    }

    // Optimization: if rem_b == 0, only A is possible
    if rem_b == 0 {
        let mut final_cut = current_cut;
        for i in depth..n {
            final_cut += d_b[order[i]];
        }
        if final_cut < *best_cut {
            *best_cut = final_cut;
            for i in 0..depth {
                best_partition[order[i]] = partition[order[i]] as usize;
            }
            for i in depth..n {
                best_partition[order[i]] = PART_A as usize;
            }
        }
        return;
    }

    // Simple lower bound check
    let mut lb_simple = current_cut;
    for i in depth..n {
        let u = order[i];
        lb_simple += std::cmp::min(d_a[u], d_b[u]);
    }
    if lb_simple >= *best_cut {
        return;
    }

    // Full lower bound calculation
    let mut lb_sum = 0;
    let limit_a_val = rem_a - 1;
    let limit_b_val = rem_b - 1;
    let has_limit_a = rem_a > 1;
    let has_limit_b = rem_b > 1;

    for i in depth..n {
        let u = order[i];
        let du = d_u[u];
        let limit_a = if has_limit_a { std::cmp::min(du, limit_a_val) } else { 0 };
        let limit_b = if has_limit_b { std::cmp::min(du, limit_b_val) } else { 0 };
        
        let two_fa = 2 * d_b[u] - limit_a;
        let two_fb = 2 * d_a[u] - limit_b;
        
        lb_sum += two_fb;
        buffer[i] = two_fa - two_fb;
    }

    let rem_a_idx = rem_a as usize;
    let slice = &mut buffer[depth..n];
    if rem_a_idx > 0 && rem_a_idx < slice.len() {
        let (left, _, _) = slice.select_nth_unstable(rem_a_idx);
        for &val in left.iter() {
            lb_sum += val;
        }
    } else if rem_a_idx == slice.len() {
        for &val in slice.iter() {
            lb_sum += val;
        }
    }

    let lower_bound = (2 * current_cut + 2 * m_u + lb_sum + 1) / 2;
    if lower_bound >= *best_cut {
        return;
    }

    // Branching on P[depth]
    let u = order[depth];

    // Heuristic: try the partition that increases cut less first
    let try_a_first = d_b[u] < d_a[u];

    let branches = if try_a_first {
        [(PART_A, rem_a - 1, d_b[u]), (PART_B, rem_b - 1, d_a[u])]
    } else {
        [(PART_B, rem_b - 1, d_a[u]), (PART_A, rem_a - 1, d_b[u])]
    };

    for &(part, new_rem, cut_inc) in &branches {
        // Apply transition
        partition[u] = part;
        let prev_m_u = m_u;
        let mut edges_removed_from_u = 0;
        
        for &neighbor in &adj[u] {
            if partition[neighbor] == PART_U {
                d_u[neighbor] -= 1;
                edges_removed_from_u += 1;
                if part == PART_A {
                    d_a[neighbor] += 1;
                } else {
                    d_b[neighbor] += 1;
                }
            }
        }

        let next_rem_a = if part == PART_A { new_rem } else { rem_a };
        let next_rem_b = if part == PART_B { new_rem } else { rem_b };

        dfs(
            depth + 1,
            current_cut + cut_inc,
            next_rem_a,
            next_rem_b,
            prev_m_u - edges_removed_from_u,
            best_cut,
            best_partition,
            partition,
            d_a,
            d_b,
            d_u,
            adj,
            adj_matrix,
            order,
            n,
            buffer,
            start_time,
            time_limit_ms,
            timeout,
        );

        // Backtrack transition
        for &neighbor in &adj[u] {
            if partition[neighbor] == PART_U {
                d_u[neighbor] += 1;
                if part == PART_A {
                    d_a[neighbor] -= 1;
                } else {
                    d_b[neighbor] -= 1;
                }
            }
        }
        partition[u] = PART_U;
    }
}

fn kernighan_lin(
    n: usize,
    adj: &Vec<Vec<usize>>,
    adj_matrix: &Vec<Vec<bool>>,
    rng: &mut SimpleRng,
    best_cut: &mut i32,
    best_partition: &mut Vec<usize>,
) {
    let mut vertices: Vec<usize> = (0..n).collect();
    rng.shuffle(&mut vertices);
    
    let mut partition = vec![0; n];
    for i in 0..n/2 {
        partition[vertices[i]] = 1;
    }
    for i in n/2..n {
        partition[vertices[i]] = 2;
    }
    
    let mut improved = true;
    while improved {
        improved = false;
        
        let mut d = vec![0; n];
        for u in 0..n {
            let mut ext = 0;
            let mut r#in = 0;
            let p_u = partition[u];
            for &v in &adj[u] {
                if partition[v] == p_u {
                    r#in += 1;
                } else {
                    ext += 1;
                }
            }
            d[u] = ext - r#in;
        }
        
        let mut swapped = vec![false; n];
        let mut swap_pairs = Vec::with_capacity(n / 2);
        let mut gains = Vec::with_capacity(n / 2);
        
        let mut temp_partition = partition.clone();
        let mut temp_d = d.clone();
        
        for _ in 0..n/2 {
            let mut best_a = None;
            let mut best_b = None;
            let mut max_gain = i32::MIN;
            
            for u in 0..n {
                if temp_partition[u] == 1 && !swapped[u] {
                    for v in 0..n {
                        if temp_partition[v] == 2 && !swapped[v] {
                            let gain = temp_d[u] + temp_d[v] - if adj_matrix[u][v] { 2 } else { 0 };
                            if gain > max_gain {
                                max_gain = gain;
                                best_a = Some(u);
                                best_b = Some(v);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if let (Some(a), Some(b)) = (best_a, best_b) {
                swapped[a] = true;
                swapped[b] = true;
                swap_pairs.push((a, b));
                gains.push(max_gain);
                
                temp_partition[a] = 2;
                temp_partition[b] = 1;
                
                for x in 0..n {
                    if !swapped[x] {
                        let c_xa = adj_matrix[x][a];
                        let c_xb = adj_matrix[x][b];
                        if partition[x] == 1 {
                            temp_d[x] += if c_xa { 2 } else { 0 } - if c_xb { 2 } else { 0 };
                        } else {
                            temp_d[x] += if c_xb { 2 } else { 0 } - if c_xa { 2 } else { 0 };
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        
        let mut cumulative_gain = 0;
        let mut max_cum_gain = 0;
        let mut best_k = 0;
        for i in 0..swap_pairs.len() {
            cumulative_gain += gains[i];
            if cumulative_gain > max_cum_gain {
                max_cum_gain = cumulative_gain;
                best_k = i + 1;
            }
        }
        
        if max_cum_gain > 0 {
            for i in 0..best_k {
                let (a, b) = swap_pairs[i];
                partition.swap(a, b);
            }
            improved = true;
        }
    }
    
    let mut cut = 0;
    for u in 0..n {
        for &v in &adj[u] {
            if u < v && partition[u] != partition[v] {
                cut += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    
    if cut < *best_cut {
        *best_cut = cut;
        *best_partition = partition;
    }
}

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut lines = stdin.lock().lines();
    
    let first_line = match lines.next() {
        Some(Ok(line)) => line,
        _ => return,
    };
    let parts: Vec<&str> = first_line.split_whitespace().collect();
    if parts.len() < 2 {
        return;
    }
    let n: usize = parts[0].parse().unwrap();
    let m: usize = parts[1].parse().unwrap();
    
    let mut adj = vec![Vec::new(); n];
    let mut adj_matrix = vec![vec![false; n]; n];
    
    for _ in 0..m {
        if let Some(Ok(line)) = lines.next() {
            let edge: Vec<&str> = line.split_whitespace().collect();
            if edge.len() >= 2 {
                let u: usize = edge[0].parse().unwrap();
                let v: usize = edge[1].parse().unwrap();
                adj[u].push(v);
                adj[v].push(u);
                adj_matrix[u][v] = true;
                adj_matrix[v][u] = true;
            }
        }
    }
    
    let start_time = Instant::now();
    
    // 1. Initial heuristic: Kernighan-Lin
    let mut best_cut = i32::MAX;
    let mut best_partition = vec![0; n];
    let mut rng = SimpleRng::new(42);
    
    // Run KL with multiple random restarts
    let kl_restarts = if n < 50 { 30 } else { 10 };
    for _ in 0..kl_restarts {
        kernighan_lin(n, &adj, &adj_matrix, &mut rng, &mut best_cut, &mut best_partition);
    }
    
    // 2. Vertex ordering for branch and bound
    let mut order = Vec::with_capacity(n);
    let mut added = vec![false; n];
    let mut conn = vec![0; n];

    let mut best_v = 0;
    let mut max_deg = -1;
    for i in 0..n {
        let deg = adj[i].len() as i32;
        if deg > max_deg {
            max_deg = deg;
            best_v = i;
        }
    }

    order.push(best_v);
    added[best_v] = true;
    for &neighbor in &adj[best_v] {
        conn[neighbor] += 1;
    }

    for _ in 1..n {
        let mut best_v = -1;
        let mut max_conn = -1;
        let mut max_deg = -1;
        for i in 0..n {
            if !added[i] {
                if conn[i] > max_conn || (conn[i] == max_conn && (adj[i].len() as i32) > max_deg) {
                    max_conn = conn[i];
                    max_deg = adj[i].len() as i32;
                    best_v = i as i32;
                }
            }
        }
        let u = best_v as usize;
        order.push(u);
        added[u] = true;
        for &neighbor in &adj[u] {
            conn[neighbor] += 1;
        }
    }
    
    // 3. Exact search (Branch and Bound)
    // Symmetries broken: force order[0] to be in partition A (PART_A)
    let mut partition = vec![PART_U; n];
    let mut d_a = vec![0; n];
    let mut d_b = vec![0; n];
    let mut d_u = vec![0; n];
    for u in 0..n {
        d_u[u] = adj[u].len() as i32;
    }
    
    // Assign order[0] to PART_A
    let u0 = order[0];
    partition[u0] = PART_A;
    let mut m_u = m as i32;
    for &neighbor in &adj[u0] {
        d_u[neighbor] -= 1;
        m_u -= 1;
        d_a[neighbor] += 1;
    }
    
    let mut buffer = vec![0; n];
    let mut timeout = false;
    
    // Depth-first search starting from depth 1
    // Remaining counts: rem_a = n/2 - 1, rem_b = n/2
    dfs(
        1,
        0,
        (n / 2) as i32 - 1,
        (n / 2) as i32,
        m_u,
        &mut best_cut,
        &mut best_partition,
        &mut partition,
        &mut d_a,
        &mut d_b,
        &mut d_u,
        &adj,
        &adj_matrix,
        &order,
        n,
        &mut buffer,
        &start_time,
        1800, // 1.8 seconds time limit
        &mut timeout,
    );
    
    // Print the results
    println!("{}", best_cut);
    let mut part_a_vertices = Vec::new();
    for i in 0..n {
        if best_partition[i] == PART_A as usize {
            part_a_vertices.push(i);
        }
    }
    
    let output_str = part_a_vertices
        .iter()
        .map(|v| v.to_string())
        .collect::<Vec<String>>()
        .join(" ");
    println!("{}", output_str);
}
